Divide between the tins and bake for 25 minutes, until golden and springy to the touch. Cool completely.
Spread one layer with jam and the whipped cream, sandwich with the second and dust with icing sugar.

notes: Dessert.

title: Buttery Shortbread Fingers
summary: Three-ingredient shortbread with a sandy, melting crumb.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 160°C (140°C fan) and line a 20 x 30cm tin.
Beat the butter and sugar until pale, then work in the flour to a soft dough. Press into the tin and prick with a fork.
Score into 24 fingers and bake for 25 minutes, until pale gold. Sprinkle with the extra sugar, recut along the lines while warm and cool in the tin.

notes: Dessert.

title: Bread and Butter Pudding
summary: Buttered bread baked in a vanilla custard with sultanas until puffed and golden.

steps.text: Butter the bread, cut into triangles and layer in a 2-litre baking dish with the sultanas.
Whisk the eggs, milk, cream, sugar and vanilla and pour over the bread. Rest for 20 minutes.
Heat the oven to 170°C (150°C fan), sprinkle the top with nutmeg and bake for 40 minutes, until golden and the custard is set.

notes: Dessert.
Plus 20 minutes soaking.
Food safety: bake until the custard is set in the middle, with no liquid egg.

title: Herby Pork Sausage Rolls
summary: Flaky pastry around a herby pork and onion filling.

steps.text: Mix the pork, onion, breadcrumbs, egg, thyme, salt and pepper until well combined.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Cut the pastry into 6 even rectangles, spoon a log of filling along each and roll up with the seam underneath.
Cut into 4 pieces each, brush with egg yolk and scatter with sesame seeds.
Bake on lined trays for 30 minutes, until golden and the filling reaches 75°C in the centre.

notes: Food safety: pork mince must reach 75°C right through with no pink inside.

title: Almond Linzer Biscuits
summary: Buttery almond biscuits sandwiched with raspberry jam and a cut-out window.

steps.text: Beat the butter and 1/2 cup icing sugar until pale, then beat in the yolk and vanilla. Stir in the flour and almond meal to a soft dough, wrap and chill.
Heat the oven to 170°C (150°C fan). Roll the dough 3mm thick, cut 6cm rounds and cut a small window out of half of them.
Bake on lined trays for 12 minutes, until pale golden. Cool completely.
Dust the window biscuits with icing sugar, spread the others with jam and sandwich together.

notes: Dessert.
Plus 1 hour chilling.

title: Soft Pretzel Bites
summary: Chewy, mahogany pretzel nuggets with coarse salt, dipped in mustard.

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, salt, water and butter, then knead for 8 minutes, until smooth. Cover and rise until doubled.
Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Roll the dough into ropes and cut into 3cm pieces.
Boil 2 litres of water with the bicarbonate of soda, then poach the pieces in batches for 30 seconds each, until puffed. Lift out onto a lined tray.
Brush with egg yolk, sprinkle with sea salt and bake for 15 minutes, until deep brown. Serve with mustard.

notes: Plus 1 hour rising.
Vegetarian. Handle the bicarbonate water carefully, as it is caustic.

title: Pavlova with Berries and Cream
summary: A crisp-shelled, marshmallowy meringue piled with cream and berries.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 150°C (130°C fan) and draw a 20cm circle on baking paper.
Whisk the egg whites to stiff peaks, then add the sugar a spoonful at a time, whisking for 8 minutes, until thick, glossy and the sugar has dissolved. Fold in the vinegar, cornflour and vanilla.
Pile into the circle, make a dip in the middle and reduce the oven to 120°C (100°C fan). Bake for 75 minutes, until crisp outside, then turn off the oven and cool inside with the door ajar.
Top with the cream and berries just before serving.

notes: Dessert.
Plus 2 hours cooling in the oven.
Vegetarian; gluten-free if you use cornflour labelled gluten-free.

title: Pumpkin Scones
summary: Soft golden scones made with mashed pumpkin, a Queensland classic.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan) and flour a tray.
Beat the mash, 30g butter, sugar and egg in a bowl, then fold in the flour and enough milk to form a soft dough.
Pat out 2.5cm thick, cut into rounds and place close together on the tray.
Bake for 18 minutes, until risen and golden, then brush with the extra butter.

notes: Vegetarian.

title: Coconut Oat Bliss Balls
summary: No-bake energy bites with oats, peanut butter and a pinch of salt.

steps.text: Mix the oats, peanut butter, maple syrup, 1/4 cup coconut, cocoa and salt in a bowl until the mixture holds together.
Roll heaped teaspoons of the mixture into 18 even balls, pressing firmly so they hold.
Roll the balls in the remaining coconut and chill until firm.

notes: Plus 30 minutes chilling.
Vegan. Use certified gluten-free oats to keep it gluten-free.

title: Apple Crumble Bars
summary: A buttery oat base and crumble top sandwiching cinnamon apple.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan) and line a 20cm square tin.
Mix the flour, oats, brown sugar, 1/2 tsp cinnamon and bicarbonate of soda, then stir in the butter until crumbly. Press two-thirds into the tin.
Toss the apple with the caster sugar, lemon juice and remaining cinnamon and spread over the base, then crumble the rest of the oat mix on top.
Bake for 40 minutes, until golden and the apple is tender. Cool before cutting.

notes: Dessert.
Vegetarian.

title: Chocolate Chunk Cookies
summary: Big chewy cookies with crisp edges and pools of dark chocolate.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan) and line two trays.
Beat the butter and both sugars until creamy, then beat in the egg and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, bicarbonate of soda and salt, then fold in the chocolate.
Scoop 12 mounds onto the trays and bake for 12 minutes, until golden at the edges but soft in the centre. Cool on the tray for 5 minutes.

notes: Dessert.
Vegetarian.

title: Buffalo Cauliflower Bites
summary: Crisp-coated cauliflower tossed in a hot, tangy buffalo glaze.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Whisk the flour, water, garlic powder and paprika to a smooth batter.
Coat the florets in the batter and spread on a lined tray. Bake for 20 minutes, until golden and crisp at the edges.
Whisk the hot sauce and melted butter, toss the florets in it and bake for 5 minutes more, until sticky.
Stir the chives into the yoghurt and serve alongside as a dip.

notes: Vegetarian.

title: Classic Deviled Eggs
summary: Creamy, tangy egg yolk filling piped into halved boiled eggs.

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, until the whites and yolks are fully set, then cool in iced water and peel.
Halve the eggs and scoop the yolks into a bowl. Mash with the mayonnaise, mustard and vinegar until smooth.
Pipe or spoon the filling back into the whites and finish with the paprika and chives.

notes: Food safety: boil the eggs until the yolks are fully set and keep them chilled until serving; eat within 2 days.
Gluten-free and vegetarian.

title: Charred Corn Esquites
summary: Street-style corn cut from the cob and tossed with lime, mayo and chilli.

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over high heat and cook the corn for 8 minutes, stirring rarely, until charred in spots.
Toss the hot corn with the mayonnaise, lime juice and chilli powder.
Fold through the feta and coriander and serve warm.

notes: Vegetarian and gluten-free.

title: Chunky Guacamole with Corn Chips
summary: Lime-spiked mashed avocado with tomato, onion and coriander.

steps.text: Mash the avocado roughly in a bowl, leaving some chunks.
Stir in the onion, tomato, coriander, lime juice, jalapeño and salt.
Taste and add more lime or salt until it is bright and well seasoned, then serve straight away with the corn chips.

notes: Vegan and gluten-free.
Press cling wrap onto the surface to stop it browning if you make it ahead.

title: Brazilian Cheese Puffs
summary: Chewy, gluten-free cheese puffs made with tapioca starch.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and line a tray.
Heat the milk, oil and salt until just boiling, then pour over the tapioca starch and mix until smooth and cool for 10 minutes.
Beat in the egg and cheese to a sticky dough, roll into 24 balls and place on the tray.
Bake for 25 minutes, until puffed and golden.

notes: Vegetarian and gluten-free.
Best eaten warm on the day.

title: Baked Beef Empanadas
summary: Golden pastry half-moons with a spiced beef, olive and egg filling.

steps.text: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, until set, then cool, peel and chop.

Cook the onion in a frying pan for 6 minutes, until soft. Add the mince, garlic, cumin and paprika and cook for 8 minutes, until browned and the mince is cooked through. Stir in the tomato paste, olives and chopped egg and cool.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Cut 12 rounds of pastry, fill, fold into half-moons and crimp the edges.
Brush with egg yolk and bake on lined trays for 25 minutes, until golden.

notes: Food safety: beef mince must reach 75°C right through before filling; the filled pies should be steaming hot in the centre.

title: Rum Glazed Grilled Pineapple
summary: Caramelised pineapple rings with a rum and brown sugar glaze.

items.raw: 800g pineapple, peeled and cut into thick rings
items.prep: peeled and cut into thick rings

steps.text: Mix the rum, sugar, cinnamon and coconut oil and brush over the pineapple rings.
Cook in a hot griddle pan for 4 minutes each side, until deeply caramelised and charred in stripes.
Spoon over any remaining glaze and serve warm.

notes: Dessert.
Vegan and gluten-free.

title: Caribbean Johnny Cakes
summary: Golden pan-fried dumplings that are crisp outside and soft within.

steps.text: Mix the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt, then rub in the butter until the mixture looks like breadcrumbs.
Stir in the coconut milk to a soft dough, knead briefly and divide into 6. Flatten into discs.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat and fry the cakes for 6 minutes each side, until deep golden and cooked through.

notes: Vegetarian.

title: Zucchini and Feta Frittata
summary: A thick, baked frittata with soft zucchini and salty feta.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Whisk the eggs, milk and salt, then stir in the zucchini, feta, spring onion and basil.
Heat the oil in a 24cm ovenproof frying pan over medium heat, pour in the mixture and cook for 3 minutes, until the edge starts to set.
Bake for 25 minutes, until puffed, golden and set in the centre.

notes: Vegetarian and gluten-free.
Food safety: the eggs must be fully set in the centre.

title: Tomato Bruschetta Trio
summary: Crisp garlic toast with three vibrant toppings: tomato, white bean and olive.

steps.text: Toast or grill the bread until golden, then rub with the cut garlic.
Toss the tomato with the basil and 1 tbsp oil. Mash the beans roughly with the lemon juice and 1 tbsp oil. Mix the olives with the capers and 1 tbsp oil.
Spoon each topping onto bread slices, drizzle with the remaining oil and serve straight away.

notes: Vegan.

title: Minestrone with Pesto Swirl
summary: A thick vegetable and bean soup finished with a spoon of basil pesto.

steps.text: Cook the onion, carrot and celery in the oil in a large pot over medium heat for 8 minutes, until soft. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and stock and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the beans, pasta and zucchini and cook for 10 minutes, until the pasta is tender.
Ladle into bowls and top with a spoonful of pesto.

notes: Vegetarian: check the pesto label for a vegetarian hard cheese.

title: Ratatouille Tartines
summary: Slow-cooked Provençal vegetables piled on toasted sourdough.

steps.text: Cook the eggplant in 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat for 8 minutes, until golden. Set aside.
Cook the zucchini, capsicum and onion in the remaining oil for 8 minutes, until soft. Add the garlic and herbs for 1 minute.
Return the eggplant, add the tomatoes and simmer for 12 minutes, until thick and jammy.
Toast the sourdough until golden and spoon over the ratatouille.

notes: Vegan.

title: Garlic Prawns on Toast
summary: Sizzling prawns in garlicky chilli oil, mopped up with grilled bread.

steps.text: Warm the oil, garlic and chilli flakes in a frying pan over medium heat for 2 minutes, until the garlic is fragrant but not browned.
Add the prawns and paprika and cook for 3 minutes, turning once, until the prawns are pink and opaque.
Stir in the lemon juice and parsley. Grill the bread until golden and spoon the prawns and oil over.

notes: Food safety: cook prawns until opaque and pink right through, about 63°C, and don't reuse leftovers more than a day later. Keep any leftover garlic, herb or chilli oil in the fridge and use it within 4 days.

title: Smoky Garlic Chickpeas with Wilted Greens
summary: A smoky Andalusian-style stew of chickpeas, spinach and cumin.

steps.text: Cook the onion in the oil in a large pot over medium heat for 8 minutes, until soft. Add the garlic, cumin and paprika for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, chickpeas and 1 cup water and simmer for 15 minutes, until thick.
Stir through the spinach until wilted, then add the vinegar.

notes: Vegan and gluten-free.

title: Fakes Greek Lentil Soup
summary: A thick, earthy lentil soup with garlic, bay and a splash of red wine vinegar.

steps.text: Cook the onion and carrot in 2 tbsp oil for 6 minutes, until soft. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, bay leaves, tomatoes and stock and simmer for 35 minutes, until the lentils are tender and the soup is thick.
Stir in the vinegar and drizzle with the remaining oil.

notes: Vegan and gluten-free.

title: Falafel Bowls with Tahini Sauce
summary: Crisp baked falafel on rice and salad with a lemony tahini drizzle.

steps.text: Pulse the chickpeas, onion, garlic, herbs and spices in a food processor until coarse. Stir in the flour and bicarbonate of soda and shape into 16 balls.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Brush with the oil and bake on a lined tray for 25 minutes, turning once, until golden and crisp.
Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, and drain.
Whisk the tahini, lemon juice and 3 tbsp water until pourable. Serve the falafel over rice with the tomato, cucumber and sauce.

notes: Vegan.

title: Chicken Shawarma Flatbread Rolls
summary: Spiced, charred chicken wrapped with garlic sauce, pickles and salad.

steps.text: Toss the chicken with the oil, spices and garlic.
Cook in a hot frying pan for 12 minutes, turning, until charred in spots and the chicken reaches 75°C in the centre.
Warm the flatbreads, spread with toum and fill with the chicken, cucumber, tomato and pickled turnip.

notes: Plus 30 minutes marinating, if you have time.
Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C with no pink meat.

title: Harira Chickpea and Lentil Soup
summary: A fragrant Moroccan tomato soup with lentils, chickpeas and a squeeze of lemon.

steps.text: Cook the onion and celery in the oil for 8 minutes, until soft. Add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, lentils, chickpeas and stock and simmer for 30 minutes, until the lentils are soft.
Break the vermicelli into the pot and cook for 5 minutes, until tender, then finish with coriander and lemon juice.

notes: Vegan.

title: Jacket Potato with Beans and Cheese
summary: Crisp-skinned baked potatoes filled with baked beans and melted cheddar.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Rub the potatoes with oil and salt and bake directly on the rack for 60 minutes, until the skin is crisp and the flesh is soft.
Warm the beans in a saucepan until steaming.
Split the potatoes, mash in the butter, then top with the beans and cheddar. Grill for 2 minutes, until bubbling.

notes: Vegetarian.

title: Cheesy Tuna Toasties
summary: A creamy tuna and cheddar filling grilled between crisp slices of bread.

steps.text: Mix the tuna, mayonnaise, spring onion and lemon juice.
Spoon over two slices of bread, top with the cheddar and the other slices, then butter the outsides.
Cook in a frying pan over medium heat for 4 minutes each side, until golden and the cheese has melted.

notes: Food safety: tinned tuna is cooked; keep opened tins chilled and use within 2 days.

title: Black Bean Quesadillas
summary: Crisp tortillas oozing with black beans, corn and melted cheese.

steps.text: Mash half the beans roughly and mix with the whole beans, corn, cumin and coriander.
Spread over two tortillas, scatter with the cheese and top with the remaining tortillas.
Cook in a dry frying pan over medium heat for 4 minutes each side, until golden and the cheese has melted. Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

notes: Vegetarian.

title: Lemon Semifreddo
summary: A frozen, no-churn cream dessert with a bright lemon flavour and a soft, mousse-like texture.

steps.text: Line a loaf tin with baking paper.
Whisk the cream with the icing sugar until it forms soft peaks, then fold in the mascarpone, lemon zest, lemon juice and vanilla until smooth.
Pour into the tin, cover and freeze until firm enough to slice.
Slice with a warm knife and serve straight away.

notes: Dessert.
Plus 6 hours freezing.
Vegetarian and gluten-free.

title: Ricotta and Honey Crostata
summary: A free-form rustic tart with a sweet ricotta filling and a jammy glaze.

steps.text: Rub the butter into the flour and icing sugar until it looks like breadcrumbs, then mix in the egg yolk and enough iced water to bring the dough together. Wrap and chill.
Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Mix the ricotta, honey, egg and lemon zest until smooth.
Roll the pastry to a 30cm round on baking paper, spoon the filling into the centre and fold the edges over, leaving the middle open.
Bake for 35 minutes, until the pastry is golden and the filling is just set. Brush the pastry with warm jam.

notes: Dessert.
Plus 30 minutes chilling.
Vegetarian.
Food safety: bake until the ricotta filling is set and the egg is fully cooked.

title: Flourless Chocolate Torta Caprese
summary: A fudgy, naturally gluten-free chocolate and almond cake from Capri.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 170°C (150°C fan) and line a 22cm springform tin.
Melt the chocolate and butter together in a bowl over simmering water, stirring until smooth. Cool for 10 minutes.
Beat the yolks with half the sugar until pale, then stir in the chocolate and almond meal.
Whisk the egg whites to soft peaks, add the remaining sugar and whisk until glossy. Fold into the batter in two batches.
Bake for 35 minutes, until the top is set and cracked and a skewer comes out with moist crumbs. Cool in the tin and dust with icing sugar.

notes: Dessert.
Gluten-free and vegetarian.

title: Crisp Rosemary Grissini
summary: Thin, crunchy breadsticks flecked with rosemary and sea salt.

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, salt, water and 2 tbsp oil to a dough and knead for 8 minutes, until smooth. Cover and rise until doubled.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Roll the dough out to a rectangle and cut into 24 thin strips.
Roll each strip into a long thin stick, lay on lined trays and brush with the remaining oil. Sprinkle with the rosemary and sea salt.
Bake for 18 minutes, until deep golden and crisp all the way through.

notes: Plus 1 hour rising.
Vegan.

title: Brown Butter Almond Financiers
summary: Small, buttery French almond cakes with nutty brown butter and a chewy edge.

steps.text: Cook the butter in a saucepan over medium heat for 5 minutes, until it smells nutty and turns golden-brown, then cool.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and grease a 12-hole muffin tin.
Whisk the egg whites lightly, then stir in the icing sugar, almond meal, flour and vanilla until just combined. Fold in the brown butter.
Spoon into the holes, scatter with flaked almonds and bake for 15 minutes, until golden with a crisp edge.

notes: Dessert.
Vegetarian.

title: Cheddar Gougères
summary: Light, airy choux puffs baked with sharp cheddar and a hint of mustard.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and line two trays.
Bring the water, butter and salt to the boil in a saucepan, tip in the flour and beat for 2 minutes, until the dough pulls from the sides.
Cool for 5 minutes, then beat in the eggs one at a time until glossy, then the mustard and 1 cup of the cheddar.
Spoon 24 mounds onto the trays, top with the remaining cheese and bake for 30 minutes, until puffed and deep golden. Do not open the oven in the first 20 minutes.

notes: Vegetarian. Best eaten warm.

title: Pan-Fried Chocolate Fondants
summary: Little warm chocolate cakes with a molten, runny middle.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and grease four ramekins with butter and dust with cocoa.
Melt the chocolate and butter together, stirring until smooth, and cool a little.
Whisk the eggs, yolks and sugar until pale and thick, then fold in the chocolate and flour.
Fill the ramekins and bake for 12 minutes, until the edges are set and the centre still wobbles. Turn out onto plates and serve immediately.

notes: Dessert.
Food safety: the centre stays soft by design; skip this recipe for anyone pregnant, elderly or immunocompromised, or bake 3 minutes longer until firm.
Vegetarian.

title: Pissaladière Onion and Anchovy Tart
summary: Sweet, slow-cooked onions and salty anchovies on crisp pastry, a Nice classic.

steps.text: Cook the onions in the oil with the thyme and bay leaf over low heat for 30 minutes, stirring often, until deeply golden and jammy.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Lay the pastry on a lined tray, prick it and score a 2cm border.
Spread with the onions, arrange the anchovies in a lattice and dot with olives.
Bake for 25 minutes, until the pastry is puffed and golden.

notes: Food safety: tinned anchovies are cured and safe to eat as they are; keep opened tins chilled.

title: Tarta de Santiago
summary: A moist, gluten-free Galician almond cake with a lemon scent.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan) and line a 22cm springform tin.
Whisk the eggs and sugar for 4 minutes, until pale and thick, then fold in the almond meal, lemon zest and cinnamon.
Pour into the tin and bake for 35 minutes, until golden and a skewer comes out clean. Cool and dust with icing sugar.

notes: Dessert.
Gluten-free and vegetarian.

title: Torrijas
summary: Spanish-style sweet fried bread soaked in cinnamon milk, caramelised in a pan.

steps.text: Warm the milk, cinnamon stick and 2 tbsp sugar in a pan until steaming, then pour into a shallow dish and cool a little.
Dip each slice of bread briefly into the milk, then into the beaten eggs.
Fry in the oil over medium heat for 3 minutes each side, until deeply golden.
Dust with the remaining sugar and ground cinnamon and serve warm.

notes: Vegetarian.

title: Marinated Olives with Orange and Rosemary
summary: Green olives steeped in olive oil, orange peel, garlic and chilli.

steps.text: Lightly crush the olives with the flat of a knife.
Stir in the oil, orange peel, garlic, rosemary and chilli flakes.
Cover and marinate until the flavours have mingled. Serve at room temperature.

notes: Plus 4 hours marinating.
Vegan and gluten-free. Keeps 1 week in the fridge.

title: Koulourakia Butter Twists
summary: Greek orange-scented butter biscuits twisted into little braids.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan) and line two trays.
Beat the butter and sugar until pale, then beat in 1 egg and the orange zest. Stir in the flour and baking powder to a soft dough.
Roll pieces of dough into 15cm ropes, fold in half and twist.
Brush with the second beaten egg, scatter with sesame seeds and bake for 18 minutes, until golden.

notes: Dessert.
Vegetarian.

title: Kourabiedes Almond Shortbread
summary: Buttery almond biscuits piled with a snowy coating of icing sugar.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 170°C (150°C fan) and line two trays.
Beat the butter and 1/3 cup icing sugar until very pale, about 6 minutes, then beat in the yolk and vanilla.
Stir in the flour and almond meal. Roll into balls or crescents, set on the trays and bake for 20 minutes, until pale golden.
Cool for 5 minutes, then roll in the remaining icing sugar.

notes: Dessert.
Vegetarian.

title: Smoky Baba Ganoush
summary: Charred eggplant blended with tahini, lemon and garlic into a silky dip.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 240°C (220°C fan). Prick the eggplants and roast them for 40 minutes, turning once, until the skin is blackened and the flesh collapses.
Scoop the flesh into a colander and drain for 10 minutes, then mash with the tahini, lemon juice, garlic, cumin and salt.
Spoon into a bowl, swirl with olive oil and scatter with parsley.

notes: Vegan and gluten-free.

title: Tahini Sesame Cookies
summary: Nutty, crumbly cookies made with tahini and rolled in sesame seeds.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan) and line a tray.
Whisk the tahini, maple syrup, sugar, egg and vanilla until smooth, then stir in the flour and baking powder.
Roll tablespoons of the dough in the sesame seeds, set them on the tray and flatten slightly.
Bake for 12 minutes, until golden at the edges. Cool on the tray.

notes: Dessert.
Vegetarian.

title: Cardamom Rice Pudding
summary: Creamy rice cooked slowly in milk with cardamom and rose water.

steps.text: Simmer the rice, milk, sugar and cardamom in a heavy saucepan over low heat for 40 minutes, stirring often, until the rice is very soft and the pudding is thick.
Take the pan off the heat and stir in the rose water, tasting for sweetness.
Pour into bowls and top with pistachios. Serve warm or chilled.

notes: Dessert.
Vegetarian and gluten-free.
Food safety: cool leftovers quickly and refrigerate within an hour.

title: Chermoula Roasted Chickpeas
summary: Crunchy chickpeas roasted with herby, garlicky Moroccan spice.

items.raw: 800g tinned chickpeas, drained and patted dry

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the chickpeas with 1 tbsp oil, the cumin, paprika, ground coriander and salt on a lined tray.
Roast for 30 minutes, shaking the tray halfway, until crisp and golden.
Stir the garlic, lemon juice, fresh coriander and remaining oil together and toss through the hot chickpeas.

notes: Vegan and gluten-free.

title: Almond Briouats
summary: Crisp filo triangles filled with sweet orange-spiced almond paste and glazed with honey.

steps.text: Mix the almond meal, sugar, orange zest, cinnamon and softened butter into a firm paste.
Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Cut the filo into long strips, brush with melted butter and place a teaspoon of almond filling at one end.
Fold into triangles, working down the strip, and place seam-side down on a lined tray. Brush with butter.
Bake for 20 minutes, until golden and crisp. Brush with warm honey and scatter with sesame seeds.

notes: Dessert.
Keep unused filo covered with a damp cloth.
Vegetarian.

title: Golden Syrup Flapjacks
summary: Chewy oat flapjacks with a buttery, caramelised golden syrup edge.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 170°C (150°C fan) and line a 20cm square tin.
Melt the butter, sugar and golden syrup in a saucepan over low heat until smooth, then stir in the oats and salt.
Press firmly into the tin and bake for 25 minutes, until golden around the edges but still soft in the middle.
Cool completely in the tin before cutting into 12 pieces.

notes: Dessert.
Vegetarian.

title: Carrot Cake with Cream Cheese Frosting
summary: A spiced, moist carrot and walnut cake with tangy frosting.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 170°C (150°C fan) and line a 22cm tin.
Whisk the eggs, brown sugar and oil until smooth, then stir in the carrot. Fold in the flour, baking powder, cinnamon and walnuts.
Pour into the tin and bake for 45 minutes, until a skewer comes out clean. Cool completely.
Beat the cream cheese, butter and icing sugar until smooth and spread over the cake.

notes: Dessert.
Vegetarian.

title: Lemon Drizzle Loaf
summary: A zesty butter loaf with a crackly sugar-lemon topping.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 170°C (150°C fan) and line a loaf tin.
Beat the butter and caster sugar until pale, then beat in the eggs. Fold in the flour, milk and lemon zest.
Bake for 45 minutes, until golden and a skewer comes out clean.
Mix the lemon juice with the white sugar and spoon over the hot loaf. Cool in the tin so the topping sets crisp.

notes: Dessert.
Vegetarian.

title: Spiced Apple Crumble
summary: Soft cinnamon apples under a buttery, oaty crumble topping.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Toss the apple with 2 tbsp sugar, cinnamon and lemon juice and tip into a baking dish.
Rub the flour, oats, 1/2 cup sugar and butter together until crumbly.
Scatter the topping over the apple and bake for 40 minutes, until the top is golden and the apples are bubbling.

notes: Dessert.
Vegetarian.

title: Hot Cross Buns
summary: Soft spiced fruit buns marked with a flour cross and glazed with apricot jam.

steps.text: Mix the bread flour, yeast, sugar, spices and salt, then stir in the warm milk, butter and egg to a dough. Knead for 10 minutes, until elastic, and fold in the sultanas. Cover and rise until doubled.
Divide into 12 balls, set them close together in a lined tin and rise again until puffy.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Mix the plain flour with about 4 tbsp water into a paste and pipe crosses over the buns.
Bake for 20 minutes, until deep golden. Brush with warm jam while hot.

notes: Plus about 2 hours rising.
Vegetarian.

title: Apfelkuchen Sunken Apple Cake
summary: A tender German apple cake with apples pressed into the batter and a cinnamon crust.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan) and line a 24cm springform tin.
Beat the butter and caster sugar until pale, then beat in the eggs. Fold in the flour, baking powder and milk.
Spread the batter into the tin until level, press the apple slices into the surface and sprinkle with cinnamon and brown sugar.
Bake for 50 minutes, until golden and a skewer comes out clean.

notes: Dessert.
Vegetarian.

title: Pogácsa Cheese Scones
summary: Hungarian-style flaky cheddar scones with a cross-hatched top.

steps.text: Rub the butter into the flour, baking powder and salt until it resembles breadcrumbs, then stir in the cheese.
Mix in the sour cream and the whole egg to a soft dough, fold it over itself three times, then wrap and chill.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Roll the dough out 2cm thick, score a crosshatch pattern on top and cut 5cm rounds.
Brush with the egg yolk and bake for 22 minutes, until puffed and deep golden.

notes: Plus 30 minutes chilling.
Vegetarian.

title: Ginger Crunch Slice
summary: A crisp, buttery ginger base topped with a sticky ginger icing.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan) and line a 20cm square tin.
Mix the melted butter, caster sugar, flour, coconut, 2 tsp ginger and baking powder and press into the tin.
Bake for 25 minutes, until golden.
Melt 60g butter with the golden syrup, then stir in the icing sugar and 2 tsp ginger until smooth. Spread over the hot base, cool and cut into pieces.

notes: Dessert.
Vegetarian.

title: Snickerdoodle Cookies
summary: Soft cinnamon-sugar cookies with a slightly tangy, chewy centre.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan) and line two trays.
Beat the butter and 3/4 cup sugar until creamy, then beat in the egg and vanilla. Stir in the flour and bicarbonate of soda.
Mix the remaining sugar with the cinnamon, roll tablespoons of dough into balls and coat in the cinnamon sugar.
Bake for 10 minutes, until set at the edges but still soft in the centre.

notes: Dessert.
Vegetarian.

title: Pecan Pie Bars
summary: A buttery shortbread base with a gooey maple pecan topping.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan) and line a 20cm square tin.
Rub the flour, icing sugar and cold butter together until it clumps, press into the tin and bake for 15 minutes, until pale gold.
Whisk the eggs, brown sugar, maple syrup, melted butter and vanilla, then stir in the pecans and pour over the base.
Bake for 25 minutes more, until the filling is set with a slight wobble. Cool completely before cutting.

notes: Dessert.
Vegetarian.

title: Mexican Hot Chocolate Pots
summary: Rich chocolate pots spiced with cinnamon and a pinch of chilli.

steps.text: Heat the cream, milk, cinnamon and cayenne until just steaming, then pour over the chocolate and stir until smooth.
Whisk the yolks and sugar together, then slowly whisk in the warm chocolate mixture.
Return to the pan and stir over low heat for 5 minutes, until thick and reaching 75°C. Pour into six cups and chill until set.

notes: Dessert.
Plus 4 hours chilling.
Food safety: heat the egg mixture to 75°C so the yolks are cooked.
Gluten-free and vegetarian.

title: Pecan Wedding Cookies
summary: Melt-in-the-mouth buttery pecan cookies rolled in icing sugar.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 170°C (150°C fan) and line two trays.
Beat the butter, 1/2 cup icing sugar and vanilla until pale, then stir in the flour and pecans.
Roll into 24 balls, set on the trays and bake for 15 minutes, until pale gold on the bottom.
Cool for 5 minutes, then roll in the remaining icing sugar.

notes: Dessert.
Vegetarian.

title: Coconut Quindim
summary: Glossy Brazilian coconut custards, baked upside down so the coconut forms a golden crown.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 170°C (150°C fan) and butter six ramekins with extra butter.
Whisk the yolks gently with the sugar, then stir in the coconut, melted butter and coconut milk. Rest for 10 minutes.
Fill the ramekins, set them in a roasting dish and pour in hot water to halfway up the sides.
Bake for 40 minutes, until set and the custard reaches 75°C. Cool, then turn out.

notes: Dessert.
Food safety: bake until the custard is set and reaches 75°C.
Gluten-free and vegetarian.

title: Spiced Sweet Potato Pudding
summary: A dense, creamy Caribbean sweet potato pudding with coconut and warm spices.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan) and grease a 20cm baking dish.
Mix the sweet potato, coconut milk, sugar, spices, vanilla, raisins, flour and egg until combined.
Pour into the dish and bake for 50 minutes, until firm, dark at the edges and a skewer comes out clean. Cool before slicing.

notes: Dessert.
Vegetarian.

title: Cinnamon Baked Plantain
summary: Sweet, soft plantain halves roasted with butter, cinnamon and brown sugar.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan).
Toss the plantain with the coconut oil, sugar, cinnamon and salt on a lined tray.
Roast for 25 minutes, turning once, until golden and caramelised at the edges. Squeeze over the lime juice.

notes: Vegan and gluten-free. Use very ripe plantain with black skin for the sweetest result.

title: Salami, Mozzarella and Rocket Panini
summary: A pressed panini with salty salami, melted mozzarella and peppery rocket.

steps.text: Spread the pesto on the bread, then layer the salami, mozzarella and rocket between two slices each.
Brush the outsides with olive oil.
Press in a hot frying pan for 4 minutes each side, until golden and the cheese has melted.

notes: Salami is cured and ready to eat.

title: Sun-Dried Tomato Pasta Salad
summary: A chilled pasta salad with olives, capers and a punchy red wine dressing.

steps.text: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water for 12 minutes, until al dente, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Toss with the sun-dried tomato, olives, capers, rocket and basil.
Whisk the oil and vinegar and toss through. Season to taste and chill until needed.

notes: Vegan.

title: Lyonnaise Salad with Bacon and Poached Egg
summary: Crisp bacon, a runny egg and a mustardy dressing over frisée-style salad leaves.

steps.text: Fry the bacon in a dry frying pan over medium heat for 8 minutes, until crisp, and set aside, saving 1 tbsp of the fat.
Cube the bread and fry in the oil until golden, about 5 minutes, to make croutons.
Whisk the bacon fat, mustard and vinegar and toss through the salad leaves.
Poach the eggs in barely simmering water for 3 minutes, until the whites are set. Top the salad with bacon, croutons and eggs.

notes: Food safety: poached eggs have a runny yolk; cook until the whites are fully set and skip the runny yolk for anyone pregnant, elderly or immunocompromised.
Bacon should be cooked until crisp and browned.

title: French Lentil Salad with Goat Cheese
summary: Peppery lentils in a Dijon vinaigrette with crumbled goat cheese and herbs.

steps.text: Simmer the lentils with the carrot and bay leaf in plenty of water for 25 minutes, until tender but still holding their shape. Drain and discard the bay.
Whisk the oil, mustard and vinegar and toss through the warm lentils.
Fold in the parsley and onion and top with goat cheese once cooled.

notes: Vegetarian and gluten-free.

title: Chorizo and Manchego Bocadillo
summary: A crusty bread roll filled with seared chorizo, roasted capsicum and manchego.

steps.text: Fry the chorizo in a dry pan over medium heat for 5 minutes, until browned at the edges and the fat runs.
Split and toast the rolls until golden, then drizzle with olive oil.
Fill with the chorizo, capsicum, manchego and rocket.

notes: Chorizo is cured; cook until hot and sizzling.

title: Lemon Chickpea Salad with Oregano
summary: A quick chickpea salad with cucumber, tomato, red onion and olives.

steps.text: Combine the chickpeas, cucumber, tomato, onion and olives in a large bowl.
Whisk the oil, lemon juice and oregano and toss through until everything is coated.
Top with the feta and serve at room temperature.

notes: Vegetarian and gluten-free. Leave out the feta and it is vegan.

title: Halloumi and Roast Vegetable Wraps
summary: Warm wraps stuffed with golden halloumi, roasted capsicum and zucchini, and tzatziki.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the zucchini, capsicum and onion with the oil and oregano and roast for 25 minutes, until tender and charred at the edges.
Fry the halloumi in a dry non-stick pan for 2 minutes each side, until golden.
Warm the flatbreads, spread with tzatziki and fill with the vegetables and halloumi.

notes: Vegetarian.

title: Chickpea Shawarma Wraps
summary: Spiced, crisp-roasted chickpeas in flatbread with tahini and pickles.

items.raw: 800g tinned chickpeas, drained and patted dry

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the chickpeas with the oil and spices on a tray and roast for 25 minutes, until crisp.
Whisk the tahini, lemon juice and 3 tbsp water into a pourable sauce.
Warm the flatbreads and fill with the chickpeas, cucumber, pickled turnip and tahini sauce.

notes: Vegan.

title: Apricot Almond Couscous Salad
summary: Fluffy couscous with dried apricots, toasted almonds, herbs and a lemon-cumin dressing.

steps.text: Put the couscous in a bowl, pour over the boiling water, cover and stand for 5 minutes, until the water is absorbed. Fluff with a fork.
Toast the almonds in a dry frying pan for 4 minutes, until golden.
Toss the couscous with the apricots, almonds, herbs, oil, lemon juice and cumin.

notes: Vegan.

title: Egg Mayo Sandwiches with Watercress
summary: Creamy egg mayonnaise on soft bread with peppery greens.

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, until fully set, then cool in cold water and peel.
Mash the eggs with the mayonnaise, mustard and chives.
Butter the bread and fill with the egg mixture and rocket.

notes: Food safety: boil the eggs until the yolks are firm and keep the filling chilled; eat within 24 hours.
Vegetarian.

title: Pea and Ham Soup
summary: A thick, savoury soup of split peas and smoky ham.

steps.text: Cook the onion, carrot and celery in the oil for 8 minutes, until soft.
Add the ham, peas, stock and bay leaf and simmer for 50 minutes, until the peas have broken down and the soup is thick.
Remove the bay leaf and stir well. Serve hot.

notes: Food safety: ham is cooked; make sure the soup is steaming hot throughout before serving.

title: Cheese and Onion Toastie
summary: Sharp cheddar and soft, caramelised red onion in a crisp toastie.

steps.text: Cook the onion in 1 tbsp butter in a frying pan over low heat for 10 minutes, until soft and golden, then add the balsamic and cook for 1 minute more.
Spread the onion over two slices of bread, top with the cheddar and the other slices and butter the outsides.
Cook in a frying pan over medium heat for 4 minutes each side, until golden and melted.

notes: Vegetarian.

title: Currywurst with Potato Wedges
summary: Sliced sausage in a curried tomato sauce, Berlin-style, with crisp potato wedges.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the potato with 1 tbsp oil and roast for 30 minutes, turning once, until golden and crisp.
Brown the bratwurst in a frying pan for 12 minutes, turning, until cooked and the centre reaches 75°C. Slice.
Cook the onion in the remaining oil for 5 minutes, then add the tomato paste, tomato sauce, curry powder, paprika, sugar and 1/2 cup water and simmer for 8 minutes, until thick.
Pour the sauce over the sliced sausage and serve with the wedges.

notes: Food safety: sausages must reach 75°C in the centre with no pink inside.

title: Zwiebelkuchen Onion Tart
summary: A Southern German savoury onion and bacon tart with a creamy egg custard.

steps.text: Cook the bacon in the oil in a frying pan for 6 minutes, until crisp. Add the onion and cook over low heat for 15 minutes, until soft and golden.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and line a 24cm tart tin with the pastry. Prick the base.
Whisk the eggs, sour cream, caraway and salt, stir in the onion mixture and pour into the case.
Bake for 40 minutes, until set in the centre and golden.

notes: Food safety: the egg custard must be fully set in the centre; bacon should be cooked until crisp.

title: Beetroot Burgers with Tzatziki
summary: Ruby beetroot and bean patties on toasted buns with cool tzatziki.

steps.text: Mash the beans roughly and mix with the beetroot, oats, egg, cumin and garlic. Shape into 4 patties and chill for 15 minutes.
Fry in the oil over medium heat for 5 minutes each side, until crisp and heated through.
Toast the buns until golden and build with tzatziki, lettuce and a patty.

notes: Vegetarian.

title: Prawn Cocktail Rolls
summary: Plump cold prawns in a tangy pink sauce piled in soft rolls.

steps.text: Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, Worcestershire sauce and lemon juice into a pink sauce.
Fold the prawns through the sauce until coated.
Split the rolls, add the lettuce and fill with the prawn mix. Top with chives.

notes: Food safety: use fully cooked prawns that have been kept below 5°C, and eat within a day.

title: Classic Tuna Salad Sandwiches
summary: Creamy tuna, celery and lemon on soft bread with crisp lettuce.

steps.text: Mix the tuna, mayonnaise, celery, lemon juice and pickle until creamy.
Pile onto two slices of bread.
Top with the lettuce and the remaining slices and cut in half.

notes: Food safety: keep the tuna mixture chilled and eat it within 24 hours; tinned tuna is already cooked.

title: Waldorf Salad with Apple and Walnuts
summary: Crisp apple, celery and grapes in a creamy yoghurt dressing with walnuts.

steps.text: Toss the apple with the lemon juice so it stays crisp.
Whisk the mayonnaise and yoghurt, then fold through the apple, celery and walnuts until coated.
Serve piled on the lettuce.

notes: Vegetarian and gluten-free.

title: Smoky Black Bean Jacket Sweet Potatoes
summary: Baked sweet potatoes topped with spiced black beans, avocado and lime.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Prick the sweet potatoes and bake for 50 minutes, until very soft.
Warm the beans with the cumin, paprika and half the lime juice in a saucepan until steaming, about 5 minutes.
Split the potatoes and top with the beans, avocado, salsa, coriander and remaining lime juice.

notes: Vegan and gluten-free.

title: Bean and Cheese Burritos
summary: Warm tortillas wrapped around refried-style beans, rice and melted cheese.

steps.text: Mash the beans roughly with the cumin in a saucepan over low heat until hot and thick, about 5 minutes.
Warm the tortillas, then fill with the rice, beans, cheddar, salsa, sour cream and coriander.
Fold in the sides, roll up tightly and toast in a dry pan for 2 minutes each side, until golden.

notes: Vegetarian.
Food safety: cool and refrigerate cooked rice within an hour if making ahead.

title: Avocado and Black Bean Tostadas
summary: Crisp corn tortillas piled with mashed black beans, avocado and quick-pickled onion.

steps.text: Soak the onion in the lime juice for 10 minutes.
Brush the tortillas with oil and bake at 200°C (180°C fan) for 10 minutes, until crisp.
Warm the beans with the cumin and mash roughly. Spread over the tortillas, top with avocado, pickled onion and coriander.

notes: Vegan and gluten-free.

title: Cuban Sandwich
summary: Pressed pork, ham, swiss cheese, pickles and mustard in crusty bread.

steps.text: Split the rolls and spread with mustard. Layer with the pork, ham, cheese and pickles.
Butter the outsides of the rolls.
Press in a hot frying pan with a weighted plate for 4 minutes each side, until crisp and the cheese has melted and the filling is steaming hot.

notes: Food safety: reheat cooked roast pork until steaming hot, 75°C in the middle.

title: Jerk Chickpea Wraps
summary: Spiced chickpeas with a jerk-style rub, crunchy slaw and lime in flatbread.

items.raw: 800g tinned chickpeas, drained and patted dry

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the chickpeas with the oil, allspice, thyme, garlic powder, cayenne and salt and roast for 20 minutes, until crisp.
Warm the tortillas and fill with the chickpeas and coleslaw.
Squeeze over the lime juice and roll up.

notes: Vegan: check that the coleslaw dressing is egg-free.

title: Baked Lemon Ricotta Pasta
summary: Creamy lemon-ricotta pasta baked with mozzarella until bubbling.

steps.text: Cook the penne in salted boiling water for 8 minutes, until just short of tender, and drain.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Mix the ricotta, lemon zest and juice, garlic, egg and basil, then toss with the pasta.
Tip into a baking dish, top with the mozzarella and drizzle with oil.
Bake for 25 minutes, until golden and bubbling.

notes: Vegetarian.

title: Slow-Braised Beef Shin Ragu
summary: Fall-apart beef shin in a rich red wine and tomato sauce, served over pappardelle.

items.raw: 1kg beef shin, cut into large chunks

steps.text: Season the beef and brown in the oil in a large heavy pot over high heat for 10 minutes, until deeply coloured on all sides. Set aside.
Cook the onion, carrot and celery in the same pot for 8 minutes, until soft, then add the garlic and tomato paste for 2 minutes.
Add the wine and boil for 3 minutes, then add the tomatoes, rosemary and beef. Cover and simmer gently, or bake at 150°C, for 3 hours, until the beef falls apart.
Shred the beef into the sauce and toss through the cooked pappardelle.

notes: Food safety: beef shin needs long cooking; it is safe and tender when it shreds easily and the sauce is steaming hot (above 75°C).

title: Gnocchi with Sage Burnt Butter
summary: Pillowy potato gnocchi in nutty browned butter with crisp sage and walnuts.

steps.text: Cook the gnocchi in salted boiling water for 3 minutes, until they float, and drain.
Melt the butter in a large frying pan over medium heat and cook the sage for 3 minutes, until the butter smells nutty and turns golden-brown.
Add the gnocchi and walnuts and toss for 3 minutes, until the gnocchi are golden at the edges. Finish with lemon zest.

notes: Vegetarian.

title: Cod Livornese
summary: Flaky white fish baked in a tomato, olive and caper sauce.

steps.text: Cook the onion in the oil in a large ovenproof frying pan for 6 minutes, until soft, then add the garlic and chilli for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, olives and capers and simmer for 8 minutes, until thickened.
Nestle in the fish, spoon over the sauce and bake at 200°C (180°C fan) for 10 minutes, until the fish is opaque and flakes easily. Scatter with the parsley.

notes: Food safety: fish is done when it is opaque and flakes easily, about 63°C in the centre.
Gluten-free and dairy-free.

title: Italian Sausage and White Bean Pan
summary: Browned sausage and creamy cannellini beans in a garlicky tomato sauce, high in protein.

steps.text: Brown the sausages in the oil in a large deep frying pan over medium heat for 10 minutes, until the centre reaches 75°C. Slice.
Cook the onion in the same pan for 5 minutes, until soft, then add the garlic and oregano for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and beans and simmer for 8 minutes, until thick, then stir in the kale until wilted and return the sausage.

notes: Food safety: pork sausages must reach 75°C in the centre with no pink inside.
Gluten-free and dairy-free if the sausages contain no fillers.

title: Tarragon Chicken in White Wine Cream
summary: Seared chicken thighs in a silky tarragon and white wine sauce.

steps.text: Season the chicken and sear in the butter and oil in a deep pan over medium-high heat for 5 minutes each side, until golden. Set aside.
Cook the shallots in the pan for 3 minutes, then add the wine and boil for 2 minutes, scraping up the browned bits.
Add the stock, mustard and chicken, cover and simmer for 15 minutes, until the chicken reaches 75°C in the centre.
Stir in the cream and tarragon and simmer for 3 minutes, until slightly thickened.

notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C with the juices running clear.
Gluten-free.

title: Salmon with Dijon Lentils
summary: Pan-seared salmon over mustardy French lentils, high in protein and fibre.

steps.text: Simmer the lentils with the carrot and bay leaf in plenty of water for 25 minutes, until tender, then drain.
Whisk 1 tbsp oil with the mustard and vinegar and stir through the lentils with the parsley.
Season the salmon and cook skin-side down in the remaining oil over medium-high heat for 4 minutes, then flip and cook for 2 minutes, until opaque and flaking.
Serve the salmon on the lentils with lemon.

notes: Food safety: cook salmon until it flakes easily and is opaque, about 63°C in the centre.
Gluten-free and dairy-free.

title: Sausage and White Bean Cassoulet
summary: A slow-baked French bean casserole with sausage, bacon and a crisp breadcrumb crust.

steps.text: Brown the sausages in the oil in a large ovenproof pot for 10 minutes, until the centre reaches 75°C. Slice and set aside.
Cook the bacon, onion, garlic and carrot in the same pot for 10 minutes, until soft.
Add the beans, tomatoes, stock, thyme, bay leaf and sausage. Cover and bake at 160°C (140°C fan) for 90 minutes.
Scatter with breadcrumbs and bake uncovered for 30 minutes, until the top is crisp and golden.

notes: Food safety: pork sausages must reach 75°C in the centre with no pink inside.

title: Lentil and Chorizo Stew
summary: A hearty Spanish stew of lentils, smoky chorizo and potato.

steps.text: Fry the chorizo in the oil in a large pot over medium heat for 5 minutes, until crisp and the fat runs.
Add the onion and carrot and cook for 6 minutes, until soft, then the garlic and paprika for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, potato, stock and bay leaf and simmer for 30 minutes, until the lentils and potato are tender and the stew is thick.

notes: Gluten-free and dairy-free.

title: White Fish with Romesco Sauce
summary: Roasted fish fillets under a smoky red capsicum and almond romesco.

steps.text: Blitz the capsicum, almonds, garlic, vinegar, paprika and salt, streaming in the 1/4 cup oil until a thick, rough sauce forms.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Rub the fish with the 1 tbsp oil, season and bake on a lined tray for 12 minutes, until opaque and flaking.
Spoon the romesco over the fish.

notes: Food safety: fish is cooked when opaque and flaking, about 63°C in the centre.
Gluten-free and dairy-free.

title: Greek Lamb Keftedes with Lemon Potatoes
summary: Herby lamb meatballs baked with lemon potatoes and oregano.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Toss the potato with 2 tbsp oil, the lemon juice, half the oregano and 1/2 cup water in a roasting dish.
Roast for 20 minutes. Meanwhile mix the lamb, onion, egg, breadcrumbs, mint and remaining oregano and roll into 16 balls.
Nestle the meatballs among the potatoes, drizzle with the last of the oil and roast for 25 minutes, until the potatoes are golden and the meatballs reach 75°C in the centre. Serve with the tzatziki.

notes: Food safety: lamb mince must reach 75°C right through with no pink inside.

title: Giouvetsi Chicken and Orzo
summary: Chicken baked with orzo in a rich tomato and cinnamon sauce, all in one dish.

steps.text: Brown the chicken in the oil in a large ovenproof pan over medium-high heat for 8 minutes, until golden. Set aside.
Cook the onion for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, tomatoes, cinnamon and stock and bring to a simmer.
Return the chicken, add the orzo, cover and bake at 180°C (160°C fan) for 40 minutes, until the orzo is tender and the chicken reaches 75°C.
Top with the feta and serve.

notes: Food safety: bone-in chicken must reach 75°C at the thickest part, away from the bone.

title: Papoutsakia (Little Shoes)
summary: Eggplant halves baked with a spiced beef and tomato filling, topped with a golden béchamel.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Brush the eggplant with 2 tbsp oil and roast cut-side down for 25 minutes, until soft. Scoop out some flesh to make boats.
Cook the onion and mince in the remaining oil for 10 minutes, until browned and cooked through, then add the garlic, tomatoes, cinnamon, oregano and scooped flesh and simmer for 10 minutes.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the milk until the sauce thickens. Stir in half the cheese.
Fill the eggplant with the beef, top with the sauce and remaining cheese and bake for 25 minutes, until golden.

notes: Food safety: beef mince must reach 75°C right through with no pink inside.

title: Sumac Chicken Traybake with Flatbread
summary: Sumac and lemon-rubbed chicken roasted with onions, then piled on flatbread with yoghurt.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the chicken and onions with the oil, sumac, cumin and lemon juice on a large tray.
Roast for 40 minutes, until the chicken is deep golden and reaches 75°C in the centre.
Warm the flatbreads and serve the chicken and onions on top with yoghurt and parsley.

notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C with the juices running clear.

title: Lentil and Rice Stuffed Eggplant
summary: Roasted eggplant boats filled with spiced lentils, rice and pine nuts.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Score the eggplant flesh, brush with 2 tbsp oil and roast cut-side up for 30 minutes, until soft.
Simmer the lentils in water for 15 minutes, until tender, then drain. Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes and drain.
Cook the onion in the remaining oil for 8 minutes, add the spices and pine nuts and cook until the nuts are golden, then stir in the lentils, rice and parsley.
Mash down the middle of each eggplant, pile in the filling and bake for 15 minutes more. Serve with tahini sauce.

notes: Vegan. Food safety: cool and refrigerate leftover rice within an hour.

title: Harissa Chicken with Herbed Couscous
summary: Spicy harissa-glazed chicken thighs with lemony couscous.

steps.text: Mix the harissa, 1 tbsp oil and half the lemon juice and rub over the chicken.
Roast at 220°C (200°C fan) for 30 minutes, until charred and the chicken reaches 75°C in the centre.
Pour the boiling water over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes until absorbed, then fluff and stir through the herbs, remaining oil and lemon juice.
Serve the chicken over the couscous with yoghurt.

notes: Plus 30 minutes marinating, if you have time.
Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C with no pink meat.

title: Apricot and Chickpea Vegetable Tagine
summary: A fragrant vegan tagine of sweet potato, chickpeas and apricots with warm spices.

steps.text: Cook the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, until soft. Add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the sweet potato, tomatoes, chickpeas, apricots and 1 cup water, cover and simmer for 30 minutes, until the sweet potato is tender and the sauce thick.
Toast the almonds in a dry pan until golden, about 3 minutes.
Serve topped with almonds and coriander.

notes: Vegan and gluten-free.

title: Cauliflower Cheese
summary: Tender cauliflower in a creamy mustard cheddar sauce, baked until bubbling.

steps.text: Boil the cauliflower in salted water for 6 minutes, until just tender, and drain well.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the milk until the sauce thickens. Stir in the mustard, nutmeg and 1 cup of the cheddar.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Arrange the cauliflower in a baking dish, pour over the sauce, and top with the breadcrumbs and remaining cheese.
Bake for 25 minutes, until golden and bubbling.

notes: Vegetarian.

title: White Fish and Potato Fishcakes
summary: Crisp golden fishcakes of flaked fish, mash and parsley with a lemon mayo.

steps.text: Poach the fish in simmering water for 8 minutes, until opaque and flaking, then drain and flake. Boil the potato for 15 minutes, until tender, then mash.
Mix the fish, mash, parsley and half the egg-beaten mixture into 8 patties, then dip in the rest of the egg and the breadcrumbs.
Fry in the oil over medium heat for 4 minutes each side, until golden and heated through.
Stir the lemon juice into the mayonnaise and serve with the cakes.

notes: Food safety: fish should be opaque and flake easily, about 63°C; chill the patties before frying if time allows.

title: Mushroom and Ale Pie
summary: A rich vegan mushroom filling in a stout gravy, topped with puff pastry.

steps.text: Cook the mushrooms in the oil in a large pot over high heat for 12 minutes, until browned and the liquid has gone. Add the onion for 5 minutes, then the garlic and flour for 1 minute.
Add the beer, stock, soy sauce and thyme and simmer for 20 minutes, until thick. Cool slightly and tip into a pie dish.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Top with the pastry, trim, cut a vent in the centre and bake for 30 minutes, until puffed and deep golden.

notes: Vegan.

title: Spätzle with Creamy Mushrooms
summary: Soft homemade egg noodles tossed in a garlicky mushroom cream sauce.

steps.text: Beat the flour, eggs, milk, salt and nutmeg to a thick, elastic batter and rest for 15 minutes.
Press the batter through a colander or spätzle press into a pan of simmering salted water and cook for 2 minutes, until the noodles float. Lift out and drain.
Melt the butter in a large frying pan and cook the mushrooms for 8 minutes, until golden. Add the garlic for 1 minute and the cream until simmering.
Toss in the spätzle and heat for 2 minutes, then scatter with parsley.

notes: Vegetarian.

title: Sauerbraten with Sweet-Sour Gravy
summary: Beef marinated for days in vinegar and spices, then braised until tender in a sweet-sour gravy.

steps.text: Combine the vinegar, water, onion, carrot, bay leaves, cloves and pepper in a bowl, add the beef, cover and marinate in the fridge.
Lift the beef out, dry well and brown in the oil in a heavy pot over high heat for 10 minutes, until deeply coloured. Strain the marinade.
Return the beef to the pot with the strained marinade and sugar, cover and braise at 160°C (140°C fan) for 3 hours, until fork-tender.
Whisk the flour with a little cold water, stir into the juices and simmer for 5 minutes, until a glossy gravy forms. Slice the beef and serve.

notes: Plus 2 days marinating.
Food safety: braised beef is safe when fork-tender; the gravy should be steaming hot, above 75°C.

title: Roast Lamb Leg with Rosemary and Garlic
summary: A classic Sunday roast leg of lamb with garlic and rosemary, and crisp roast potatoes.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Make small cuts in the lamb and push in the garlic and rosemary. Rub with 1 tbsp oil, the lemon zest and salt.
Roast the lamb for 20 minutes, then reduce to 180°C (160°C fan). Add the potato tossed in the remaining oil around the lamb.
Roast for 70 minutes more, until the lamb reaches 63°C in the thickest part for medium, or 70°C for well done, and the potatoes are crisp.
Rest the lamb under foil for 15 minutes before carving.

notes: Food safety: lamb leg is safe at 63°C in the thickest part, after a 3-minute rest; use a thermometer.
Gluten-free and dairy-free.

title: Honey Soy Chicken Drumsticks
summary: Sticky, glossy baked drumsticks with a honey, soy and ginger glaze.

steps.text: Mix the soy sauce, honey, garlic, ginger and sesame oil and coat the drumsticks. Marinate.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Roast the drumsticks on a lined tray for 45 minutes, turning and basting twice, until sticky and the thickest part reaches 75°C.
Scatter with spring onion and sesame seeds.

notes: Plus 1 hour marinating.
Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C at the thickest part, with the juices running clear.

title: Chilli Garlic Prawn Spaghetti
summary: Spaghetti tossed with juicy prawns, garlic, chilli and lemon.

steps.text: Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water for 10 minutes, until al dente, saving 1/2 cup of the water, then drain.
Warm the oil, garlic and chilli in a large frying pan for 2 minutes, until fragrant. Add the prawns and cook for 3 minutes, until pink and opaque.
Add the wine and lemon juice and simmer for 2 minutes, then toss in the pasta, a splash of pasta water, the zest and parsley until glossy.

notes: Food safety: prawns are cooked when pink and opaque all the way through, about 63°C.

title: Sweet Chilli Salmon Tray Bake
summary: Salmon and green vegetables roasted on one tray with a sweet chilli glaze.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Toss the broccolini and beans with the oil on a large tray and roast for 8 minutes.
Add the salmon, brush with the sweet chilli sauce and soy sauce and roast for 10 minutes, until the salmon is opaque and flakes easily.
Squeeze over the lime juice and scatter with sesame seeds.

notes: Food safety: salmon is done when opaque and flaking, about 63°C in the centre.
Dairy-free.

title: Turkey and Bean Chilli
summary: A lean, high-protein chilli with turkey mince, beans and smoky spices.

steps.text: Brown the turkey in the oil in a large pot over high heat for 8 minutes, breaking it up, until cooked through. Add the onion and capsicum and cook for 6 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin and paprika for 1 minute, then the tomatoes, beans and stock.
Simmer for 30 minutes, until thick and rich.

notes: Food safety: turkey mince must reach 75°C right through with no pink inside.
Gluten-free and dairy-free.

title: Maple Mustard Salmon with Green Beans
summary: Salmon glazed with maple syrup and wholegrain mustard, served on garlicky beans.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Mix the maple syrup, mustard and soy sauce and brush over the salmon on a lined tray.
Roast for 12 minutes, until the salmon is opaque and flakes easily.
Meanwhile fry the beans in the oil for 6 minutes, until tender-crisp, adding the garlic for the last minute. Serve with the salmon.

notes: Food safety: salmon is cooked when opaque and flaking, about 63°C in the centre.
Dairy-free.

title: Smoky Lentil Joes
summary: Saucy, smoky brown lentils in soft buns, a vegan take on the classic.

steps.text: Simmer the lentils in plenty of water for 25 minutes, until tender, and drain.
Cook the onion and capsicum in the oil for 6 minutes, until soft, then add the garlic and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Stir in the passata, barbecue sauce, paprika and lentils and simmer for 10 minutes, until thick and glossy.
Toast the buns until golden and fill with the lentil mix.

notes: Vegan.

title: Creamy Tomato Tortellini Soup
summary: A velvety tomato soup with plump cheese tortellini and basil.

steps.text: Cook the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, until soft, then add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and stock, simmer for 10 minutes, then blend until smooth.
Return to the pot, stir in the cream and tortellini and simmer for 4 minutes, until the pasta floats and is tender. Top with the basil.

notes: Vegetarian: check the pasta filling for a vegetarian hard cheese.

title: Chipotle Mushroom Tacos
summary: Smoky pulled-style mushrooms in warm tortillas with lime slaw.

steps.text: Cook the mushrooms in the oil in a large frying pan over high heat for 10 minutes, until deeply browned and the liquid has gone.
Stir in the chipotle, cumin and garlic and cook for 2 minutes more, until sticky.
Toss the cabbage with the lime juice. Warm the tortillas and fill with the mushrooms, slaw, avocado and coriander.

notes: Vegan and gluten-free.

title: Chile Verde Pork Stew
summary: Tender pork shoulder simmered in a tangy green chilli and tomatillo-style sauce.

steps.text: Brown the pork in the oil in a large pot in two batches, 8 minutes each, until golden. Set aside.
Cook the onion for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, chillies, cumin and oregano for 2 minutes.
Return the pork, add the stock, cover and simmer gently for 90 minutes, until the pork is tender enough to shred.
Stir in the lime juice and coriander and serve with rice or tortillas.

notes: Food safety: pork must reach at least 70°C and, for this braise, cook until tender and shreddable.
Gluten-free and dairy-free.

title: Pollo a la Brasa Peruvian Chicken
summary: Garlicky, cumin-rubbed roast chicken with crisp skin and a green sauce.

steps.text: Mix the garlic, soy sauce, oil, vinegar, cumin and paprika and rub all over the chicken, including under the skin. Marinate.
Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Roast the chicken for 70 minutes, basting once, until the skin is crisp and the thickest part of the thigh reaches 75°C.
Blend the coriander, jalapeño, mayonnaise and lime juice into a green sauce.
Rest the chicken for 10 minutes, carve and serve with the sauce.

notes: Plus 4 hours marinating.
Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part of the thigh, with clear juices.

title: Cuban-Style Black Beans
summary: Slow-simmered black beans with sofrito, cumin and a splash of vinegar.

steps.text: Cook the onion and capsicum in the oil for 8 minutes, until soft. Add the garlic, cumin and oregano for 1 minute.
Add the beans, stock and bay leaves and simmer for 25 minutes, mashing a few beans against the pot, until thick and creamy.
Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, and drain.
Stir the vinegar into the beans and serve over the rice.

notes: Vegan and gluten-free. Food safety: cool and refrigerate leftover rice within an hour.

title: Jerk Pork Fillet with Pineapple Salsa
summary: Spicy jerk-rubbed pork fillet with a sweet, fresh pineapple and lime salsa.

steps.text: Mix the oil, allspice, thyme, cinnamon, chilli, garlic and spring onion and rub over the pork. Marinate.
Sear the pork in a hot ovenproof pan for 8 minutes, turning, until browned, then roast at 200°C (180°C fan) for 15 minutes, until the centre reaches 70°C.
Rest for 5 minutes. Toss the pineapple with the lime juice and coriander and serve with the sliced pork.

notes: Plus 2 hours marinating.
Food safety: pork fillet should reach 70°C in the centre, then rest for 3 minutes.
Gluten-free and dairy-free.

title: Jerk Cauliflower Steaks
summary: Thick cauliflower steaks roasted with fiery jerk spices until charred and sweet.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Mix the oil, allspice, thyme, cayenne, garlic powder and salt and brush over the cauliflower on two trays.
Roast for 35 minutes, turning once, until deeply charred and tender.
Squeeze over the lime juice and scatter with coriander.

notes: Vegan and gluten-free.

title: Trinidad Coconut Chickpea Curry
summary: A creamy coconut chickpea curry with curry powder and thyme, served with rice.

steps.text: Cook the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, until soft. Add the garlic, ginger, curry powder and thyme for 1 minute.
Add the chickpeas, coconut milk, potato and 1 cup water and simmer for 20 minutes, until the potato is tender and the sauce is thick.
Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes and drain. Serve the curry over the rice with coriander.

notes: Vegan and gluten-free. Food safety: cool and refrigerate leftover rice within an hour.

title: Savoury Oat Porridge with Egg
summary: Creamy oats cooked in stock, topped with a fried egg, spring onion and chilli oil.

steps.text: Simmer the oats and stock in a saucepan for 8 minutes, stirring, until creamy.
Fry the eggs in the butter over medium heat for 3 minutes, until the whites are set.
Spoon the porridge into bowls, top with the eggs, spring onion, chilli oil and soy sauce.

notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set; skip runny yolks for anyone pregnant, elderly or immunocompromised. Keep any leftover garlic, herb or chilli oil in the fridge and use it within 4 days.

title: Chickpea Flour Socca with Herbs
summary: Crisp-edged chickpea pancakes from Nice, gluten-free and vegan.

steps.text: Whisk the chickpea flour, water, 1 tbsp oil, salt and pepper until smooth and rest for 30 minutes.
Heat the remaining oil in a 24cm frying pan over high heat and pour in half the batter.
Cook for 3 minutes, until the edges crisp and the top is set, then flip and cook for 2 minutes more. Repeat with the remaining batter.
Top with rosemary and tomato.

notes: Plus 30 minutes resting.
Vegan and gluten-free.

title: Spiced Apple Porridge with Walnuts
summary: Warm oat porridge cooked with grated apple, cinnamon and a spoonful of maple syrup.

steps.text: Simmer the oats, milk, apple, cinnamon and salt in a saucepan for 8 minutes, stirring, until thick and creamy.
Spoon the hot porridge into two warm bowls, dividing it evenly.
Top with the maple syrup and walnuts.

notes: Vegetarian. Use plant milk for a vegan version.

title: Pork Carnitas Tacos with Pickled Onion
summary: Pork shoulder braised until tender, crisped under the grill and piled into warm corn tortillas.

items.raw: 1kg pork shoulder, cut into big chunks

steps.text: Heat the oven to 160°C (140°C fan). Put the pork, orange juice, lime juice, garlic, cumin, oregano, bay leaves and salt in a lidded ovenproof pot with 1/2 cup water.
Cover and cook for 2 hours 30 minutes, until the pork shreds easily with a fork.
Shred the pork on a lined tray, spoon over some pot juices and grill for 6 minutes, until the edges crisp and brown.
Warm the tortillas in a dry frying pan for 30 seconds each side, until soft and flecked. Fill with pork, pickled onion and coriander and serve with lime.

notes: Food safety: pork shoulder is safe once it reaches 70°C inside, and this braise is cooked far past that when it shreds easily. Keep leftovers chilled within 2 hours.
Gluten-free: check the tortilla label.

title: Chicken in Chocolate Chilli Mole
summary: Chicken simmered in a deep, glossy mole of dried chilli, almonds, sesame, raisins and dark chocolate.

steps.text: Soak the chillies in hot water for 15 minutes, until soft, then drain. Toast the almonds and sesame seeds in a dry pan for 3 minutes, until golden.
Fry the onion and garlic in 1 tablespoon of oil for 6 minutes, until browned. Blend with the chillies, nuts, seeds, raisins, tomatoes, cinnamon, cloves, cumin and 1 cup of stock until very smooth.
Brown the chicken in the remaining oil in a wide pot for 8 minutes, until golden, then lift out. Pour the blended paste into the pot and fry for 8 minutes, stirring, until it darkens and thickens.
Stir in the chocolate and the remaining stock until melted, add the chicken, cover and simmer for 35 minutes, until the chicken reaches 75°C in the thickest part and the sauce coats a spoon.
Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, drain and serve with the chicken and mole.

notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part and the juices must run clear.
Dried chilli heat varies: taste the paste before adding chocolate.

title: Black Bean Enchiladas with Tasty Cheese
summary: Corn tortillas rolled around spiced black beans and cheese, baked under a smoky red sauce.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, until soft, then add the garlic and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the beans and corn and cook for 4 minutes, mashing about a third of the beans, until thick. Take off the heat and stir through half the cheese.
Spread 1/2 cup of enchilada sauce over the base of a baking dish. Warm the tortillas, fill each with the bean mix, roll up and lay seam-side down.
Pour over the remaining sauce, scatter with the remaining cheese and bake for 20 minutes, until bubbling and golden. Top with sour cream and coriander.

notes: Vegetarian.
Gluten-free: check the tortilla and sauce labels.

title: Huevos Divorciados
summary: Two fried eggs on crisp corn tortillas, one under red sauce and one under green, split by black beans.

steps.text: Warm the black beans in a small pan for 4 minutes, until hot and slightly mashed. Warm the red sauce and the salsa in two separate pans.
Fry the tortillas in a little oil for 1 minute each side, until crisp at the edges, and set two on each plate.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil for 3 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks still soft.
Top one egg with red sauce and one with salsa, spoon the beans down the middle and finish with avocado, coriander and lime.

notes: Food safety: serve eggs with set whites; cook the yolks through for young children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Vegetarian.

title: Chorizo and Potato Breakfast Hash
summary: Crisp potato and smoky chorizo with capsicum and eggs baked right in the pan.

steps.text: Boil the potato for 6 minutes, until just tender, then drain well.
Fry the chorizo in the oil in a large ovenproof frying pan for 4 minutes, until crisp and the oil runs red. Add the onion, capsicum and paprika and cook for 5 minutes, until soft.
Add the potato and cook for 8 minutes, turning only now and then, until golden and crisp.
Make four wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 4 minutes, until the whites are set. Top with coriander and avocado.

notes: Food safety: cook the whites until set and the chorizo until steaming hot; serve firm-yolked eggs to children or pregnant guests.
Gluten-free.

title: Camarones a la Diabla with Rice
summary: Prawns in a fiery chipotle and tomato sauce over fluffy rice.

steps.text: Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, and drain.
Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, until soft, then add the garlic and chipotle for 1 minute. Add the tomatoes and oregano and simmer for 8 minutes, until thick.
Blend the sauce until smooth and return it to the pan with the butter. Add the prawns and cook for 4 minutes, until they turn pink and opaque.
Stir through the lime juice and coriander and serve over the rice.

notes: Food safety: prawns are cooked when pink, curled and opaque all the way through; don't keep cooked prawns more than 2 days.
Gluten-free.

title: Mexican Beef and Rice Stuffed Capsicums
summary: Capsicums filled with spiced beef, rice and beans and baked with melted cheese.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, until soft, then add the garlic and mince and cook for 8 minutes, until browned.
Stir in the taco seasoning, tomatoes, rice and beans and simmer for 5 minutes, until thick.
Fill the capsicum halves, set them in a baking dish with 1/2 cup water and cover with foil.
Bake for 30 minutes, then uncover, scatter with cheese and bake for 15 minutes, until the capsicums are tender and the cheese is golden.

notes: Food safety: the mince filling must reach 75°C right through; cool leftover rice quickly and refrigerate within 1 hour.
Gluten-free: check the taco seasoning label.

title: Migas with Corn Chips and Eggs
summary: Soft scrambled eggs folded through crisp corn chips, tomato and jalapeno.

steps.text: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt in a bowl.
Melt the butter in a frying pan over medium heat, then cook the jalapeno, spring onion and tomato for 2 minutes, until softened.
Add the eggs and stir gently for 3 minutes, until just set but still glossy.
Fold in the corn chips and cheese and serve straight away with coriander and salsa.

notes: Food safety: scramble the eggs until set throughout, with no runny egg, if serving to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Vegetarian. Gluten-free.

title: Mushroom Quesadillas with Smoky Beans
summary: Golden tortillas filled with garlicky mushrooms, black beans and melted cheese.

steps.text: Cook the onion in half the oil in a frying pan for 5 minutes, until soft. Add the mushrooms and cook for 8 minutes, until browned and dry.
Add the garlic and paprika for 1 minute, then stir through the beans and mash lightly.
Fill four tortillas with the mushroom mix and cheese and top with the remaining tortillas.
Fry each quesadilla in a little oil for 3 minutes per side, until golden and the cheese melts. Cut into wedges and serve with sour cream and salsa.

notes: Vegetarian.

title: Cochinita Pibil-Style Slow Pork
summary: Pork shoulder marinated in orange, lime and annatto and roasted slowly until it falls apart.

items.raw: 1.5kg pork shoulder, cut into large chunks

steps.text: Mix the annatto, orange juice, lime juice, garlic, oregano, cumin, cinnamon, cloves and salt into a paste, rub over the pork and marinate for at least 4 hours.
Heat the oven to 150°C (130°C fan). Tip the pork and marinade into a deep roasting dish, add 1/2 cup water and seal tightly with baking paper and foil.
Roast for 3 hours 30 minutes, until the pork is very tender and shreds easily.
Shred the pork in its juices. Warm the tortillas and serve with pickled cabbage, pickled onion and coriander.

notes: Food safety: pork shoulder is safe at 70°C inside; this long roast far exceeds that, so check it shreds easily. Marinate in the fridge, not on the bench.
Gluten-free: check the tortilla label.

title: Chilean Beef and Corn Pie
summary: A layered pie of spiced beef, olives and egg under a golden sweet corn crust.

steps.text: Hard-boil two of the eggs for 10 minutes, until set, then cool, peel and slice.
Cook one onion in the oil for 6 minutes, until soft. Add the mince, garlic, cumin and paprika and cook for 8 minutes, until browned and cooked through. Cool slightly and stir in the raisins.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Blend the corn, milk, basil, butter, sugar and remaining raw egg until a thick, coarse purée, then cook it in a pan for 8 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Spoon the beef into a baking dish, top with the egg slices and olives, then spread over the corn mixture.
Bake for 30 minutes, until golden and bubbling at the edges, and rest for 10 minutes before serving.

notes: Food safety: the beef mince must reach 75°C right through before it goes in the pie; the pie should be steaming hot in the middle.
Gluten-free.

title: Beef Picadillo with Olives, Raisins and Rice
summary: Savoury beef mince with olives, raisins and tomato, served over white rice.

steps.text: Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, then drain.
Cook the onion and capsicum in the oil for 6 minutes, until soft. Add the garlic, cumin and oregano for 1 minute.
Add the mince and cook for 8 minutes, until browned and cooked through. Stir in the tomatoes, olives, raisins and vinegar.
Simmer for 12 minutes, until thick, and serve over the rice.

notes: Food safety: the mince must reach 75°C right through; refrigerate leftovers and rice within 1 hour.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

title: Pernil-Style Roast Pork Shoulder
summary: A garlic and citrus-marinated pork shoulder roasted low and slow with a crackling top.

items.raw: 2kg pork shoulder, skin on and scored

steps.text: Mix the garlic, orange juice, lime juice, oregano, cumin, salt and oil. Cut deep slits in the pork, work the marinade in and rest it in the fridge overnight.
