Add the tomatoes, stock and rosemary, seal and cook at high pressure for 45 minutes, then release naturally.
Shred the beef into the sauce. Cook the pasta until tender, toss with the ragu and top with parmesan.

notes: Contains gluten and dairy.
Food safety: cook beef until tender and steaming hot throughout (at least 75°C); refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 3 days.

title: Sheet-Pan Sausage and Vegetable Bake with Zucchini
summary: Pork sausages roasted with zucchini, red onion, capsicum and potatoes on one tray.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 210°C. Toss the potatoes, zucchini, onion, capsicum, oil, oregano and salt on a large tray.
Roast for 15 minutes, add the sausages and roast for 25 minutes more, turning once, until golden.
Check a sausage reaches 75°C in the centre with no pink, rest for 5 minutes and serve.

notes: Check the sausage label for gluten.
Food safety: pork must reach 70°C or more with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days. Sausages must reach 75°C.

title: Slow-Cooker Lentil and Sweet Potato Dal
summary: Red lentils and sweet potato simmered slowly with ginger and turmeric in coconut milk.

steps.text: Add the lentils, sweet potato, onion, garlic, ginger, spices, coconut milk and stock to the slow cooker.
Cook on low for 5 hours until the lentils are soft and the sweet potato is tender.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, about 2 minutes.
Cook the rice separately until tender and serve the dal over it.

notes: Vegan and gluten free.

title: Freezer-Batch Chicken and Vegetable Pot Pie Filling
summary: A creamy chicken, leek and pea filling frozen in portions, then topped with puff pastry and baked when needed.

steps.text: Melt the butter, soften the leek and carrot for 6 minutes, add the chicken and cook for 6 minutes.
Stir in the flour, then gradually add the milk and stock, and simmer for 10 minutes until thick. Add the peas and thyme, and cool.
Freeze the filling in 8 pots. To serve, thaw, top each with a pastry round and bake at 200°C for 25 minutes until golden and steaming hot.

notes: Contains dairy and gluten.

Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C at the thickest part with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days. Freeze in portions for up to 3 months and thaw in the fridge overnight; reheat until steaming hot.

title: Chicken and Rice Stir-Fry with Capsicum, Carrot and Spring Onion Greens
summary: A simple stir-fry that uses garlic-infused oil and the green tops of spring onion in place of garlic and onion.

items.raw: 1 cup spring onion, green tops only, sliced

steps.text: Heat half the oil in a wok and stir-fry the chicken for 5 minutes until cooked through, then remove.
Add the remaining oil, capsicum, carrot and ginger and stir-fry for 4 minutes.
Return the chicken with the soy, vinegar, rice and spring onion greens and toss for 2 minutes until hot.

notes: Made with ingredient choices that avoid onion and garlic pieces; check the soy sauce label. Dairy free.
Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C at the thickest part with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

title: Baked Salmon with Herbed Potatoes and Wilted Spinach
summary: Salmon with chive-and-parsley potatoes and spinach, using ingredients commonly chosen for low-FODMAP eating.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 210°C. Roast the potatoes with half the oil for 20 minutes.
Add the salmon, brush with oil, and roast for 10 minutes until it flakes.
Wilt the spinach in a hot pan for 1 minute, toss with the potatoes, herbs and lemon and serve with the salmon.

notes: Gluten free and dairy free.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

title: Ramadan Iftar Lamb and Chickpea Stew
summary: A warming Moroccan-style stew of lamb, chickpeas, lentils and tomato, good for breaking the fast.

steps.text: Brown the lamb in the oil for 5 minutes, add the onion and celery for 4 minutes and the spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, lentils, chickpeas and stock, cover and simmer for 60 minutes until the lamb and lentils are tender.
Finish with the lemon and coriander and serve with the apricots on the side.

notes: Gluten free and dairy free.
Food safety: cook lamb until tender and at least 75°C throughout; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

title: Suhoor Spiced Egg and Bean Shakshuka
summary: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and white bean sauce, a filling pre-dawn meal served with wholemeal bread.

steps.text: Soften the onion and capsicum in the oil for 6 minutes, add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and beans, simmer for 8 minutes, then make 8 wells and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook for 5 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks are firm enough. Serve with the bread.

notes: Contains egg and gluten.
Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites and yolks are set; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

title: Shabbat Slow-Roast Chicken with Root Vegetables and Honey
summary: A whole chicken roasted over carrot, potato and onion with honey and thyme for a Friday night table.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C. Spread the vegetables in a deep tray, drizzle with half the oil and season.
Rub the chicken with the remaining oil, place the lemon inside, set on the vegetables and roast for 80 minutes, brushing with the honey in the last 20 minutes.
Check the thickest part of the thigh reaches 75°C, rest for 15 minutes, carve and serve with the tray juices.

notes: Gluten free and dairy free.
Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C at the thickest part with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

title: Lunar New Year Braised Pork Belly with Star Anise and Eggs
summary: Slow-braised pork belly and boiled eggs in a sweet soy sauce, served with steamed rice.

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, cool and peel. Blanch the pork in boiling water for 5 minutes and drain.
Simmer the pork with the soy, sugar, star anise, ginger, garlic and water, covered, for 75 minutes until tender, adding the eggs for the last 15 minutes.
Steam the bok choy for 3 minutes until tender and serve everything over the rice.

notes: Contains egg, soy and gluten.
Food safety: pork must reach 70°C or more with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

title: Lemon and Herb Pan-Seared Snapper with Roast Pumpkin
summary: Snapper fillets seared crisp-skinned with lemon zest, served on roast pumpkin with rocket.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C and roast the pumpkin with half the oil for 25 minutes until golden.
Rub the fish with lemon zest, salt and the remaining oil and sear in a hot pan skin side down for 4 minutes, then turn for 2 minutes until opaque and flaking.
Serve on the pumpkin and rocket with the balsamic.

notes: Gluten free and dairy free.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

title: Lemon and Herb-Crusted Lamb Rack with Roast Vegetables
summary: Lamb racks coated with lemon zest, thyme and breadcrumbs, roasted with carrot and potato.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C. Roast the potato and carrot with 2 tablespoons of oil for 15 minutes.
Sear the lamb in the remaining oil for 3 minutes until browned, brush with mustard and press on the lemon zest, thyme and crumbs.
Add to the tray and roast for 15 to 18 minutes, then rest for 10 minutes before cutting into cutlets.

notes: Contains gluten.
Food safety: cook lamb racks to at least 63°C for medium, then rest for 3 minutes; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

title: Whole Baked Snapper with Lemon, Herbs and Cherry Tomatoes
summary: A whole snapper baked on a bed of lemon slices, herbs and tomatoes, served at the table with crusty bread.

items.raw: 1 whole snapper, about 1.2kg, scaled and gutted

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C. Slash the fish three times on each side and rub with oil and salt.
Scatter half the lemon, garlic, tomatoes and parsley in a tray, lay the fish on top and fill the cavity with the rest.
Bake for 30 minutes until the flesh flakes at the thickest part, then serve with the bread.

notes: Contains gluten (bread).
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

title: Whole Fish Foil Parcel with Lemongrass, Ginger and Lime
summary: A whole fish steamed in a foil parcel with lemongrass, ginger, chilli and lime, served with jasmine rice.

items.raw: 1 whole snapper, about 1kg, scaled and gutted

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C. Place the fish on a large sheet of foil and fill the cavity with lemongrass, ginger and chilli.
Pour over the lime and fish sauce, fold the foil into a sealed parcel and bake for 25 minutes until the flesh flakes.
Open carefully, scatter with coriander and serve with the rice and the juices.

notes: Dairy free.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

title: Garlic Prawn and Chorizo Pan with Crusty Bread
summary: Prawns and chorizo sizzled in garlic and paprika oil, mopped up with bread and a tomato salad.

steps.text: Fry the chorizo in the oil for 3 minutes until crisp at the edges, add the garlic and paprika for 30 seconds.
Add the prawns and cook for 3 minutes until pink and curled, then add the tomatoes for 1 minute.
Finish with lemon and parsley and serve with torn baguette.

notes: Contains gluten and crustacean shellfish.

Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day. Cook the chorizo until it reaches 75°C.

title: Mussels in Tomato, White Bean and Chilli Broth
summary: Mussels steamed open in a chunky tomato and cannellini broth with chilli and basil.

steps.text: Soften the garlic and chilli in the oil for 1 minute, add the tomatoes, beans and stock and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the mussels, cover and cook for 5 minutes until the shells open; discard any that stay closed.
Scatter with basil and serve with toasted bread.

notes: Contains gluten and molluscs.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

title: Crab Linguine with Lemon, Chilli and Parsley
summary: Fresh crab meat tossed through linguine with lemon zest, chilli and olive oil.

steps.text: Cook the linguine in salted water until tender, reserving 1/2 cup of the water.
Warm the oil with the garlic and chilli for 2 minutes, add the crab for 2 minutes until hot through.
Toss in the pasta, lemon and parsley with a splash of pasta water until glossy.

notes: Contains gluten and crustacean shellfish.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

title: Salt and Pepper Squid with Lime Mayo and Slaw
summary: Crisp-fried squid rings with a light cornflour coat, lime mayonnaise and cabbage slaw.

steps.text: Toss the squid in cornflour, pepper and salt, shaking off the excess.
Shallow-fry in hot oil in batches for 2 minutes until golden and opaque, then drain.
Mix the mayonnaise with half the lime, toss the slaw with the rest and serve together.

notes: Contains egg.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

title: Braised Octopus and Potato Plate with Paprika Oil
summary: Tender braised octopus on warm potatoes, finished with smoked paprika oil and lemon.

steps.text: Simmer the octopus with the bay leaves in water for 60 minutes until a knife slides in easily, then slice.
Boil the potatoes in salted water for 15 minutes until tender and drain.
Warm the oil with the paprika for 1 minute, layer the potatoes and octopus on plates, spoon over the oil and finish with parsley and lemon.

notes: Gluten free and dairy free.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

title: Seared Scallops with Pea Purée and Crisp Prosciutto
summary: Golden scallops on a bright pea purée with crisp prosciutto, a quick dinner-party main.

steps.text: Crisp the prosciutto in a dry pan for 2 minutes until crunchy and set aside.
Simmer the peas in the stock for 4 minutes until tender, then blend with the butter and lemon until smooth.
Sear the scallops in the oil for 90 seconds each side until golden and opaque, and serve on the purée with the prosciutto.

notes: Contains dairy and molluscs.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

title: Grilled Lobster Tails with Garlic Herb Butter and Corn
summary: Lobster tails grilled with garlic butter and served with charred corn on the cob.

steps.text: Melt the butter with the garlic and parsley. Split the lobster shells lengthways and brush with the butter.
Grill the lobster flesh side down for 4 minutes and flip for 4 minutes until opaque and firm; grill the corn alongside for 10 minutes, turning, until charred.
Serve with the remaining butter and lemon.

notes: Contains dairy and crustacean shellfish. Gluten free.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

title: Lemon Zest Prawn Skewers with Quinoa and Avocado
summary: Prawns rubbed with lemon zest and grilled, served with lime quinoa and avocado.

steps.text: Toss the prawns with the lemon zest, oil and salt and thread onto skewers.
Cook the quinoa in water for 15 minutes until tender and fluffy, then stir in the lime juice.
Grill the skewers for 3 minutes each side until pink and curled, and serve over the quinoa with avocado, tomato and coriander.

notes: Gluten free and dairy free.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

title: Finger Lime Fish Tacos with Cabbage Slaw
summary: Pan-fried white fish in soft tacos with cabbage slaw, avocado and a squeeze of finger lime or lime.

steps.text: Toss the fish with the paprika, cumin and oil, then pan-fry for 3 minutes until opaque and flaking.
Toss the cabbage with the lime juice and coriander for the slaw.
Fill the warmed tortillas with the fish, slaw, avocado and yoghurt.

notes: Contains gluten and dairy. Finger lime pearls can replace the lime juice when in season.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

title: High-Protein Turkey Chilli Meal Prep with Sweet Potato
summary: Lean turkey mince and kidney beans in a smoky chilli, served over baked sweet potato in batches for the week.

steps.text: Brown the mince in the oil for 8 minutes, add the onion, capsicum and garlic for 5 minutes, then the spices.
Add the tomatoes and beans and simmer for 25 minutes until thick; the mince must reach 75°C.
Split the baked sweet potatoes, spoon over the chilli and cool the rest in portions.

notes: Gluten free and dairy free.
Food safety: mince must reach 75°C throughout with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

title: High-Protein Tuna and White Bean Pasta Boxes
summary: A cold lunchbox pasta of tuna, white beans, cherry tomatoes and olives in a lemon dressing.

steps.text: Cook the pasta in salted water until tender, drain and cool under cold water.
Toss with the tuna, beans, tomatoes, olives, oil, lemon and parsley.
Pack into boxes and keep refrigerated until lunch.

notes: Contains gluten.

Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day. Keep packed lunches chilled below 5°C.

title: Lunchbox Egg and Vegetable Frittata Slices
summary: Baked frittata with zucchini, capsicum and cheddar, cut into slices for cold lunchboxes.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C and oil a 20cm tin. Whisk the eggs and milk, then stir in the vegetables, cheese and spring onion.
Pour into the tin and bake for 30 minutes until set in the centre and golden.
Cool, slice into six and pack chilled.

notes: Contains egg and dairy.
Food safety: cook eggs until the whites and yolks are set; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days. Keep packed lunches chilled below 5°C.

title: Cold Roast Beef and Beetroot Wraps
summary: Sliced roast beef, grated beetroot, rocket and horseradish yoghurt in wraps for a cold packed lunch.

steps.text: Mix the yoghurt, horseradish and mustard.
Spread over the wraps, then layer the beef, beetroot and rocket.
Roll tightly until snug, wrap and keep chilled.

notes: Contains dairy and gluten.
Food safety: use beef that was cooked to at least 63°C and cooled quickly; keep wraps chilled below 5°C and eat within 2 days.

title: Lunchbox Spiced Yoghurt Chicken and Cucumber Pita Pockets
summary: Baked yoghurt-marinated, spiced chicken in pita with cucumber, lettuce and mint yoghurt, eaten cold.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the chicken with half the yoghurt, garam masala, paprika and oil and roast on a tray for 18 minutes until cooked through at 75°C.
Cool, then mix the remaining yoghurt with the mint.
Stuff the pita with the chicken, cucumber, lettuce and mint yoghurt and pack chilled.

notes: Contains dairy and gluten.
Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C at the thickest part with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days. Keep packed lunches chilled below 5°C.

title: Freezer-Batch Beef and Lentil Cottage Pie Pots
summary: Beef mince and lentils under sweet potato mash, portioned into freezer pots for quick dinners.

steps.text: Cook the lentils in water for 20 minutes until tender and drain. Boil the sweet potato for 15 minutes until soft and mash with the butter.
Brown the mince, onion and carrot in the oil for 10 minutes, add the paste, stock, Worcestershire and lentils and simmer for 15 minutes until thick.
Spoon into 8 pots, top with mash, cool and freeze. Bake from thawed at 190°C for 25 minutes until steaming hot and golden.

notes: Contains dairy and gluten (Worcestershire).
Food safety: mince must reach 75°C throughout with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days. Freeze in portions for up to 3 months; reheat until steaming hot.

title: Freezer-Batch Vegetable and Chickpea Curry Pots
summary: A mild coconut curry of chickpeas, cauliflower and spinach, frozen in single portions.

steps.text: Soften the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, add the garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, coconut milk, chickpeas and cauliflower and simmer for 20 minutes until the cauliflower is tender.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, cool and freeze in portions. Reheat until steaming hot.

notes: Vegan and gluten free. Freeze for up to 3 months.

title: Freezer-Batch Chicken Enchilada Bake Portions
summary: Layered tortillas with shredded chicken, beans, salsa and cheese, baked, cut and frozen in portions.

steps.text: Poach the chicken in simmering water for 15 minutes until cooked through at 75°C, then shred and mix with beans, corn, cumin and 1 cup of salsa.
Layer the tortillas, filling and cheese in a tray, finishing with the remaining salsa and cheese.
Bake at 190°C for 25 minutes until bubbling, cool, cut into 8 and freeze. Reheat until steaming hot.

notes: Contains dairy and gluten.
Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C at the thickest part with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days. Freeze for up to 3 months.

title: Smoky Roast Pumpkin and Lentil Bowls
summary: Roast pumpkin dusted with smoked paprika over warm lentils, with yoghurt and rocket.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 210°C. Toss the pumpkin with the paprika, oil and salt and roast for 30 minutes until tender and caramelised.
Simmer the lentils in water for 25 minutes until tender and drain, then toss with lemon.
Serve the lentils topped with pumpkin, rocket and yoghurt.

notes: Contains dairy. Gluten free. Vegetarian.

title: Slow-Cooker Lamb Shoulder with Garlic, Rosemary and Chickpeas
summary: Lamb shoulder cooked until it falls apart over garlic, rosemary and chickpeas, with flatbread to serve.

steps.text: Rub the lamb with the oil, rosemary and salt and sit it on the onion, garlic and chickpeas in the slow cooker.
Pour over the lemon and stock and cook on low for 8 hours until the lamb shreds with a fork.
Shred, toss in the juices and serve with the flatbread.

notes: Contains gluten.
Food safety: cook lamb until tender and at least 75°C throughout; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

title: Slow-Cooker Moroccan Chicken with Olives and Lemon
summary: Chicken thighs slow cooked with olives, lemon zest, turmeric and ginger, served over couscous.

steps.text: Place the onion, garlic, spices, lemon, olives and stock in the slow cooker and nestle in the chicken.
Cook on low for 6 hours until the chicken falls from the bone and reaches 75°C.
Prepare the couscous with boiling water until the grains are tender, and serve with the chicken, juices and coriander.

notes: Contains gluten (couscous).
Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C at the thickest part with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

title: Slow-Cooker Beef Rib Ragu with Soft Polenta
summary: Beef short ribs cooked until tender in a rich tomato sauce and served on creamy polenta.

steps.text: Brown the ribs in a hot pan for 8 minutes and add to the slow cooker with the onion, carrot, garlic, paste, tomatoes, stock and thyme.
Cook on low for 9 hours until the meat falls off the bone; remove the bones and shred the meat.
Cook the polenta in 4 cups of water until thick, stir through the parmesan and serve under the ragu.

notes: Contains dairy.
Food safety: cook beef until tender and at least 75°C throughout; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 3 days.

title: Pressure-Cooker Chicken Congee with Ginger and Spring Onion
summary: A silky rice porridge with chicken, ginger and spring onion, ready in about 40 minutes.

steps.text: Add the rice, chicken, stock and ginger to the pressure cooker, seal and cook at high pressure for 20 minutes, then release naturally.
Lift out the chicken, check it reaches 75°C, shred, then stir the congee until creamy.
Serve topped with the chicken, spring onion, soy and sesame oil.

notes: Contains soy, gluten and sesame.
Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C at the thickest part with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

title: Pressure-Cooker Pea and Ham Hock Stew
summary: A thick stew of split peas, carrot and smoked ham hock, cooked in about an hour.

steps.text: Soften the onion, carrot and celery in the oil on the sauté setting for 5 minutes.
Add the peas, hock, water and bay leaves, seal and cook at high pressure for 40 minutes, then release naturally.
Shred the meat from the hock, return it to the pot and stir until the stew is thick.

notes: Gluten free and dairy free.
Food safety: pork must reach 70°C or more with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

title: Sheet-Pan Miso-Glazed Salmon with Sweet Potato and Bok Choy
summary: Salmon glazed with miso and honey, roasted with sweet potato and bok choy on one tray.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C. Roast the sweet potato with the oil for 15 minutes.
Mix the miso, honey and vinegar, brush onto the salmon, add the fish and bok choy to the tray and roast for 12 minutes until the salmon flakes.
Rest for 2 minutes, then serve the salmon and vegetables over the rice with the tray juices.

notes: Contains soy. Dairy free.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

title: One-Pot Beef and Vegetable Pasta
summary: Beef mince, tomato and short pasta cooked together in one pot with grated vegetables.

steps.text: Brown the mince, onion and garlic in the oil for 8 minutes until no pink remains.
Add the carrot, zucchini, tomatoes, stock, oregano and pasta, cover and simmer for 18 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is tender.
Stir in the parmesan and serve.

notes: Contains gluten and dairy.
Food safety: mince must reach 75°C throughout with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

title: One-Pot Coconut Prawn and Rice with Lime
summary: Prawns steamed on top of coconut rice with ginger and lime, all in one pot.

steps.text: Bring the rice, coconut milk, water and ginger to a simmer, cover and cook on low for 12 minutes.
Scatter the prawns and peas over the rice, cover and cook for 6 minutes until the rice is tender and the prawns are pink.
Stir in the lime, coriander and chilli and serve.

notes: Gluten free and dairy free. Contains crustacean shellfish.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

title: One-Pot Chickpea, Spinach and Feta Orzo
summary: Orzo cooked in tomato stock with chickpeas and spinach, finished with feta and lemon.

steps.text: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the orzo, chickpeas, tomatoes and stock and simmer for 12 minutes, stirring, until the orzo is tender.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, then the lemon, and crumble over the feta.

notes: Contains gluten and dairy. Vegetarian.

title: Iftar Chicken Biryani with Cucumber Raita
summary: Spiced chicken layered with fragrant basmati rice and finished with a cooling raita.

steps.text: Brown the onions in the oil for 12 minutes until golden, then add the chicken, garlic, ginger, spices and half the yoghurt and cook for 15 minutes until the chicken reaches 75°C.
Boil the rice in salted water for 6 minutes until just tender and drain. Layer over the chicken with the mint, cover tightly and cook on low for 15 minutes.
Mix the cucumber into the remaining yoghurt for the raita and serve alongside.

notes: Contains dairy. Gluten free.
Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C at the thickest part with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

title: Suhoor Savoury Oats with Egg and Spinach
summary: Slow-release oats cooked with stock, topped with a soft egg, spinach and cheese for a filling pre-dawn meal.

steps.text: Simmer the oats in the stock for 6 minutes, stirring, until thick and creamy; stir in the spinach until wilted.
Fry the eggs in the oil for 3 minutes until the whites are set.
Spoon the oats into bowls and top with the egg and cheese.

notes: Contains egg, dairy and gluten.
Food safety: cook eggs until the whites and yolks are set; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

title: Eid Slow-Roasted Lamb Shoulder with Spiced Rice and Almonds
summary: Lamb shoulder roasted slowly with cumin and garlic, served on fragrant rice with toasted almonds.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 160°C. Stud the lamb with the garlic, rub with the spices, oil and salt, add the stock to the tray, cover tightly with foil and roast for 4 hours until the meat is tender and falls apart.
Cook the rice until tender. Toast the almonds in a dry pan for 3 minutes until golden.
Shred the lamb, serve over the rice with the almonds and parsley.

notes: Contains nuts. Gluten free and dairy free.
Food safety: cook lamb until tender and at least 75°C throughout; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

title: Passover Braised Beef Brisket with Carrots and Potatoes
summary: Brisket braised slowly with onions, carrots and potatoes in its own juices for the holiday table.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 160°C. Rub the brisket with paprika and salt and sear in the oil for 8 minutes.
Place the brisket on the onion, garlic, paste, stock, carrot and potatoes in a deep tray, cover tightly and braise for 3 hours until fork-tender.
Rest for 15 minutes, slice across the grain and spoon over the juices.

notes: Gluten free and dairy free. Check labels for Passover certification if observing.
Food safety: cook beef until tender and at least 75°C throughout; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 3 days.

title: Lunar New Year Longevity Noodles with Chicken and Mushrooms
summary: Long wheat noodles stir-fried with chicken, mushrooms and greens, left uncut for good fortune.

steps.text: Cook the noodles until tender, drain and toss with the sesame oil.
Stir-fry the chicken in the oil for 5 minutes until cooked through at 75°C, add the mushrooms, garlic and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add the bok choy, soy and noodles and toss for 3 minutes until hot and the greens are tender.

notes: Contains egg, gluten, soy and sesame.
Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C at the thickest part with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

title: Lunar New Year Steamed Chicken with Ginger and Shiitake
summary: Chicken pieces steamed over rice with ginger and shiitake mushrooms in a light soy sauce.

steps.text: Toss the chicken with the soy, vinegar, ginger and mushrooms in a heatproof dish.
Steam for 25 minutes until the chicken reaches 75°C and the juices run clear.
Drizzle with sesame oil, scatter with spring onion and serve with the rice.

notes: Contains soy, gluten and sesame. Dairy free.
Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C at the thickest part with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

title: Lemon and Thyme Beef Burgers with Beetroot and Caramelised Onion
summary: Beef burgers with lemon zest and thyme, beetroot and caramelised onion in a bun.

steps.text: Cook the onion in the oil with the sugar on low for 15 minutes until soft and golden.
Mix the mince with the lemon zest, thyme and salt, shape into 4 patties and pan-fry for 5 minutes each side until no pink remains and they reach 75°C.
Top with the cheese until melted and build in the buns with the beetroot, onion and rocket.

notes: Contains dairy and gluten.
Food safety: mince must reach 75°C throughout with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

title: Barbecue Whole Snapper with Chilli, Lime and Herb Salad
summary: A whole snapper grilled over medium heat and finished with a chilli lime dressing and herbs.

items.raw: 1 whole snapper, about 1.2kg, scaled and gutted

steps.text: Slash the fish, oil it and grill over medium heat for 10 to 12 minutes each side until the flesh flakes at the thickest part.
Whisk the lime, chilli, fish sauce and the remaining oil.
Toss the herbs and cucumber and serve with the fish and dressing.

notes: Gluten free and dairy free.
Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking, and shellfish until opaque and firm; keep raw seafood below 5°C, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

title: Garlic Chive Layered Pancakes
summary: Crisp, flaky layered pancakes with garlic chives, pan-fried and cut into wedges for snacking.

steps.text: Stir the flour with the boiling water until a shaggy dough forms, then knead for 5 minutes until smooth. Cover and rest.
Divide into 4 pieces and roll each into a thin round. Brush with sesame oil and scatter with chives and salt.
Roll each round into a log, coil into a snail and press flat into a 14cm disc.
Fry in the neutral oil over medium heat for 3 minutes each side, until golden and crisp at the edges.
Cut into wedges and serve with the soy sauce and rice vinegar mixed together for dipping.

notes: Plus 30 minutes resting the dough.
Snack. Vegan.

title: Black Sesame Tang Yuan
summary: Chewy glutinous rice balls filled with sweet black sesame paste, served in warm ginger syrup.

steps.text: Toast the sesame in a dry pan over medium heat for 3 minutes until fragrant, then grind to a rough paste with the white sugar and butter. Chill until firm and roll into 16 small balls.
Knead the flour with 3/4 cup water into a soft dough. Flatten pieces, wrap each around a filling ball and roll smooth.
Simmer the 3 cups water with the ginger and brown sugar for 8 minutes until syrupy.
Boil the dumplings in a separate pot of water for 5 minutes, until they float and are tender.
Lift into bowls and ladle over the ginger syrup.

notes: Dessert. Vegetarian. Filling chilled before wrapping.

title: Soy Egg Rice Bowls with Pickled Cucumber
summary: Marinated soft-set eggs over steamed rice with quick-pickled cucumber and sesame.

steps.text: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Boil the eggs for 7 minutes, then cool in iced water and peel.
Simmer the soy sauce, sugar and water for 2 minutes until the sugar dissolves, cool, then steep the eggs in it for at least 1 hour.
Toss the cucumber with the vinegar and a pinch of salt for 10 minutes.
Top the rice with halved eggs, cucumber, sesame oil, sesame seed and spring onion.

notes: Food safety: use fresh eggs and keep marinated eggs refrigerated; eat within 2 days. Plus 1 hour marinating.

title: Wok-Tossed Cabbage Dumpling Filling Bowls
summary: Dumpling flavours without the wrapping: pork and cabbage stir-fried over rice with ginger and chilli oil.

steps.text: Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the pork for 4 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Add the ginger and garlic for 30 seconds, then the wombok, soy sauce and wine and toss for 4 minutes until the cabbage wilts.
Stir through the chilli oil and spring onion.
Spoon the pork and cabbage over the rice and serve hot.

notes: Food safety: cook the pork mince to 75°C with no pink remaining. Keep any leftover garlic, herb or chilli oil in the fridge and use it within 4 days.

title: Silken Tofu and Mushrooms in Chilli Bean Sauce
summary: Silky tofu and mushrooms in a numbing, spicy bean sauce, served with rice.

steps.text: Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy.
Toast the peppercorns in a dry wok for 1 minute until fragrant, crush, and set aside.
Heat the oil and fry the mushrooms for 4 minutes until browned. Add the doubanjiang, garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Pour in the stock and soy sauce, add the tofu in cubes and simmer gently for 5 minutes.
Stir the cornflour with 2 tbsp water, add and cook for 1 minute until glossy. Top with peppercorns and spring onion over rice.

notes: Vegan. Doubanjiang contains wheat; check labels for gluten.

title: Steamed Egg Custard with Prawns
summary: Silky savoury egg custard steamed gently and topped with prawns, soy and spring onion.

steps.text: Whisk the eggs with the water and a pinch of salt, then strain through a sieve into a shallow heatproof dish.
Cover with foil and steam over gently simmering water for 8 minutes.
Lay the prawns on top, cover and steam for 4 minutes more, until the custard is just set and the prawns are opaque and pink.
Drizzle with soy sauce and sesame oil and scatter with spring onion and pepper.

notes: Food safety: prawns should be opaque and pink and the custard set through to 75°C.

title: Peanut Candy Sesame Brittle Bars
summary: Crunchy peanut and sesame brittle set in a tray, snapped into shards.

steps.text: Line a tray with baking paper and toast the peanuts and sesame in a dry pan for 4 minutes until golden.
Boil the sugar, water and golden syrup for 10 minutes until it reaches 150°C and turns light amber.
Stir in the butter and bicarbonate of soda, which will foam, then fold through the peanuts and sesame quickly.
Pour onto the tray, press thin with an oiled spatula and cool for 30 minutes until hard.
Snap the cooled brittle into pieces and store airtight.

notes: Snack. Vegetarian and gluten-free. Hot sugar can cause severe burns; handle with care.

title: Japanese Sweet Potato Pancakes
summary: Fluffy savoury-sweet pancakes with mashed sweet potato and a soy glaze.

steps.text: Boil the sweet potato for 12 minutes until very soft, drain and mash.
Mix in the egg, flour and milk until a thick batter forms.
Heat the oil in a pan and cook spoonfuls for 3 minutes each side over medium heat, until golden.
Simmer the butter, soy sauce and mirin for 1 minute until syrupy.
Brush the glaze over the pancakes and scatter with sesame.

notes: Vegetarian.

title: Black Sesame Cream Pudding
summary: Creamy toasted black sesame pudding, set with cornflour and finished with maple.

steps.text: Toast the sesame in a dry pan for 3 minutes until fragrant. Warm the milk, cream and sugar until steaming, blend with the sesame and cornflour until smooth, strain and return to the pot.
Cook over medium heat for 5 minutes, whisking until thick and glossy.
Pour into 4 glasses and chill until set.
Spoon over the maple syrup and serve cold.

notes: Dessert. Plus 4 hours chilling. Vegetarian; gluten-free if you use cornflour labelled gluten-free.

title: Cold Soba with Sesame Dipping Sauce
summary: Chilled buckwheat noodles with cucumber, nori and a nutty dipping sauce for hot days.

steps.text: Boil the soba for 5 minutes until tender, then rinse well under cold water and drain.
Whisk the soy sauce, mirin, vinegar, tahini and sesame oil into a smooth sauce.
Pile the noodles into bowls and top with cucumber, nori and spring onion.
Serve with the sauce for dipping or pouring over.

notes: Vegan. Check soba is 100% buckwheat if avoiding gluten.

title: Tamago Sando with Pickled Slaw
summary: Soft, creamy Japanese egg sandwich on white bread with crunchy pickled slaw.

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes until firm, then cool in iced water and peel.
Mash with the mayonnaise, mustard and a pinch of salt until creamy.
Toss the cabbage with the vinegar and sugar for 5 minutes.
Butter the bread, pile on the egg and slaw, close and trim the crusts.

notes: Food safety: eggs boiled until the yolk is fully firm; keep refrigerated and eat within a day.

title: Karaage Chicken Bento Skewers
summary: Crisp soy-ginger marinated chicken nuggets threaded on skewers, served with lemon.

steps.text: Marinate the chicken in the soy sauce, mirin, ginger and garlic for 20 minutes.
Toss in the potato starch to coat.
Heat 3cm of oil to 175°C and fry in batches for 5 minutes until deep golden.
Drain on paper, thread onto skewers and serve with lemon.

notes: Food safety: fry until golden and the chicken reaches 75°C. Plus 20 minutes marinating.

title: Oyakodon Quick Rice Bowl
summary: Soft-set egg and chicken simmered in dashi, soy and mirin over steamed rice.

steps.text: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender.
Simmer the dashi, soy sauce, mirin and sugar in a pan, add the onion and chicken and cook for 6 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Pour the lightly beaten eggs over and cook for 1 minute until just set.
Slide over the rice and top with spring onion.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C and the eggs are just set.

title: Sweet Potato Mochi Pillows
summary: Soft stretchy rice-flour mochi wrapped around sweet mashed sweet potato, dusted with starch.

steps.text: Whisk the flour, water and sugar in a heatproof bowl until smooth.
Microwave covered for 1 minute, stir, then microwave for another 1 minute until thick and translucent.
Tip onto a surface dusted with the potato starch and cool slightly.
Cut into 8 pieces, flatten, wrap each around a ball of sweet potato (boiled for 12 minutes until soft, mashed with 1 tbsp sugar) and pinch closed.

notes: Dessert. Vegan and gluten-free. Eat the same day for best texture.

title: Kimchi Cheese Toastie Rolls
summary: Crisp pan-fried bread rolls stuffed with kimchi and melty cheddar.

steps.text: Flatten the bread with a rolling pin and trim the crusts.
Mix the kimchi, cheddar and gochujang and spoon along one edge of each slice.
Roll up tightly and press the seam closed.
Fry in the butter over medium heat for 5 minutes, turning until golden all over.

notes: Most kimchi has fish sauce or shrimp in it; use a vegan kimchi to make it vegetarian. Kimchi may contain fish sauce; check the label.

title: Hotteok Cinnamon Pockets
summary: Chewy griddled Korean sweet pancakes with a brown sugar, cinnamon and walnut filling.

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, white sugar, milk and a pinch of salt into a sticky dough. Cover and rise.
Mix the brown sugar, cinnamon and walnuts until combined.
Divide the dough into 6, flatten, add filling to each and pinch closed.
Cook in the oil over medium heat for 3 minutes each side, pressing flat, until golden and the sugar has melted.

notes: Dessert. Plus 1 hour rising. Vegetarian.

title: Gochujang Egg Drop Toast
summary: Buttery pan-fried bread topped with a runny egg, gochujang glaze and sesame.

steps.text: Fry the bread in half the butter for 2 minutes each side until golden and crisp.
In the remaining butter, fry the eggs for 3 minutes until the whites are set and yolks are soft.
Mix the gochujang and honey until smooth and spread over the toast.
Top with the eggs, sesame and spring onion.

notes: Food safety: soft yolks use raw egg; cook the white through. Vegetarian. This uses raw or lightly cooked egg: pregnant women, older people, young children and anyone with low immunity should skip it or use pasteurised eggs.

title: Bulgogi Beef Lunch Wraps
summary: Sweet soy-marinated beef with crisp lettuce, rice and ssamjang in cool leaves.

steps.text: Mix the soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, garlic and pear and marinate the beef for 30 minutes.
Sear the beef in a hot pan in batches for 2 minutes per batch until browned.
Fill lettuce leaves with rice, beef and a dab of ssamjang.

notes: Food safety: sear the thin beef until browned through, at least 71°C. Plus 30 minutes marinating.

title: Tteokbokki-Style Rice Cakes in Gochujang
summary: Chewy rice cakes simmered in a sweet-spicy gochujang sauce with fish cakes.

steps.text: Boil the egg for 8 minutes, cool and peel.
Simmer the water, gochujang, soy sauce and sugar in a wide pan for 3 minutes.
Add the rice cakes and fish cakes and cook for 10 minutes, stirring until the sauce thickens and the rice cakes are soft.
Top with the egg and spring onion.

notes: Food safety: reheat fish cakes until hot through to 75°C.

title: Coconut Glutinous Rice Cups with Mango
summary: Glutinous rice soaked in coconut cream, topped with fresh mango and toasted sesame.

steps.text: Rinse the rice and steam it over simmering water for 25 minutes until tender.
Warm half the coconut cream with 2 tbsp palm sugar and salt, stir through the hot rice and rest for 10 minutes.
Warm the remaining coconut cream and sugar for a sauce.
Serve the rice with mango, a spoon of sauce and sesame.

notes: Dessert. Plus 30 minutes soaking the rice. Vegan and gluten-free.

title: Red Curry Fish Patties with Cucumber
summary: Bouncy red curry fish cakes fried until golden, with cucumber and sweet chilli dip.

steps.text: Blend the fish, curry paste, egg and fish sauce into a coarse paste, then fold in the beans and lime leaf.
Shape the mixture into 12 small flat patties with wet hands.
Fry in 1cm of oil over medium heat for 3 minutes each side until golden and cooked through.
Serve with the sweet chilli sauce and cucumber.

notes: Food safety: cook the fish cakes until the centre is opaque and flakes, at 63°C or above.

title: Thai Basil Egg Fried Rice Cups
summary: Wok-fried rice with Thai basil, chilli and fried egg, packed into little cups for lunchboxes.

items.raw: 3 cups white rice, cooked and cooled

steps.text: Heat the oil in a wok and stir-fry the garlic and chilli for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the rice, oyster sauce and fish sauce and toss for 4 minutes until hot and lightly browned.
Fry the eggs separately for 3 minutes until the whites are set.
Fold in the basil, spoon the rice into bowls and top with the eggs and cucumber.

notes: Food safety: cool leftover rice and refrigerate it within 1 hour, then reheat until piping hot.

title: Coconut Custard Pots
summary: Baked coconut custard with palm sugar, set until just wobbly.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 150°C and set 4 ramekins in a deep tray.
Warm the cream, milk and sugar until the sugar dissolves, then whisk into the eggs with the vanilla and salt.
Strain into the ramekins and pour hot water into the tray to halfway up.
Bake for 30 minutes until set around the edges with a slight wobble in the centre.
Chill the custards in the fridge until cold before serving.

notes: Dessert. Plus 2 hours chilling. Vegetarian and gluten-free.

title: Lemongrass and Galangal Noodle Broth
summary: Hot, sour lemongrass broth with mushrooms, tomato and noodles for a quick lunch.

steps.text: Simmer the stock with the lemongrass, galangal and lime leaf for 8 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and tomato and cook for 3 minutes until soft.
Soak the vermicelli in boiling water for 4 minutes until tender and drain into bowls.
Season the broth with fish sauce, lime juice and chilli and ladle over. Top with coriander.

notes: Gluten-free if the stock is.

title: Banana Blossom Salad with Peanuts
summary: Shredded banana blossom tossed with lime, chilli and roasted peanuts.

steps.text: Toss the shredded blossom in lime juice and water for 5 minutes until it stays pale and crisp, then drain.
Dissolve the sugar in the lime juice and fish sauce for the dressing.
Toss the blossom with the shallot, chilli and herbs.
Dress and scatter with peanuts.

notes: Gluten-free. Use soy sauce for a vegan dressing.

title: Egg Yolk Cream Hot Chocolate
summary: Rich whipped egg-yolk cream spooned over hot cocoa for a dessert drink.

steps.text: Whisk the yolks, sugar, condensed milk and vanilla over a pot of simmering water for 5 minutes until thick, pale and 71°C.
Whisk the cocoa into 1 cup hot water with a little sugar until smooth and pour into two cups.
Spoon the custard on top.

notes: Food safety: egg yolks are heated to 71°C to cook through.
Dessert. Vegetarian and gluten-free.

title: Bánh Mì Pâté Toasts
summary: Crunchy toasted baguette with pâté, pickled carrot and radish, cucumber and chilli.

steps.text: Pickle the carrot and daikon in the vinegar, sugar and a pinch of salt for 15 minutes.
Split and toast the baguette until crisp.
Spread with pâté and layer with cucumber, pickles, coriander and chilli.

notes: Pâté contains liver; pregnant people should avoid it.

title: Lemongrass Pork Rice Paper Rolls
summary: Fresh rolls with lemongrass pork, vermicelli and herbs, served with peanut dip.

steps.text: Mix the pork with the lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce and sugar and fry for 7 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Soak the vermicelli in boiling water for 4 minutes until tender.
Dip a wrapper in water, fill with pork, noodles, herbs and cucumber and roll tightly.
Whisk the peanut butter, hoisin and a splash of warm water for the dip.

notes: Food safety: cook the pork mince to 75°C, with no pink.

title: Vietnamese Sweet Corn Pudding
summary: Warm corn and coconut milk pudding thickened with tapioca and finished with toasted peanuts.

steps.text: Simmer the corn, coconut milk, sugar and salt for 8 minutes.
Stir the starch with 3 tbsp water and whisk in, cooking for 3 minutes until thick.
Serve warm topped with peanuts.

notes: Dessert. Vegan and gluten-free.

title: Sambal Egg Skewer Bites
summary: Soft eggs rolled in spicy sambal and grilled on skewers.

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, cool in iced water and peel.
Fry the garlic and sambal in the oil for 2 minutes, add the kecap manis and bubble until sticky.
Roll the eggs in the sauce over low heat for 2 minutes until coated.
Thread onto skewers and serve with lime.

notes: Food safety: boil eggs until the yolk is mostly firm. Vegetarian.

title: Coconut Cassava Cake
summary: Chewy baked coconut cassava cake with a golden top.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C and line a 20cm tin.
Whisk the eggs, milk, sugar and oil, then beat in the cassava flour and baking powder.
Pour in, sprinkle with coconut and bake for 45 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean.

notes: Dessert. Vegetarian; gluten-free if you use gluten-free baking powder. Cassava is eaten cooked only.

title: Gado-Gado Lunch Bowl
summary: Blanched vegetables, tofu and egg with a rich peanut sauce.

steps.text: Boil the potatoes for 10 minutes until tender, adding the beans for the last 3 minutes. Drain.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, cool and peel.
Pan-fry the tofu until golden on all sides.
Whisk the peanut butter, kecap manis, lime juice, garlic, sambal and warm water into a sauce.
Arrange the vegetables, tofu and halved eggs on plates and drizzle with sauce.

notes: Vegetarian. Food safety: boil eggs until the yolk is firm.

title: Sambal Tempeh-Style Tofu Rice Boxes
summary: Crisp tofu tossed in sweet sambal glaze over rice with greens.

steps.text: Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy.
Fry the tofu in the oil for 8 minutes until golden.
Add the beans, sambal and kecap manis and toss for 3 minutes until sticky.
Serve over rice with lime.

notes: Vegan.

title: Kuih Lapis Steamed Layer Cake
summary: Rainbow-layered coconut rice flour cake, steamed in thin layers.

steps.text: Whisk everything until smooth and divide in two, tinting one half if you like.
Steam a greased tin for 3 minutes, pour in a thin layer and steam for 5 minutes until set.
Repeat layer by layer until the batter is used.
Steam the final layer for 10 minutes, cool completely and slice.

notes: Dessert. Vegan and gluten-free. Plus 2 hours cooling.

title: Roti Canai with Dhal Dip
summary: Flaky layered Malaysian flatbread torn and dipped in quick lentil dhal.

steps.text: Knead the flour, egg, water, milk and 1 tsp salt into a soft dough. Rub with ghee and rest.
Simmer the lentils with the water, turmeric, curry powder and onion for 20 minutes until soft.
Stretch each dough ball thin, fold into a square and fry in ghee for 3 minutes each side until golden.
Crush the roti to fluff its layers and serve with the dhal.

notes: Plus 2 hours resting the dough. Vegetarian.

title: Curry Puff Pastry Triangles
summary: Baked flaky pastry with a spiced potato and pea filling.

steps.text: Boil the potato for 8 minutes until tender and drain.
Fry the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, add curry powder for 1 minute, then the potato and pea. Mash lightly and cool.
Cut pastry into squares, fill, fold into triangles and seal.
Brush with beaten egg and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until puffed and golden.

notes: Vegetarian.

title: Pulut Hitam Black Rice Pudding
summary: Warm black glutinous rice pudding with coconut cream and palm sugar.

steps.text: Rinse and soak the rice overnight.
Simmer the rice in the water for 45 minutes until tender and the porridge thickens.
Stir in the palm sugar and salt and cook for 5 minutes.
Serve warm with the coconut cream.

notes: Dessert. Plus overnight soaking. Vegan and gluten-free.

title: Mango Turon Spring Rolls
summary: Crisp fried spring roll wrappers with mango and brown sugar, dusted with sugar.

steps.text: Roll each mango strip in brown sugar and cinnamon until coated.
Wrap in a wrapper, sealing the edges with water.
Fry in 2cm of oil over medium heat for 4 minutes until golden, then drain.
Dust with the caster sugar and serve warm.

notes: Dessert. Vegan.

title: Pandesal-Style Soft Rolls
summary: Soft, slightly sweet bread rolls rolled in breadcrumbs, baked until golden.

steps.text: Mix the flour, sugar, yeast and a pinch of salt. Add milk, egg and butter and knead for 8 minutes until smooth.
Rise until doubled, then shape into 12 rolls and coat with breadcrumbs.
Rest the shaped rolls for 30 minutes until puffy.
Bake at 190°C for 18 minutes until golden.

notes: Plus 90 minutes rising and resting. Vegetarian.

title: Chicken Tinola Lunch Soup
summary: Gentle ginger chicken soup with green papaya and spinach.

steps.text: Fry the ginger, garlic and onion in the oil for 4 minutes until soft.
Add the chicken and brown for 4 minutes, then add the water and fish sauce.
Simmer for 15 minutes, add the papaya and cook for 6 minutes until tender.
Stir through the spinach until wilted.

notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C and no pink should remain.

title: Leche Flan Cups
summary: Silky caramel custard baked in cups, rich and smooth.

steps.text: Melt the sugar in a pot over medium heat until deep amber and divide among 6 ramekins.
Whisk the yolks, condensed milk, milk and vanilla and strain.
Pour into the ramekins and bake in a water bath at 150°C for 40 minutes until set with a gentle wobble.
Chill until cold, then run a knife around each and unmould onto plates.

notes: Dessert. Plus 4 hours chilling. Vegetarian and gluten-free.

title: Ginisang Sweet Potato Fritters
summary: Crispy sweet potato fritters with garlic and spring onion, served with vinegar dip.

steps.text: Mix the potato, flour, egg, onion and first garlic with a pinch of salt.
Fry spoonfuls in oil for 3 minutes each side until golden and crisp.
Mix the vinegar, extra garlic and chilli for dipping.

notes: Vegetarian.

title: Masala Chai Shortbread
summary: Buttery spiced tea shortbread, crisp and tender.

steps.text: Beat the butter and icing sugar until pale.
Mix in the flour, cornflour and spices to a soft dough, chill and roll out.
Cut into rounds and bake at 160°C for 18 minutes until pale golden.

notes: Plus 30 minutes chilling. Vegetarian.

title: Besan Ladoo Sweet Balls
summary: Roasted chickpea flour and ghee balls with cardamom, soft and melting.

steps.text: Roast the flour in the ghee over low heat for 15 minutes, stirring until fragrant and golden.
Cool until just warm, stir in the sugar and cardamom.
Roll into 12 balls and press a pistachio into each.

notes: Dessert. Vegetarian and gluten-free.

title: Paneer Kathi Rolls
summary: Spiced paneer wrapped in flaky rotis with onions and mint chutney.

steps.text: Coat the paneer in the paste, spices and yoghurt for 15 minutes.
Fry in the oil for 8 minutes until browned on all sides.
Warm the rotis and fill with paneer, onion and chutney. Roll tight.

notes: Vegetarian.

title: Masala Dosa Lunch Crepes
summary: Crisp rice-flour crepes filled with spiced potato.

steps.text: Whisk the flours, water and salt into a thin batter.
Fry the mustard seed and curry leaf in 1 tbsp ghee, add the onion, chilli and turmeric and cook for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the potato and mash lightly.
Pour batter into a hot pan, spread thin and cook with ghee for 3 minutes until crisp, fill and fold.

notes: Vegetarian. Gluten-free.

title: Tandoori Chicken Thigh Skewers
summary: Marinated chicken thigh grilled until charred, with mint raita.

steps.text: Mix the yoghurt, paste, spices and lemon juice and coat the chicken. Marinate for at least 2 hours.
Thread the chicken onto metal or soaked skewers.
Grill over high heat for 12 minutes, turning until charred and cooked through.
Serve with raita and onion.

notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C. Plus 2 hours marinating.

title: Rasmalai-Style Cardamom Milk Cakes
summary: Soft ricotta dumplings steeped in saffron cardamom milk.

steps.text: Mix the ricotta, flour and semolina into a dough, knead and shape 12 small discs.
Simmer the milk, sugar, cardamom and saffron for 12 minutes until reduced by a third.
Drop in the discs and poach gently for 10 minutes until they swell.
Chill and serve with pistachio.

notes: Dessert. Plus 3 hours chilling. Vegetarian.

title: Kerala Fish Curry Lunch Pots
summary: Tamarind and coconut fish curry with curry leaves and chilli.

steps.text: Fry the mustard seed and curry leaf in the oil for 30 seconds until they pop.
Add the onion, garlic and ginger for 5 minutes until soft.
Stir in the spices, coconut milk and tamarind and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the fish and cook for 6 minutes until opaque and flaking.

notes: Food safety: fish is cooked when opaque and flaking at 63°C.

title: Sri Lankan Coconut Sambol Toasts
summary: Zesty fresh coconut sambol piled on crisp toast.

steps.text: Rub the coconut with the onion, chilli, lime juice and salt until combined.
Toast the sourdough in the oil for 3 minutes each side until crisp.
Pile the sambol on the toast until generously covered.

notes: Vegan.

title: Ethiopian-Style Lentil Wraps with Greens
summary: Red lentil stew in a flatbread wrap with spiced greens.

steps.text: Fry the onion in the oil for 5 minutes until soft, add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the lentils and water and simmer for 18 minutes until thick.
Wilt the kale in the stew for 3 minutes until tender.
Spoon into flatbreads and roll.

notes: Vegan.

title: South African Milk Tart Squares
summary: Cinnamon-dusted creamy milk custard in a crisp pastry.

steps.text: Press the pastry into a tin and bake at 190°C for 12 minutes until golden.
Heat 2 1/2 cups milk with the sugar. Whisk the cornflour and eggs into the remaining milk and add, stirring over medium heat for 6 minutes until thick.
Stir in the vanilla and butter and pour into the shell.
Chill, dust with cinnamon and cut into squares.

notes: Dessert. Plus 2 hours chilling. Vegetarian.

title: Boerewors Roll Lunch Sandwich
summary: Grilled spiced sausage in a roll with tomato relish and onion.

steps.text: Grill the sausage for 15 minutes, turning until browned and cooked through.
Fry the onion in oil for 8 minutes until golden.
Butter and toast the rolls for 2 minutes until golden, then fill with sausage, onion, tomato sauce and relish.

notes: Food safety: pork sausage must reach 75°C throughout.

title: Pacific Coconut Fish Ceviche Cups
summary: Lime-cured fish with coconut milk, cucumber and chilli served in cups.

steps.text: Toss the fish with lime juice and refrigerate for 20 minutes until opaque.
Drain most of the juice and stir in the coconut milk, cucumber, tomato, onion and chilli.
Serve in cups topped with coriander.

notes: Food safety: use very fresh fish; the flesh should turn opaque, or poach to 63°C if unsure. Plus 20 minutes curing. Gluten-free. Use very fresh, well-chilled seafood for anything served raw or lightly cured, and serve it straight away; pregnant women, older people, young children and anyone with low immunity should avoid raw fish.

title: Samoan Palusami-Style Spinach Parcels
summary: Spinach leaves in creamy coconut baked in foil.

steps.text: Mix the onion, tomato, coconut cream, salt and lime.
Pile the spinach on foil squares, spoon over the mixture and seal.
Bake at 180°C for 30 minutes until tender.

notes: Vegan and gluten-free.

title: Sesame Seed Balls with Sweet Potato Filling
summary: Crisp fried glutinous rice balls coated in sesame with a sweet potato centre.

steps.text: Boil the sweet potato for 12 minutes until soft, drain, mash with the sugar and cool, then roll into 8 balls.
Mix the flour with the hot water into a soft dough, divide into 8 and flatten each piece.
Wrap each piece around a filling ball, seal well and roll in the sesame seed until evenly coated.
Fry in oil heated to 150°C for 6 minutes, turning until golden and puffed, then drain on paper.

notes: Dessert. Vegan and gluten-free. Keep the oil at a steady heat so the balls cook through.

title: Egg Tart Cups with Flaky Pastry
summary: Cantonese-style custard tarts with a golden, lightly set filling.

steps.text: Cut the pastry into rounds and press into a 12-hole tin, then chill.
Dissolve the sugar in the hot water, cool, then whisk in the eggs, milk and vanilla and strain.
Fill each case nearly to the top.
Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until the pastry is golden and the custard is just set with a small wobble.

notes: Food safety: bake until the custard is set through, at 75°C or more. Plus 20 minutes chilling. Dessert. Vegetarian.

title: Cold Sesame Noodles with Cucumber
summary: Chewy noodles in a creamy peanut-sesame sauce with crisp cucumber.

steps.text: Boil the noodles for 5 minutes until tender, rinse under cold water and drain well.
Whisk the peanut butter, tahini, soy sauce, vinegar, chilli oil and sesame oil with 2 tbsp warm water until smooth.
Toss the noodles with the sauce, cucumber and spring onion until coated.

notes: Vegan.

title: Chicken and Corn Congee
summary: Comforting slow-cooked rice porridge with chicken, ginger and sweet corn.

steps.text: Simmer the rice, stock and ginger for 35 minutes, stirring until the grains break down into a thick porridge.
Add the chicken whole and simmer for 12 minutes until cooked through, then shred.
Return the chicken, add the corn and soy sauce and cook for 3 minutes until hot.
Ladle into bowls and top with spring onion and sesame oil.

notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C and be white throughout.

title: Steamed Pork and Mushroom Shumai
summary: Open-top steamed pork dumplings with shiitake and ginger.

steps.text: Mix the pork, mushroom, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil and cornflour until sticky.
Place a spoonful on each wrapper, gather the edges around it and press the top flat.
Top each with a little carrot.
Steam in batches over boiling water for 12 minutes until the filling is firm and cooked through.

notes: Food safety: pork must reach 75°C throughout.

title: Wok Rice with Prawns and Soft Egg Ribbons
summary: Wok-fried rice with fluffy egg, prawns and peas.

items.raw: 3 cups jasmine rice, cooked and cooled

steps.text: Heat the oil in a wok over high heat and cook the prawns for 2 minutes until pink and opaque, then lift out.
Scramble the eggs in the same wok for 1 minute until just set.
Add the rice and peas and toss for 4 minutes until hot and lightly toasted.
Return the prawns, add the soy sauce and sesame oil and scatter with spring onion.

notes: Food safety: prawns must be opaque and pink; cool leftover rice and refrigerate within 1 hour.

title: Walnut Almond Cookies Chinese Style
summary: Crumbly, golden cookies with walnut and almond meal, easy and not too sweet.

steps.text: Cream the butter and sugar until pale, then beat in the yolk.
Mix in the flour, almond meal, baking powder and walnuts to a soft dough.
Roll into 12 balls, flatten slightly and place on a lined tray.
Bake at 170°C for 15 minutes until golden at the edges.

notes: Dessert. Vegetarian.

title: Miso Butter Corn Fritters
summary: Golden savoury fritters with sweet corn and miso, quick to fry.

steps.text: Mix the corn, flour, eggs, miso and spring onion into a thick batter.
Heat oil in a pan and drop in spoonfuls.
Fry for 3 minutes each side until golden and crisp.
Melt the butter and drizzle over the fritters to serve.

notes: Vegetarian.

title: Teriyaki Salmon Rice Bowls
summary: Glazed salmon over rice with edamame and pickled ginger.

steps.text: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender.
Pan-fry the salmon in the oil, skin side down, for 4 minutes, turn and cook for 3 minutes more.
Pour in the teriyaki sauce and cook for 1 minute until sticky.
Steam the edamame until bright green, then serve everything over the rice with ginger and nori.

notes: Food safety: salmon is cooked when it flakes easily, at 63°C.

title: Black Sesame Mochi Waffles
summary: Chewy mochi-style waffles with a nutty sesame flavour.

steps.text: Toast the sesame seed in a dry pan for 3 minutes until golden, grind it, then mix with the flours, sugar and baking powder.
Whisk the eggs, milk and melted butter into the dry mix until smooth.
Cook in a hot waffle iron for 5 minutes until deep golden and crisp.
Serve the warm waffles with maple syrup poured over.

notes: Vegetarian.

title: Curry Udon with Mushrooms
summary: Thick noodles in a mild Japanese-style curry broth with mushrooms and spinach.

steps.text: Fry the onion in the oil for 4 minutes until soft, add the curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the stock, soy sauce, mirin and mushrooms and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the udon and cook for 3 minutes until hot and tender.
Stir through the spinach until wilted.

notes: Vegan.

title: Dorayaki-Style Honey Pancake Sandwiches
summary: Soft honey pancakes sandwiched with sweet nut spread.

steps.text: Whisk the eggs, sugar and honey until pale and thick, then fold in the flour, baking powder and milk.
Cook small rounds in a lightly oiled pan for 2 minutes each side until golden.
Cool slightly and sandwich pairs with the peanut butter.

notes: Dessert. Vegetarian.

title: Chawanmushi Egg Custard with Mushroom
summary: Silky steamed savoury egg custard with dashi and mushroom.

steps.text: Whisk the eggs with the dashi, soy sauce and mirin and strain into 4 cups.
Add the mushrooms and cover each cup tightly with foil.
Steam gently over simmering water for 12 minutes until just set, with a tiny wobble.
Scatter the spring onion over the warm custards and serve.

notes: Food safety: the custard should be set through, at 75°C. Vegetarian only if dashi is plant-based.

title: Crisp Kimchi and Spring Onion Wedges
summary: Crisp pan-fried pancakes with sharp kimchi and spring onion.

steps.text: Mix the kimchi, flour, water, egg, spring onion and gochugaru into a thick batter.
Fry in the oil over medium heat for 4 minutes each side until golden and crisp.
Cut into wedges and serve with the soy sauce and vinegar dip.

notes: Most kimchi has fish sauce or shrimp in it; use a vegan kimchi to make it vegetarian. Kimchi may contain fish sauce.

title: Dalgona Honeycomb Candy
summary: Crunchy golden honeycomb candy made with sugar and bicarbonate of soda.

steps.text: Line a tray with baking paper.
Heat the sugar and water in a pot without stirring for 8 minutes until deep amber.
Take off the heat and whisk in the bicarbonate of soda; it will puff up hugely.
Pour out and cool for 20 minutes until hard, then break into pieces.

notes: Dessert. Vegan and gluten-free. Hot sugar burns severely; keep children away.

title: Japchae with Mushrooms
summary: Glossy glass noodles with vegetables and mushrooms in sweet soy sauce.

steps.text: Boil the noodles for 6 minutes until chewy and transparent, drain and cut short.
Stir-fry the carrot and mushrooms in half the oil for 5 minutes until tender, wilt the spinach and remove.
Toss the noodles with the soy sauce, sugar, garlic and remaining oil, then fold in the vegetables.
Scatter with sesame seed and serve warm or at room temperature.

notes: Vegan. Gluten-free if tamari replaces soy sauce.

title: Tuna Kimbap Rolls
summary: Rice and filling rolled in nori, sliced into bite-size rounds.

steps.text: Cook the rice until tender and season with sesame oil, seeds and salt.
Mix the tuna with the mayonnaise.
Spread rice over each nori sheet, leaving a border, and add tuna, carrot and cucumber in a line.
Roll tightly, brush with sesame oil and slice into rounds.

notes: Food safety: keep refrigerated and eat within a day.

title: Doenjang Veggie Stew
summary: Savoury fermented soy paste stew with tofu, zucchini and mushrooms.

steps.text: Whisk the miso into the stock in a pot and bring to a gentle simmer until dissolved.
Add the potato and onion and cook for 8 minutes until almost tender.
Add the zucchini, mushrooms and tofu and simmer for 6 minutes until tender.
Add the chilli and serve with rice.

notes: Vegan.

title: Pumpkin Congee with Ginger
summary: Sweet pumpkin rice porridge, a warm Thai-style breakfast.

steps.text: Simmer the rice, water and ginger for 25 minutes, stirring until thick.
Add the pumpkin and cook for 10 minutes until soft and breaking down.
Season with soy sauce and top with spring onion and shallots.

notes: Vegan.

title: Green Curry Chicken Lunch Bowls
summary: Creamy green curry with chicken, bamboo-style beans and rice.

steps.text: Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy.
Fry the paste in a pot for 2 minutes until fragrant, then add the chicken for 4 minutes until sealed.
Add the milk, stock, beans, fish sauce and sugar and simmer for 12 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir through the basil and serve over rice.

notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C.

title: Charred Wide Noodles with Tofu and Gai Lan
summary: Wide rice noodles charred with soy, greens and tofu.

steps.text: Fry the tofu in half the oil for 5 minutes until golden, then remove.
Stir-fry the garlic and gai lan for 2 minutes, push aside and scramble the eggs until just set.
Add the noodles, sauces and sugar and toss for 4 minutes until the noodles char slightly.
Return the tofu and toss.

notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until set. Vegetarian only if oyster sauce is replaced; contains oyster.

title: Pineapple Coconut Sorbet Cups
summary: Frozen pineapple and coconut sorbet, scooped into fruit cups.

steps.text: Freeze the pineapple until solid.
Blend with the coconut cream, lime juice and icing sugar until smooth.
Freeze for 2 hours until scoopable, then serve topped with coconut.

notes: Dessert. Plus 4 hours freezing. Vegan and gluten-free.

title: Thai Peanut Satay Tofu Skewers
summary: Grilled marinated tofu skewers with peanut satay sauce.

steps.text: Toss the tofu with the soy sauce, turmeric and 1 tbsp satay sauce and rest for 20 minutes.
Thread onto skewers and grill for 10 minutes, turning until golden and charred.
Warm the peanut butter, satay sauce, lime juice and milk until smooth and bubbling.
Serve the skewers with cucumber and sauce.

notes: Vegan. Check satay sauce for gluten if needed.

title: Larb-Style Mushroom Lettuce Cups
summary: Zesty minced mushroom with toasted rice powder, chilli and herbs in lettuce cups.

steps.text: Toast the rice in a dry pan for 3 minutes until golden, then grind to a powder.
Fry the mushrooms in the oil for 8 minutes until browned and dry.
Toss with the lime juice, fish sauce, rice powder, shallot, chilli and herbs.
Spoon into lettuce leaves.

notes: Gluten-free. Use soy sauce for vegan.

title: Egg Pancake Wrap with Rice Noodles
summary: Thin egg crepes filled with vermicelli, herbs and prawns.

steps.text: Soak the vermicelli in boiling water for 4 minutes until tender, then drain.
Whisk the eggs and cook thin crepes in the oil for 1 minute each side until set.
Cook the prawns for 3 minutes until pink and opaque.
Mix the fish sauce, lime juice and sugar and toss through the noodles, carrot and mint.
Fill the crepes with the filling and prawns and roll.

notes: Food safety: prawns must be opaque and pink; eggs set through.

title: Chè Three-Colour Dessert Glass
summary: Layered sweet dessert of red lentil, coconut milk and sweet potato over shaved ice.

steps.text: Simmer the lentils in water for 12 minutes until soft, then mash with half the sugar.
Boil the sweet potato for 8 minutes until tender.
Simmer the coconut milk with the remaining sugar and salt for 5 minutes until slightly thick.
Layer the lentil, sweet potato and ice in glasses and pour over the coconut milk.

notes: Dessert. Vegan and gluten-free.

title: Vietnamese Caramel Pork Rice Pots
summary: Sticky caramelised pork belly with eggs, served with steamed rice.

steps.text: Caramelise the sugar in a pot over medium heat for 5 minutes until deep amber.
Add the pork and brown for 5 minutes, then the fish sauce, garlic and water.
Cover and simmer for 45 minutes, until the pork is very tender.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, peel and add to the pot for 5 minutes.
Cook the rice until fluffy and serve topped with the pork, eggs and spring onion.

notes: Food safety: pork must reach 70°C and be very tender.

title: Fresh Lemongrass Chicken Banh Mi Salad
summary: Lemongrass chicken over rice noodles with fresh herbs.

steps.text: Marinate the chicken in the lemongrass, 1 tbsp fish sauce and half the sugar for 20 minutes.
Fry the chicken for 8 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Soak the vermicelli in boiling water for 4 minutes until tender and drain.
Whisk the remaining fish sauce, sugar and lime juice.
Toss everything together with the herbs.

notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C. Plus 20 minutes marinating.

title: Pho-Style Mushroom Broth
summary: Fragrant star anise and cinnamon vegetable broth with rice noodles and herbs.

steps.text: Char the onion and ginger in a dry pan for 5 minutes until blackened in spots.
Simmer the stock with the charred onion, ginger, star anise and cinnamon for 25 minutes.
Strain, add the mushrooms and soy sauce and simmer for 5 minutes.
Cook the noodles until tender, divide into bowls and ladle over the broth.
Top with sprouts, basil and lime.

notes: Vegan.

title: Coconut Rice Cake
summary: Steamed coconut rice flour cake, soft and chewy.

steps.text: Whisk the flours, milk, water and sugar until smooth.
Pour into a greased tin and steam over simmering water for 30 minutes until set.
Cool completely, slice and scatter with coconut.

notes: Dessert. Vegan and gluten-free.

title: Nasi Goreng Egg Muffins
summary: Little baked egg muffins flavoured like Indonesian fried rice.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C and grease a 6-hole tin.
Mix the rice with the kecap manis, sambal, spring onion and pea.
Press into the holes and top each with a whisked egg.
Bake for 18 minutes until the eggs are set and golden.

notes: Food safety: eggs must be set through. Vegetarian.

title: Soto Ayam Turmeric Broth with Glass Noodles
summary: Turmeric chicken broth with noodles, egg and lime.

steps.text: Simmer the chicken with the water, lemongrass, galangal, turmeric and lime leaf for 30 minutes.
Remove the chicken and shred it, discarding bones.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, peel and halve.
Soak the noodles in hot water until tender.
Assemble bowls with noodles, chicken, egg and sprouts and ladle over the hot broth.

notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C.

title: Perkedel Corn and Potato Patties
summary: Crisp spiced potato and corn patties served with sambal.

steps.text: Boil the potato for 12 minutes until tender, drain and mash.
Mix in the corn, egg, spring onion, garlic and coriander and shape into 8 patties.
Fry in oil over medium heat for 4 minutes each side until golden.
Serve the patties hot with a spoonful of sambal on the side.

notes: Vegetarian.

title: Serabi Coconut Pancakes
summary: Tiny soft coconut-milk pancakes with a crisp base.

steps.text: Whisk the flour, milk, water, sugar, baking powder and salt into a smooth batter and rest.
Heat a small pan and pour in a ladleful, cover and cook for 4 minutes until holes appear and the base is golden.
Repeat, then serve with palm sugar syrup (simmered with a spoonful of water until syrupy).

notes: Plus 20 minutes resting. Vegan; gluten-free if you use gluten-free baking powder.

title: Malaysian Chicken Rice Bowls
summary: Poached chicken with fragrant rice, ginger sauce and cucumber.

steps.text: Poach the chicken in simmering stock with the ginger for 25 minutes until cooked through.
Fry the garlic in the sesame oil until golden and cook the rice in 2 cups of the stock until fluffy.
Mix the grated ginger, soy sauce and a spoon of stock into a dipping sauce.
Slice the chicken and serve with rice, cucumber and sauce.

notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C and juices run clear.

title: Sambal Eggplant Rice Plates
summary: Soft eggplant coated in tangy sambal with rice.

steps.text: Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy.
Fry the eggplant in the oil for 10 minutes until golden and soft.
Add the garlic, sambal, tamarind and sugar and cook for 3 minutes until sticky.
Stir through the basil and serve over rice.

notes: Vegan and gluten-free.

title: Filipino Garlic Rice and Egg Breakfast Plates
summary: Crunchy garlic fried rice with fried eggs and tomato.

steps.text: Fry the garlic in the oil for 2 minutes until golden and crisp.
Add the rice and soy sauce and stir for 4 minutes until heated through and toasty.
Fry the eggs separately for 3 minutes until the whites are set.
Serve with tomato and spring onion.

notes: Food safety: cool leftover rice and refrigerate within 1 hour; cook eggs until the whites are firm. Vegetarian.

title: Pork Adobo Lunch Bowls
summary: Soy and vinegar braised pork with garlic and bay, served over rice.

steps.text: Combine the pork, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, bay leaf, pepper and water in a pot.
Simmer covered for 40 minutes until the pork is tender.
Uncover and cook for 8 minutes until the sauce reduces and the pork browns.
Cook the rice until fluffy and serve with the pork and sauce.

notes: Food safety: pork must reach 70°C and be very tender.

title: Purple Sweet Potato Halo-Halo Cups
summary: Layered shaved ice dessert with sweet potato, coconut and evaporated milk.

steps.text: Boil the sweet potato for 12 minutes until very soft, drain and mash with sugar.
Layer sweet potato, raisin and ice in tall glasses.
Pour over the milks and top with coconut.

notes: Dessert. Vegetarian and gluten-free.

title: Chana Masala Pita Pockets
summary: Spiced chickpea curry stuffed into warm pita with yoghurt.

steps.text: Fry the onion in the oil for 6 minutes until golden, add the paste and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomato and cook for 5 minutes until jammy, then the chickpeas and 1/2 cup water.
Simmer for 8 minutes until thick.
Warm the pita, fill with chickpeas and top with yoghurt and coriander.

notes: Vegetarian.

title: Vegan Coconut Dal Soup
summary: Creamy red lentil and coconut milk soup with turmeric.

steps.text: Fry the cumin and onion in the oil for 5 minutes until soft, add the garlic, ginger and turmeric for 1 minute.
Add the lentils and stock and simmer for 15 minutes until soft.
Stir in the milk and blend if you like, then finish with lime juice.

notes: Vegan and gluten-free.

title: Spiced Pumpkin Samosa Pastries
summary: Baked pastry parcels with spiced pumpkin and peas.

steps.text: Roast the pumpkin at 200°C for 15 minutes until tender.
Fry the onion, cumin and garam masala in the oil for 5 minutes, add pumpkin and peas and mash lightly.
Cut the pastry into triangles, fill and seal.
Brush with egg and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden.

notes: Vegetarian.

title: Egg Bhurji Breakfast Wraps
summary: Spiced Indian scrambled egg in warm rotis.

steps.text: Fry the onion and chilli in the ghee for 4 minutes until soft.
Add the tomato and spices for 2 minutes, then pour in the beaten eggs.
Stir for 3 minutes until fully set, then fold in the coriander.
Spoon into warm rotis and roll up.

notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until firm and fully set. Vegetarian.

title: Gajar Halwa Carrot Pudding
summary: Slow-cooked carrot pudding with milk, ghee and cardamom.

steps.text: Cook the carrot in the ghee for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the milk and simmer for 25 minutes, stirring until the milk is absorbed.
Stir in the sugar, cardamom and raisins and cook for 5 minutes until thick, then top with pistachio.

notes: Dessert. Vegetarian and gluten-free.

title: Lamb Rogan Josh Pots
summary: Mild, rich lamb curry with Kashmiri chilli and yoghurt.

steps.text: Brown the lamb in the ghee in batches until golden, then remove.
Fry the onions for 8 minutes until deep golden, add the paste and spices for 1 minute.
Return the lamb, add the yoghurt, tomatoes and water.
Simmer covered for 75 minutes until the lamb is very tender.

notes: Food safety: braise lamb until very tender, well above 70°C.

title: Aloo Gobi Sheet-Pan Bake
summary: Spiced potato and cauliflower roasted with turmeric and cumin.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan) and line a large tray.
