Toss everything except the coriander and lime with the oil and salt on a tray.
Roast for 35 minutes, turning once, until golden and tender.
Finish with coriander and lime.

notes: Vegan and gluten-free.

title: Mango Lassi Overnight Oats
summary: Chilled oats soaked in yoghurt and mango, a cooling breakfast.

steps.text: Mix the oats, yoghurt, milk, cardamom and honey in a jar.
Chill overnight until thick.
Top each jar with diced mango and serve cold.

notes: Plus overnight soaking. Vegetarian.

title: Ethiopian-Style Spiced Chicken and Egg
summary: Mild chicken and boiled eggs in an onion and paprika sauce.

steps.text: Cook the onions in a dry pot for 10 minutes until soft and golden, add the ghee, paste and spices for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken and water and simmer for 30 minutes until cooked through.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, peel and add to the pot.
Simmer for 5 minutes to warm through.

notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C.

title: Tanzanian Coconut Rice with Peas
summary: Fragrant coconut rice cooked with cardamom and peas.

steps.text: Rinse the rice under cold water until it runs clear.
Bring the milk, water, spices and salt to the boil, add the rice and cover until simmering gently.
Cook on low for 15 minutes until the liquid is absorbed, then add the peas.
Rest off the heat for 5 minutes until fluffy and serve.

notes: Vegan and gluten-free.

title: Ugandan Rolex Egg Wraps
summary: Egg omelette rolled inside a warm flatbread with tomato and cabbage.

steps.text: Whisk the eggs with the tomato, cabbage and onion.
Cook in the oil over medium heat for 3 minutes until set, then lay a roti on top and flip.
Roll up tightly and slice.

notes: Food safety: eggs must be fully set. Vegetarian.

title: Malva Pudding with Apricot Sauce
summary: Warm sponge pudding soaked in a creamy apricot sauce.

steps.text: Whisk the eggs and half the sugar, beat in the jam, butter, flour and bicarbonate of soda.
Pour into a dish and bake at 180°C for 30 minutes until risen and golden.
Heat the cream, milk, remaining sugar and water until warm.
Pour over the hot pudding and let it soak.

notes: Dessert. Vegetarian.

title: Mealie Cornbread with Chilli Butter
summary: Moist cornbread with sweet corn, brushed with chilli butter.

steps.text: Mix the polenta, flour, baking powder, corn, milk and eggs.
Pour into a lined tin and bake at 200°C for 30 minutes until golden and set.
Melt the butter with the chilli for 1 minute and brush over.

notes: Vegetarian.

title: Sosatie Skewers with Apricot Glaze
summary: Marinated lamb and apricot skewers grilled until sticky.

steps.text: Mix the jam, curry powder, vinegar and oil and coat the lamb.
Thread the lamb, onion and apricot onto skewers.
Grill for 12 minutes, turning until browned and cooked through.

notes: Food safety: lamb pieces must reach 70°C. Plus 2 hours marinating.

title: Fijian Kokoda Fish Salad
summary: Lime-cured fish with coconut cream and fresh vegetables.

steps.text: Cure the fish in lime juice for 30 minutes until opaque.
Drain, then fold in the coconut cream and vegetables.
Chill for 15 minutes until cold and serve in small bowls.

notes: Food safety: fish should turn opaque with the acid; use very fresh fish. Plus 30 minutes curing. Gluten-free. Use very fresh, well-chilled seafood for anything served raw or lightly cured, and serve it straight away; pregnant women, older people, young children and anyone with low immunity should avoid raw fish.

title: Tongan Lu Sipi Style Lamb Parcels
summary: Lamb and coconut cream steamed in foil with onions.

steps.text: Mix the lamb with the onion, ginger and salt, then divide onto foil sheets.
Spoon over the coconut cream and seal tightly.
Bake at 170°C for 90 minutes until the lamb is very tender.

notes: Food safety: lamb must reach 70°C and be very tender. Gluten-free.

title: Five-Spice Roast Duck Leg Rice Plates
summary: Crisp-skinned duck legs rubbed with five spice, served on rice with greens.

steps.text: Rub the duck with the salt, five spice and ginger and rest in the fridge.
Roast at 160°C for 90 minutes until the meat is tender.
Brush with soy sauce and honey and roast at 220°C for 15 minutes until the skin is crisp and mahogany.
Cook the rice until fluffy and steam the bok choy for 3 minutes until tender.
Serve the duck over rice with the greens.

notes: Food safety: duck legs must reach 75°C and be very tender. Plus 2 hours curing.

title: Wok Cashew Chicken with Crisp Capsicum
summary: Quick wok chicken with cashews and crisp capsicum in a savoury sauce.

steps.text: Toss the chicken in the cornflour and soy sauce.
Stir-fry the cashews in the oil until golden, about 1 minute, then remove.
Cook the chicken for 5 minutes until browned and cooked through, then add the onion, capsicum and garlic for 3 minutes until crisp-tender.
Add the oyster sauce and cashews, toss and serve over rice cooked until fluffy.

notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C throughout.

title: Stir-Fried Beef and Gai Lan in Oyster Sauce
summary: Silky beef with crisp gai lan and a glossy oyster sauce.

steps.text: Toss the beef with the cornflour and soy sauce.
Stir-fry the beef in the oil in batches for 2 minutes until just browned.
Add the garlic, ginger and gai lan with a splash of water for 3 minutes until tender-crisp.
Return the beef, add the oyster sauce and toss until glossy. Serve with rice.

notes: Food safety: sear beef until browned, at least 71°C.

title: Spring Onion Oil Noodles
summary: Noodles tossed in sizzling spring onion oil and soy.

steps.text: Boil the noodles for 4 minutes until tender, then drain.
Heat the oil with the spring onion over low heat for 8 minutes until the onion is crisp and golden.
Stir in the soy sauces and sugar and toss through the noodles until coated.

notes: Vegan.

title: Walnut Sticky Rice Cake
summary: Steamed sticky rice cake with walnuts and brown sugar, sliced and pan-fried.

steps.text: Mix the flour, water and sugar until smooth and fold in the walnut.
Steam in a lined tin for 35 minutes until firm and translucent.
Cool, slice and pan-fry in the oil for 3 minutes each side until crisp outside.

notes: Dessert. Plus 1 hour cooling. Vegan and gluten-free.

title: Tofu Skin Vegetable Rolls
summary: Crisp pan-fried tofu skin rolls with mushrooms and carrot.

steps.text: Stir-fry the mushroom, carrot, tofu and sprouts with the soy sauce and sesame oil for 5 minutes until dry, then cool.
Roll the filling in the wrappers, sealing with water.
Shallow-fry in oil for 5 minutes, turning until golden and crisp.

notes: Vegan.

title: Temaki Hand Roll Sushi Night
summary: Hand-rolled nori cones with sushi rice, cucumber, avocado and salmon.

steps.text: Cook the rice until tender and fold through the vinegar, sugar and a pinch of salt while warm; cool.
Halve the nori sheets with scissors and keep them dry.
Spread rice on one half, add salmon, avocado and cucumber, and roll into a cone.
Serve with soy sauce and wasabi.

notes: Food safety: smoked salmon is ready-to-eat; pregnant people should avoid it.

title: Saikoro Beef Rice with Garlic
summary: Garlic-seared diced beef steak over rice with soy butter.

steps.text: Cook the rice until tender.
Sear the beef in a very hot pan for 3 minutes until browned, adding the garlic for the last minute until golden.
Add the soy sauce, mirin and butter and toss for 1 minute until glossy.
Spoon over the rice and top with spring onion.

notes: Food safety: beef pieces should reach 63°C for medium or higher for well done.

title: Chilled Silken Tofu with Ginger Soy
summary: Cold silken tofu with a punchy ginger-soy dressing.

steps.text: Drain the tofu and slide onto a plate, chill until cold.
Mix the soy sauce, ginger and sesame oil.
Top with spring onion, bonito and sesame and spoon over the dressing.

notes: Gluten-free if tamari is used. Not vegetarian: bonito.

title: Anpan Soft Bread with Sweet Filling
summary: Soft buns baked with a sweet potato filling.

steps.text: Boil the sweet potato for 12 minutes until soft, mash with the honey and cool.
Knead the flour, sugar, yeast, milk, butter and egg for 10 minutes into a smooth dough; rise until doubled.
Divide into 8, wrap each around a spoonful of filling and place on a tray.
Prove for 30 minutes, brush with egg, add sesame and bake at 180°C for 18 minutes until golden.

notes: Dessert. Plus 90 minutes rising. Vegetarian.

title: Cabbage and Pork Gyoza Soup
summary: Pan-fried gyoza served in a clear ginger broth.

steps.text: Mix the pork, cabbage, ginger and soy sauce and fold into the wrappers.
Brown the gyoza in the oil for 2 minutes until golden underneath.
Pour in the stock, cover and simmer for 8 minutes until the filling is cooked through.
Top with spring onion and sesame oil.

notes: Food safety: pork mince must reach 75°C.

title: Sakura Rice Pudding
summary: Creamy baked rice pudding with vanilla and a hint of rose.

steps.text: Combine the rice, milk, sugar and butter in a baking dish.
Bake at 160°C for 45 minutes, stirring once, until creamy and soft.
Stir in the vanilla and rose water and serve warm.

notes: Dessert. Vegetarian and gluten-free.

title: Seaweed Rice Balls with Tuna Mayo Filling
summary: Onigiri filled with tuna mayo and wrapped in nori.

steps.text: Cook the rice until tender and cool until warm.
Mix the tuna, mayonnaise and soy sauce.
Wet your hands, shape rice around a spoonful of filling into triangles.
Wrap with nori strips and sprinkle with sesame.

notes: Food safety: keep refrigerated and eat within a day; cool cooked rice quickly.

title: Double-Fried Gochujang Honey Wings
summary: Double-fried crunchy wings tossed in a sweet-spicy glaze.

steps.text: Toss the wings in the cornflour and salt.
Fry in oil at 160°C for 10 minutes, rest, then fry again at 190°C for 5 minutes until deep golden and crisp.
Simmer the gochujang, honey, soy and garlic for 3 minutes until syrupy.
Toss the wings in the glaze and sprinkle with sesame.

notes: Food safety: wings must reach 75°C throughout.

title: Egg and Cheese Gyeran-ppang Bread
summary: Savoury Korean egg bread baked with a whole egg on top.

steps.text: Mix the flour, milk, baking powder, sugar, 1 egg and butter into a batter.
Pour into greased muffin holes, crack an egg on top of each and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake at 190°C for 18 minutes until the egg is set and the bread golden.

notes: Food safety: bake until the whites are set and yolks firm. Vegetarian. Wash fresh produce well, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat them within 3 days.

title: Spicy Silken Tofu Pot with Cracked Egg
summary: Spicy soft tofu stew with mushrooms and a cracked egg.

steps.text: Fry the garlic and gochugaru in the sesame oil for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the stock, soy sauce and mushrooms and simmer for 6 minutes.
Add the tofu in big spoonfuls and simmer for 4 minutes until hot.
Crack in the egg, cover and cook for 2 minutes until the white is set; top with spring onion.

notes: Food safety: egg white must be set.

title: Sweet Potato Noodle Salad with Peanut Dressing
summary: Glass noodles with sweet potato, carrot and a sesame peanut dressing.

steps.text: Boil the sweet potato for 8 minutes until tender, drain.
Boil the noodles for 6 minutes until clear and soft, rinse and drain.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy, vinegar and sesame oil into a dressing.
Toss with everything and sprinkle with sesame.

notes: Vegan.

title: Kkwabaegi Twisted Doughnuts
summary: Fried twisted doughnuts dusted with cinnamon sugar.

steps.text: Knead the flour, yeast, milk, caster sugar, egg and a pinch of salt for 8 minutes until smooth; rise until doubled.
Divide into 8 ropes and twist each.
Fry in oil at 170°C for 3 minutes each side until golden.
Roll in the cinnamon sugar while hot.

notes: Dessert. Plus 1 hour rising. Vegetarian.

title: Pad Krapow Egg Rice Bowls
summary: Fiery holy basil pork with fried egg on rice.

steps.text: Cook the rice until fluffy.
Stir-fry the garlic and chilli in the oil for 30 seconds, then the pork for 5 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Add the oyster sauce, fish sauce and sugar and cook for 1 minute, then stir in the basil.
Fry the eggs until the whites are set and serve on top.

notes: Food safety: pork mince must reach 75°C.

title: Massaman Sweet Potato Curry
summary: Mild peanut-rich curry with sweet potato, potato and onion.

steps.text: Fry the paste for 2 minutes until fragrant, then add the milk and stock.
Add the potatoes, onion, tamarind and sugar and simmer for 22 minutes until tender.
Stir in the peanuts and serve over rice cooked until fluffy.

notes: Many massaman pastes contain shrimp paste; check the label, or use a vegan paste, to keep it vegan.

title: Grilled Pork Skewers with Sticky Rice
summary: Honey-glazed pork skewers served with sticky rice and sweet chilli.

steps.text: Mix the fish sauce, honey, garlic and crushed coriander seed and coat the pork.
Thread the pork onto skewers, leaving a little space between pieces.
Grill for 10 minutes, turning until charred and cooked through.
Steam the rice until tender and serve together with sweet chilli sauce.

notes: Food safety: pork must reach 70°C and the juices run clear. Plus 1 hour marinating.

title: Coconut Pancakes with Palm Sugar
summary: Soft coconut pancakes with a caramel drizzle.

steps.text: Whisk the flour, baking powder, milk, egg and half the sugar into a batter.
Cook spoonfuls in the oil for 3 minutes each side until golden.
Melt the remaining sugar with 2 tbsp water for 3 minutes until syrupy.
Drizzle the syrup over and scatter with coconut.

notes: Vegetarian.

title: Yellow Curry Cauliflower Lunch Pots
summary: Mild turmeric curry with cauliflower and potato.

steps.text: Fry the onion, curry powder and paste for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Add the milk, stock, fish sauce, potato and cauliflower.
Simmer for 20 minutes until tender.

notes: Gluten-free.

title: Egg-Stuffed Rice Paper Fritters
summary: Crisp rice paper pockets filled with egg and vermicelli.

steps.text: Soak the vermicelli until tender and mix with the eggs, spring onion and fish sauce.
Soften wrappers in water, fill with the mixture and fold into parcels.
Fry in oil for 3 minutes each side until golden, crisp and the egg is set.

notes: Food safety: eggs must be set through. Gluten-free.

title: Vietnamese Chicken Congee
summary: Silky rice porridge with shredded chicken, ginger and herbs.

steps.text: Simmer the rice, water and ginger for 25 minutes, stirring until thick.
Add the chicken and cook for 15 minutes until cooked through, then shred and return.
Season with fish sauce and serve topped with herbs and lime.

notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C.

title: Turmeric Fish with Dill and Noodles
summary: Pan-fried turmeric fish served over rice vermicelli with dill.

steps.text: Coat the fish in the turmeric, 1 tbsp fish sauce and ginger for 15 minutes.
Fry in the oil for 4 minutes each side until golden and flaking.
Soak the vermicelli until tender and divide into bowls.
Top with fish, dill, spring onion, peanuts and the remaining fish sauce.

notes: Food safety: fish is cooked when opaque and flakes easily at 63°C. Plus 15 minutes marinating. Gluten-free.

title: Coconut Bread Pudding
summary: Warm coconut bread pudding with sultanas.

steps.text: Tear the bread into a dish and scatter with sultanas.
Whisk the milks, eggs, sugar and vanilla and pour over, then soak for 10 minutes.
Bake at 170°C for 30 minutes until set and golden.

notes: Dessert. Vegetarian. Food safety: bake until the custard is firm.

title: Gudeg-Style Sweet Pumpkin Stew
summary: Sweet coconut-braised pumpkin with egg and tofu.

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, peel and set aside.
Simmer the pumpkin, milk, water, sugar, garlic, onion and bay for 20 minutes until the pumpkin is tender.
Add the tofu and eggs and cook for 8 minutes until the sauce thickens.

notes: Vegetarian and gluten-free. Food safety: boil eggs until firm.

title: Slow Coconut Beef Dry Curry
summary: Dry-style coconut beef braise with lemongrass and chilli.

steps.text: Toast the coconut in a dry pan for 3 minutes until brown and grind to a paste.
Blend the shallot, garlic, galangal and chilli to a paste and fry for 5 minutes.
Add the beef, coconut milk, lemongrass, lime leaf and sugar and simmer gently for 2 hours.
Cook uncovered for 30 minutes until the sauce is dry and the beef is dark and tender.

notes: Food safety: braise beef until very tender, above 71°C. Gluten-free.

title: Corn Fritter Rice Bowls with Sambal
summary: Crisp corn fritters served over rice with fried egg and sambal.

steps.text: Mix the corn, flour, 1 egg and spring onion into a batter.
Fry spoonfuls in oil for 3 minutes each side until golden; keep warm.
Fry the 3 eggs until the whites are set.
Serve over rice cooked until fluffy with sambal.

notes: Food safety: eggs cooked until the whites are set. Vegetarian.

title: Black Rice Pudding Jars
summary: Overnight black rice and coconut jars with palm sugar.

steps.text: Soak the rice overnight and drain.
Simmer with the water for 30 minutes until the grains are soft and the liquid thickens.
Stir in the sugar and chill with the milk poured over; top with mango.

notes: Plus overnight soaking. Vegan and gluten-free.

title: Mee Goreng Hawker Egg Noodles
summary: Wok-fried egg noodles with greens, egg and sweet soy.

steps.text: Stir-fry the garlic and sambal in the oil for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the noodles and bok choy for 3 minutes until hot and tender.
Push aside and scramble the eggs until set, then toss with kecap manis and sprouts.

notes: Food safety: eggs cooked firm. Vegetarian.

title: Kuih Ketayap Coconut Crepes
summary: Thin crepes rolled around sweet palm sugar coconut.

steps.text: Whisk the flour, milk, water, egg and a pinch of salt into a thin batter.
Simmer the coconut and sugar with 2 tbsp water for 5 minutes until sticky.
Cook thin crepes in a lightly oiled pan for 1 minute each side until set.
Fill with the coconut and roll up.

notes: Dessert. Vegetarian.

title: Coconut Rice Plates with Chilli Eggs and Peanuts
summary: Fragrant coconut rice with sambal egg, cucumber and peanuts.

steps.text: Cook the rice with the milk, water and salt, covered, for 15 minutes until absorbed.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes and peel.
Warm the sambal and toss the eggs in it for 2 minutes until coated.
Serve with cucumber and peanuts.

notes: Food safety: boil eggs until firm. Vegetarian and gluten-free.

title: Chicken Sinigang Sour Soup
summary: Tamarind-soured broth with chicken and greens.

steps.text: Simmer the chicken with the water, tomato and onion for 15 minutes.
Stir in the tamarind and daikon and cook for 10 minutes until the daikon is tender.
Add the beans and spinach and cook for 3 minutes; season with fish sauce.

notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C.

title: Garlic Longganisa-Style Sausage Patties
summary: Sweet-garlicky pork patties for breakfast with rice.

steps.text: Mix the pork with the garlic, sugar, soy, vinegar and pepper and form into 8 patties.
Fry in the oil for 5 minutes each side until browned and cooked through.
Serve the hot patties with steamed rice on the side.

notes: Food safety: pork patties must reach 75°C. Plus 1 hour marinating.

title: Coconut Macaroon Mounds
summary: Chewy coconut macaroons with a golden top.

steps.text: Mix the coconut, whisked egg whites, sugar, vanilla and salt.
Scoop heaped tablespoons onto a lined baking tray.
Bake at 170°C for 15 minutes until golden at the edges.

notes: Dessert. Vegetarian and gluten-free.

title: Pancit Canton-Style Noodle Plates
summary: Stir-fried egg noodles with vegetables and chicken.

steps.text: Stir-fry the chicken in the oil for 5 minutes until cooked through, then add the garlic and vegetables for 3 minutes.
Add the stock, soy and oyster sauces and bring to a simmer until bubbling.
Add the noodles and toss for 4 minutes until the liquid is absorbed.

notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C.

title: Spiced Cauliflower Pakora with Mint Dip
summary: Crisp chickpea-batter cauliflower fritters.

steps.text: Whisk the flour, water, spices and salt into a thick batter.
Coat the cauliflower and fry in oil at 180°C for 5 minutes until golden and crisp.
Mix the yoghurt with the chutney and serve alongside.

notes: Vegetarian and gluten-free.

title: Creamy Tomato Chicken Flatbread Wraps
summary: Creamy tomato butter chicken in warm flatbread with cucumber.

steps.text: Brown the chicken in the butter for 5 minutes, add the paste and spices for 1 minute.
Add the passata and simmer for 12 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce thickens.
Stir in the cream, then spoon into flatbreads with cucumber.

notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C.

title: Lemon Rice with Peanuts
summary: South Indian tempered lemon rice with curry leaves.

steps.text: Cook the rice until fluffy and spread to cool.
Fry the mustard seed, curry leaf, peanuts and chilli in the ghee for 2 minutes until the seeds pop.
Stir in the turmeric, lemon juice and rice until the colour is even.

notes: Vegetarian and gluten-free. Food safety: cool leftover rice quickly and refrigerate within 1 hour.

title: Chickpea Flour Omelette Wraps
summary: Vegan savoury pancakes with onion, tomato and coriander.

steps.text: Whisk the flour, water, turmeric and salt into a smooth batter and stir in the onion, tomato, chilli and coriander.
Cook half the batter in the oil for 3 minutes each side until golden and set.
Repeat with the remaining batter and serve the pancakes warm.

notes: Vegan and gluten-free.

title: Kheer Rice Pudding with Pistachio
summary: Slow-simmered cardamom rice pudding.

steps.text: Simmer the rice and milk with the cardamom for 35 minutes, stirring until thick and creamy.
Stir in the sugar and raisins and cook for 5 minutes.
Serve topped with pistachio.

notes: Dessert. Vegetarian and gluten-free.

title: Dhal Tadka Rice Bowls
summary: Yellow-style red lentil dhal with spiced garlic butter.

steps.text: Simmer the lentils with the water, turmeric and tomato for 22 minutes until soft.
Fry the garlic, cumin and chilli in the ghee for 2 minutes until golden and spoon over the dhal.
Cook the rice until fluffy and serve.

notes: Vegetarian and gluten-free.

title: Coconut Prawn Curry with Curry Leaves
summary: Southern prawn curry in coconut milk.

steps.text: Fry the onion in the oil for 5 minutes until soft, add the garlic, ginger, curry leaf and turmeric for 1 minute.
Add the milk and tamarind and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the prawns and cook for 4 minutes until pink and opaque.
Serve over fluffy rice with extra coriander if you like.

notes: Food safety: prawns must be opaque and pink, at 63°C. Gluten-free.

title: Sri Lankan Pol Roti Coconut Flatbreads
summary: Simple coconut flatbreads cooked on a hot pan.

steps.text: Mix the flour, coconut, chilli, onion and salt, add water to a soft dough and rest for 10 minutes.
Divide and roll into 8 flat discs about 3mm thick.
Cook in a hot dry pan for 2 minutes each side until blistered and cooked through.

notes: Vegan.

title: Cardamom Biscuits for Chai Time
summary: Crisp buttery biscuits flavoured with cardamom and cinnamon.

steps.text: Cream the butter and sugar until pale, mix in the yolk and spices.
Stir in the flour to a soft dough and roll out.
Cut into rounds and bake at 170°C for 14 minutes until golden at the edges.

notes: Dessert. Vegetarian.

title: Zanzibar-Style Tomato Coconut Fish Pot
summary: Mild coconut curry with white fish, tomato and lime.

steps.text: Fry the onion in a pot until soft, about 5 minutes, add the garlic and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the tomato and milk and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the fish and cook for 5 minutes until opaque and flaking.
Finish with lime and coriander and serve over fluffy rice.

notes: Food safety: fish is cooked when opaque and flakes easily, at 63°C. Gluten-free.

title: Sukuma Wiki with Egg and Ugali-Style Polenta
summary: Garlicky braised greens with fried egg and polenta.

steps.text: Cook the polenta in the boiling water for 10 minutes, stirring until very thick.
Fry the onion in the oil for 4 minutes, add the tomato for 3 minutes and then the kale for 6 minutes until tender.
Fry the eggs until the whites are set and serve on the greens with polenta.

notes: Vegetarian and gluten-free. Food safety: cook the egg whites until set.

title: Chapati Wraps with Curried Potato and Peas
summary: Soft Kenyan-style flatbread wrapped around curried potato.

steps.text: Knead the flour, water, oil and salt into a soft dough; rest for 20 minutes.
Boil the potato for 12 minutes until tender, drain.
Fry the onion and curry powder for 4 minutes, add the potato and pea and mash lightly.
Roll the dough into discs and cook in a dry pan for 2 minutes each side until blistered.
Spoon the filling onto the chapati and wrap it up to serve.

notes: Vegan.

title: Apricot Almond Chicken Drumstick Pot
summary: Gently spiced chicken with apricots and almonds.

steps.text: Brown the chicken in the butter for 6 minutes, remove.
Fry the onion and curry powder for 4 minutes until soft, add the stock and apricots and return the chicken.
Simmer covered for 25 minutes until cooked through; scatter with almonds.
Serve over fluffy rice with extra coriander if you like.

notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C.

title: Honey Rusks
summary: Hard twice-baked rusks for dunking in tea.

steps.text: Rub the butter into the flour, baking powder and sugar.
Mix in the egg, buttermilk and honey to a soft dough and press into a tin.
Bake at 180°C for 35 minutes until golden, cool and cut into fingers.
Dry in a 100°C oven for 60 minutes until hard and crisp.

notes: Vegetarian.

title: Spiced Samoan Coconut Rice Pudding
summary: Baked coconut rice with cinnamon and vanilla.

steps.text: Rinse the rice under cold water until it runs clear.
Combine the rice, milk, water and sugar in a pot and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring until thick.
Stir in the vanilla and cinnamon and serve warm.

notes: Dessert. Vegan and gluten-free.

title: Hawaiian-Style Pineapple Chicken Skewers
summary: Teriyaki-pineapple chicken skewers, grilled until charred.

steps.text: Marinate the chicken in the teriyaki sauce and ginger.
Thread onto skewers with the pineapple and capsicum.
Grill for 12 minutes, turning until charred and cooked through.
Serve with rice cooked until fluffy.

notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C. Plus 30 minutes marinating.

title: Cassava Coconut Pancakes
summary: Pancakes made with cassava flour and coconut milk.

steps.text: Whisk everything except the oil until smooth.
Cook spoonfuls in the oil for 3 minutes each side until golden.
Serve with extra maple syrup.

notes: Vegetarian; gluten-free if you use gluten-free baking powder.

title: Crisp-Skin Soy Glazed Roast Chicken
summary: A whole chicken dried, glazed with soy and honey and roasted until the skin crackles.

steps.text: Pat the chicken very dry, then rub the salt and five spice inside and out. Stuff the cavity with the spring onion and ginger.
Whisk the soy sauce, honey, wine and vinegar, brush a first coat over the skin and leave uncovered in the fridge to dry the skin.
Heat the oven to 200°C. Roast the chicken on a rack for 25 minutes, then brush with more glaze.
Lower the oven to 180°C and roast for 45 minutes more, glazing twice, until the skin is deep mahogany and crisp.
Check the thickest part of the thigh reads 75°C, then rest the chicken for 15 minutes before carving.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and serve with the carved chicken and the pan juices.

notes: Food safety: the thickest part of the thigh must reach 75°C and the juices run clear. Plus 3 hours drying in the fridge.
Dinner. Dairy-free.

title: Hand-Torn Noodles with Braised Beef Shin
summary: Chewy hand-torn dough ribbons tossed through tender soy-braised beef shin and bok choy.

steps.text: Brown the beef in 1 tbsp of the oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat for 6 minutes until deeply coloured, then set aside.
Fry the ginger, garlic, star anise and doubanjiang in the pot for 1 minute until fragrant, then return the beef.
Add both soy sauces, the wine and 3 cups of water. Cover and simmer gently for 2 hours until the beef is fork-tender.
Knead the flour with 1 cup of water for 8 minutes until smooth, rub with the remaining oil, cover and rest.
Roll the dough out thin, tear into postcard-sized pieces and boil in a large pot of water for 3 minutes until they float and are chewy.
Add the bok choy to the braise for the last 2 minutes, then toss the noodles through the beef and sauce.
Serve topped with spring onion.

notes: Food safety: braise the beef until it is very tender and reads at least 75°C in the centre. Plus 30 minutes resting the dough.
Dinner. Dairy-free.

title: Prawn and Avocado Sushi Roll Platter
summary: Hand-rolled maki and inside-out rolls of cooked prawn, avocado, cucumber and sweet omelette.

steps.text: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear, cook it with the lid on until tender, then rest for 10 minutes.
Warm the vinegar, sugar and salt until dissolved, fold through the hot rice and fan until cooled to room temperature.
Beat the eggs with the mirin and cook as a thin omelette in a lightly oiled pan over low heat until just set, then slice into strips.
Lay a nori sheet on a bamboo mat, spread with a thin layer of rice and add a line of prawn, avocado, cucumber or omelette.
Roll tightly, wet the edge to seal, and make 6 rolls. For two of them, roll the rice outside and coat in sesame seed.
Cut each roll into 8 with a wet sharp knife and serve with soy sauce, pickled ginger and wasabi.

notes: Food safety: use pre-cooked prawns kept chilled, and eat the rolls the same day. The omelette is cooked until fully set.
Dinner. Dairy-free.

title: Bossam-Style Pork Belly Wraps with Kimchi
summary: Gently simmered pork belly sliced thin and wrapped in lettuce with ssamjang and kimchi.

items.raw: 2 spring onion, cut into thin strips

steps.text: Put the pork, onion, ginger, garlic, miso paste, soy sauce and sugar in a pot and cover with water by 3cm.
Bring to the boil, then simmer gently for 90 minutes until a skewer slides easily through the pork.
Lift the pork out and rest for 15 minutes, then slice it into 5mm pieces.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender.
Serve the pork with lettuce leaves, rice, ssamjang, kimchi and spring onion so everyone can build their own wraps.

notes: Food safety: the pork is cooked once it reaches 75°C in the thickest part and is tender throughout. Plus 15 minutes resting.
Dinner. Dairy-free.

title: Lamb Biryani Layered Dum Pot
summary: Marinated lamb and saffron rice layered with fried onion and mint, then sealed and steamed on low heat.

steps.text: Mix the lamb with the yoghurt, ginger garlic paste, garam masala, turmeric, chilli powder and 1 tsp salt, and leave to marinate.
Fry the onion in the oil over medium heat for 15 minutes until deep golden and crisp, then lift out and set half aside.
Soak the rice for 20 minutes, then parboil with the clove, cardamom, cinnamon and remaining salt for 5 minutes until almost cooked, and drain.
Warm the milk and steep the saffron in it. Layer the lamb and its marinade in a heavy pot, add half the onion, the mint and coriander.
Cover with the rice, drizzle with saffron milk and scatter with the reserved onion.
Seal the pot tightly with foil and a lid, cook on the lowest heat for 60 minutes until the lamb is tender.
Rest for 10 minutes, then gently fold from the bottom and serve.

notes: Food safety: the lamb should be tender and reach at least 70°C in the centre of the largest piece. Plus 4 hours marinating.
Dinner.

title: Crispy Fish with Sweet Sour Chilli Sauce
summary: Cornflour-dusted fish fillets fried until crisp and glazed with a tangy sweet chilli sauce.

steps.text: Pat the fish very dry, season with the salt and press into the cornflour until evenly coated.
Heat the oil in a wide pan to 180°C and fry the fish for 4 minutes each side until golden, crisp and the flesh flakes easily.
Drain on a rack, then pour off all but 1 tbsp of oil from the pan.
Fry the garlic and chilli for 30 seconds, add the sweet chilli sauce, fish sauce and lime juice and bubble for 2 minutes until glossy.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Spoon the sauce over the fish and serve with coriander, cucumber and rice.

notes: Food safety: the fish is cooked when the flesh turns opaque and flakes easily with a fork.
Dinner. Dairy-free.

title: Banh Xeo Turmeric Crepes with Prawn
summary: Crisp coconut turmeric crepes folded around prawns, sprouts and herbs, wrapped in lettuce to eat.

steps.text: Whisk the rice flour, turmeric, coconut milk, water and spring onion into a thin batter and rest.
Fry the pork mince in a little oil over high heat for 4 minutes until browned and cooked through, then add the prawns for 2 minutes until pink and opaque.
Heat a non-stick pan with a spoonful of oil until very hot, pour in a ladle of batter and swirl thin.
Add a spoonful of the prawn and pork mix and a handful of sprouts, cover for 2 minutes, then uncover until the edge is crisp and golden.
Fold the crepe in half and repeat for 8 crepes in total.
Stir the fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, garlic and 2 tbsp water until the sugar dissolves, and serve for dipping with lettuce and mint.

notes: Food safety: pork mince must reach 75°C throughout and prawns turn opaque and pink before serving. Plus 30 minutes resting the batter.
Dinner. Dairy-free. Gluten-free.

title: Balinese Spiced Duck Leg Bake
summary: Duck legs rubbed with turmeric, lemongrass and chilli paste and slow-roasted until the skin crisps.

steps.text: Blitz the shallot, garlic, ginger, lemongrass, chilli, turmeric, coriander seed, salt and oil into a smooth paste.
Rub the paste over the duck legs, tuck the lime leaves underneath and leave to marinate.
Heat the oven to 160°C. Roast the duck legs skin side up in a snug dish, covered with foil, for 90 minutes until very tender.
Remove the foil, brush with kecap manis and roast at 200°C for 15 minutes until the skin is dark and crisp.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, and serve with the duck and cucumber.

notes: Food safety: duck is done when the thickest part of the leg reaches 75°C and the meat pulls away from the bone. Plus 2 hours marinating.
Dinner. Dairy-free.

title: Nasi Lemak Plates with Sambal Chicken
summary: Coconut rice with sambal-glazed chicken, a fried egg, cucumber and crunchy peanuts.

steps.text: Rinse the rice, then cook it with the coconut milk, water, lemongrass and a pinch of salt, covered, until tender and fluffy.
Fry the onion and garlic in 1 tbsp oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft, then add the sambal oelek, tamarind and palm sugar and stir for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken and 1/4 cup water, cover and cook for 20 minutes, turning, until the sauce is thick and sticky.
Toast the peanuts in a dry pan for 3 minutes until golden, then fry the eggs in the remaining oil until the whites are set.
Plate the rice with chicken, an egg, cucumber, peanuts and fried shallots.

notes: Food safety: chicken thigh must reach 75°C in the thickest part with no pink juices.
Dinner. Dairy-free. Gluten-free.

title: Crisp Pork Belly with Garlic Vinegar Dip
summary: Pork belly simmered, dried and fried until the crackling shatters, served with a sharp garlic vinegar dip.

steps.text: Simmer the pork with the onion, peppercorns, bay leaves and salt in water for 60 minutes until a skewer slides in easily.
Lift out the pork, pat very dry and leave uncovered in the fridge so the skin dries out completely.
Cut into thick slabs and shallow-fry in the oil over medium-high heat for 6 minutes each side until the skin blisters and turns crisp.
Stir the vinegar, garlic, chilli and sugar together with a pinch of salt for the dip.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and serve with the pork and dip.

notes: Food safety: the pork is cooked once it reaches 75°C in the thickest part. Hot oil spits, so keep the skin very dry. Plus 3 hours drying in the fridge.
Dinner. Dairy-free. Gluten-free.

title: Swahili Chicken Pilau
summary: Spiced rice cooked in a rich stock with caramelised onion and tender chicken pieces.

steps.text: Brown the onion in the oil in a heavy pot over medium heat for 15 minutes until deep brown, stirring often.
Add the garlic, ginger, cumin seed, cinnamon, cardamom, pepper and turmeric and stir for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chicken and tomato and cook for 10 minutes until the chicken is browned and the tomato breaks down.
Stir in the rinsed rice, stock and salt, bring to the boil, then cover and cook on the lowest heat for 20 minutes until the rice is tender.
Rest for 10 minutes with the lid on, then fluff with a fork and serve.

notes: Food safety: the thickest part of the chicken must reach 75°C and the juices run clear.
Dinner. Dairy-free. Gluten-free.

title: Apricot-Spiced Lamb Curry with Potato
summary: Slow-cooked lamb in a mildly sweet, fragrant curry with apricot, finished with fresh coriander.

steps.text: Brown the lamb in the oil in a heavy pot over high heat for 8 minutes until deeply coloured, then lift out.
Soften the onion in the same pot for 8 minutes, add the garlic, ginger, curry powder, turmeric and cinnamon and stir for 1 minute.
Return the lamb with the tomatoes, apricot, sugar, tamarind and water, cover and simmer gently for 60 minutes.
Add the potato and cook for 30 minutes more until the lamb is fork-tender and the sauce is thick.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, then stir the coriander through the curry and serve.

notes: Food safety: the lamb should be tender and reach at least 70°C in the centre of the largest piece.
Dinner. Dairy-free. Gluten-free.

title: Kalua-Style Slow Pork Shoulder with Rice
summary: Smoky, salty pulled pork cooked low and slow in the oven, served over rice with pineapple.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 150°C. Rub the pork all over with the salt, smoked paprika and soy sauce.
Place in a deep roasting dish with the water, cover tightly with foil and roast for 4 hours until the meat falls apart.
Check the centre reads 90°C or more, then rest for 15 minutes before shredding with two forks.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, and mix a few spoonfuls of the pan juices through the shredded pork.
Serve the pork over rice with pineapple and spring onion.

notes: Food safety: pork must reach at least 75°C in the centre; for pulling it should reach 90°C and be fork-tender.
Dinner. Dairy-free. Use tamari instead of soy sauce for gluten-free.

title: Fijian-Style Coconut Chicken Foil Parcels
summary: Chicken thighs steamed in foil parcels with coconut cream, spinach, ginger and chilli.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C and cut four large squares of foil.
Toss the chicken with the coconut cream, ginger, garlic, chilli, lime juice and salt.
Pile the spinach and onion in the centre of each square, top with the chicken and sauce, and fold the foil into sealed parcels.
Bake on a tray for 35 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the spinach is soft.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, and serve the parcels opened over rice.

notes: Food safety: open one parcel to check the chicken has reached 75°C with no pink juices.
Dinner. Dairy-free. Gluten-free.

title: Samoan-Style Coconut Fish with Rice
summary: Pan-seared fish simmered in coconut milk with lime and spring onion, served over steamed rice.

steps.text: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Soften the onion and garlic in the oil over medium heat for 4 minutes, then pour in the coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
Slide in the fish, add the salt and tomato, and cook gently for 8 minutes until the flesh is opaque and flakes easily.
Stir through the lime juice and half the spring onion.
Spoon over the rice and finish with the remaining spring onion.

notes: Food safety: the fish is cooked when it turns opaque and flakes with a fork.
Dinner. Dairy-free. Gluten-free.

title: Pacific Pumpkin Coconut Bake with Spinach
summary: Sweet pumpkin baked in coconut milk with ginger and lime, finished with wilted spinach and peanuts.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C. Toss the pumpkin with the oil, turmeric and salt in a baking dish.
Roast for 20 minutes until the edges are starting to brown.
Stir through the onion, ginger, garlic and coconut milk and bake for 20 minutes more until the pumpkin is tender.
Fold the spinach through until wilted, and squeeze over the lime juice.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, and serve with the bake and peanuts.

notes: Dinner. Vegan.

title: Nyama Choma-Style Beef Skewers
summary: Chilli and garlic marinated beef sirloin skewers charred and served with tomato onion relish and rice.

steps.text: Mix the beef with the garlic, ginger, oil, chilli powder, cumin, half the lemon juice and the salt, and leave to marinate.
Mix the tomato, red onion, coriander, green chilli and remaining lemon juice for the relish.
Thread the beef onto skewers and grill over high heat for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until charred outside and cooked to your liking.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, and serve the skewers with the relish and rice.

notes: Food safety: beef cubes should reach 63°C internal for medium or 71°C for well done; rest for 3 minutes before serving. Plus 2 hours marinating.
Dinner. Dairy-free. Gluten-free.

title: Kenyan Coconut Chicken Curry
summary: Chicken simmered in a tomato and coconut curry with ginger and green chilli, served with chapati-style flatbread.

steps.text: Fry the onion in the oil over medium heat for 8 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder and stir for 1 minute until fragrant, then add the tomato and cook for 5 minutes until broken down.
Add the chicken, coconut milk, chilli and salt, cover and simmer for 25 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir through the coriander and serve with warm flatbread.

notes: Food safety: the thickest piece of chicken must reach 75°C with no pink juices.
Dinner. Dairy-free.

title: Ethiopian-Style Red Lentil Stew with Flatbread
summary: A spiced red lentil stew with onion, garlic and berbere-style spices, scooped up with warm flatbread.

steps.text: Cook the onion in a dry pot over medium heat for 8 minutes until softened, then add the oil, garlic and ginger and cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in the paprika, chilli powder, cumin, coriander, cinnamon and tomato paste for 1 minute until dark and fragrant.
Add the rinsed lentils, water and salt, bring to the boil, then simmer for 25 minutes until the lentils are soft and the stew is thick.
Serve in bowls with warm flatbread for scooping.

notes: Dinner. Vegan.

title: Bobotie Baked Curried Mince
summary: Spiced beef mince with apricot and almond under a golden egg custard, served with rice.

items.raw: 1 slice white bread, soaked in milk

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C. Soften the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, add the garlic, curry powder and turmeric and stir for 1 minute.
Add the mince and cook for 8 minutes until browned, breaking up lumps, then stir in the jam, sultana, almond, squeezed bread and salt.
Press the mince into a baking dish. Whisk the eggs with the milk and pour over, then lay the bay leaves on top.
Bake for 30 minutes until the custard is set and golden.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, and serve with the bobotie.

notes: Food safety: the mince must reach 75°C throughout and the egg topping must be fully set.
Dinner.

title: Peri-Peri Chicken Thighs with Pap-Style Polenta
summary: Chilli lemon grilled chicken thighs beside creamy maize porridge and a quick tomato relish.

steps.text: Blend the chilli, garlic, olive oil, lemon juice, paprika and half the salt, and coat the chicken in it.
Heat the oven to 220°C and roast the chicken on a tray for 30 minutes until charred at the edges and cooked through.
Bring the water and remaining salt to the boil, whisk in the polenta and cook on low heat for 15 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy, then beat in the butter.
Mix the tomato and red onion with a pinch of salt for the relish.
Serve the chicken over the polenta with the relish.

notes: Food safety: the thickest part of the chicken must reach 75°C with no pink juices. Plus 1 hour marinating.
Dinner.

title: Butternut and Bean Potjie
summary: A one-pot stew of butternut, beans and tomato with warm curry spices, simmered until thick.

steps.text: Soften the onion in the oil in a heavy pot over medium heat for 6 minutes, then stir in the garlic, curry powder and paprika for 1 minute.
Add the pumpkin, carrot, tomatoes, stock, jam and salt, cover and simmer for 25 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the beans and cook for 8 minutes more until heated through and the sauce is thick.
Scatter with parsley and serve with crusty bread.

notes: Dinner. Vegan. Use canned beans only; if cooking dried kidney beans, boil them hard for 10 minutes first.

title: Kung Pao Tofu with Cashews
summary: Crisp tofu cubes tossed in a glossy sweet-sour chilli sauce with cashews, capsicum and Sichuan pepper.

steps.text: Toss the tofu in the cornflour, then fry in 2 tbsp of the oil over medium-high heat for 8 minutes, turning, until golden and crisp. Lift out.
Toast the cashews in a dry pan for 2 minutes until golden.
Stir the soy sauce, vinegar and sugar together until the sugar dissolves.
Fry the dried chilli and peppercorns in the remaining oil for 30 seconds, then add the garlic and capsicum and stir-fry for 3 minutes until just tender.
Return the tofu and cashews, pour in the sauce and toss for 2 minutes until sticky.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, and serve topped with spring onion.

notes: Dinner. Vegan.

title: Vegetable Katsu Curry Plates
summary: Crumbed pumpkin and eggplant cutlets with a mild sweet curry sauce over rice.

steps.text: Whisk the flour and water into a thin batter. Dip the pumpkin and eggplant in it, then press into the panko.
Soften the onion and carrot in 1 tbsp oil for 6 minutes, stir in the curry powder and flour for 1 minute, then add the stock, soy sauce and sugar.
Simmer the sauce for 15 minutes until thick, then blend smooth if you like.
Shallow-fry the cutlets in the remaining oil over medium heat for 3 minutes each side until golden and the pumpkin is tender.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, then top with the cutlets and spoon over the sauce.

notes: Dinner. Vegan.

title: Mushroom Bibimbap Bowls
summary: Rice topped with sauteed mushrooms, carrot, spinach and crisp tofu, finished with a gochujang sauce.

steps.text: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Fry the tofu in 1 tbsp neutral oil over medium-high heat for 8 minutes until golden on all sides, then set aside.
Saute the mushrooms in the remaining neutral oil with half the garlic for 6 minutes until browned, then season with the soy sauce.
Quickly cook the carrot in a hot pan for 2 minutes until just tender, and wilt the spinach with the rest of the garlic and a little sesame oil.
Stir the gochujang with the vinegar, remaining sesame oil and 1 tbsp water.
Divide the rice between bowls, arrange the vegetables, tofu and cucumber on top, and finish with the sauce and sesame seed.

notes: Dinner. Vegan.

title: Pumpkin Red Curry with Rice
summary: Soft pumpkin and green beans in a creamy coconut red curry with lime and basil.

steps.text: Fry the curry paste in the oil in a large pot over medium heat for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Pour in the coconut milk and stock, add the soy sauce and palm sugar, and bring to a gentle simmer until bubbling.
Add the pumpkin and cook for 15 minutes until almost tender, then add the beans for 5 minutes until just cooked.
Stir through the lime juice and basil.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, and serve with the curry.

notes: Dinner. Most red curry pastes contain shrimp paste; check the label, or use a vegan paste, to keep it vegan. Check the curry paste label if you avoid shrimp paste.

title: Lemongrass Tofu Vermicelli Bowls
summary: Lemongrass-marinated tofu over rice vermicelli with crunchy vegetables, herbs and peanuts.

steps.text: Mix the lemongrass, garlic, soy sauce and half the sugar, and coat the tofu in it.
Soak or boil the vermicelli according to the packet until tender, then drain and rinse in cold water.
Pan-fry the tofu in the oil over medium-high heat for 4 minutes each side until golden and caramelised.
Stir the lime juice, vinegar and remaining sugar with 2 tbsp water until the sugar dissolves.
Divide the noodles between bowls, top with the vegetables, mint and tofu, and drizzle with the dressing and peanuts.

notes: Dinner. Vegan. Plus 20 minutes marinating.

title: Sambal Tofu Stir-Fry with Green Beans
summary: Tofu and green beans wok-tossed in a fiery tamarind sambal, served on rice.

steps.text: Fry the tofu in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat for 8 minutes until golden all over, then lift out.
Fry the onion and garlic in the remaining oil for 4 minutes until soft, then add the sambal oelek, tamarind, kecap manis and palm sugar.
Add the beans and water and stir-fry for 5 minutes until the beans are tender-crisp.
Return the tofu and toss for 2 minutes until coated in the thick sauce.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, and serve the stir-fry on top.

notes: Dinner. Vegan. Check the label of the kecap manis if you avoid fish products.

title: Mushroom Rendang with Coconut Rice
summary: Meaty mushrooms simmered in a dry coconut rendang paste until dark and sticky.

steps.text: Blitz the shallot, garlic, ginger, lemongrass, chilli and turmeric into a paste.
Toast the desiccated coconut in a dry pan for 3 minutes until deep golden, then grind it roughly.
Fry the paste in the oil in a wide pan over medium heat for 8 minutes until the oil separates.
Add the mushrooms, coconut milk, tamarind, sugar and salt and simmer for 25 minutes, stirring, until the sauce is thick and clinging to the mushrooms.
Stir through the toasted coconut. Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and serve alongside.

notes: Dinner. Vegan.

title: Mushroom Adobo Rice Bowls
summary: Mushrooms braised in a soy, vinegar and garlic adobo sauce until glossy, served over rice.

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in the oil in a wide pot over high heat for 8 minutes until browned and their liquid has gone.
Add the garlic, bay leaves and pepper and stir for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and water and simmer for 15 minutes without stirring for the first 5 minutes until the sauce is reduced and glossy.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender.
Spoon the mushrooms and sauce over the rice and top with spring onion.

notes: Dinner. Vegan.

title: Sri Lankan Cashew and Pea Curry
summary: Creamy cashews and peas in a mild coconut curry with curry leaves, mustard seed and turmeric.

steps.text: Soak the cashews in hot water for 20 minutes, then drain.
Heat the coconut oil, add the mustard seed and curry leaves and cook for 30 seconds until they pop.
Add the onion and garlic and cook for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the curry powder, turmeric and cinnamon.
Add the cashews, coconut milk, water and salt and simmer for 15 minutes until the cashews are tender, then add the peas for 3 minutes until bright.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, and serve with the curry.

notes: Dinner. Vegan. Plus 20 minutes soaking the cashews.

title: Chickpea and Spinach Curry with Jeera Rice
summary: Chickpeas and spinach in a lightly spiced tomato curry, served with cumin-scented rice.

steps.text: Soften the onion in the oil over medium heat for 6 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger, garam masala, turmeric and ground cumin and stir for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and salt, and simmer for 10 minutes until thick.
Stir in the chickpeas and cook for 8 minutes, then fold in the spinach until wilted.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, stirring the cumin seed through at the end.
Serve the curry over the rice.

notes: Dinner. Vegan.

title: Coconut Rice Flour Cake
summary: A tender, lightly sweet cake made with rice flour and coconut milk.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 170°C and line a 20cm cake tin.
Whisk the eggs and sugar for 4 minutes until pale and thick, then whisk in the coconut milk, coconut oil and vanilla.
Fold in the rice flour, baking powder and desiccated coconut until just combined.
Pour into the tin and bake for 35 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 10 minutes before turning out.

notes: Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian; gluten-free if you use gluten-free baking powder.

title: Cardamom Almond Cake
summary: A moist almond cake scented with cardamom and finished with a honey glaze.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 170°C and line a 20cm cake tin.
Beat the eggs and sugar for 3 minutes until pale, then stir in the butter and cardamom.
Fold in the almond meal and baking powder until smooth.
Bake for 35 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean, then brush with honey and scatter with pistachio.
Cool completely in the tin before slicing.

notes: Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian; gluten-free if you use gluten-free baking powder.

title: Besan Shortbread Rounds
summary: Crumbly gluten-free shortbread made with chickpea flour, cardamom and ghee.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 160°C and line a tray.
Beat the ghee and icing sugar for 3 minutes until pale, then mix in the chickpea flour and cardamom to a soft dough.
Roll into 12 balls, flatten gently and press a few pistachio into each.
Bake for 18 minutes until firm and just golden at the edges.
Cool completely on the tray as they crisp up.

notes: Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian and gluten-free.

title: Flourless Peanut Butter Cookies
summary: Chewy, three-ingredient style cookies with peanut butter, sugar and egg and a pinch of salt.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 175°C and line two trays.
Mix the peanut butter, sugar, egg, bicarbonate of soda and salt until a thick dough forms.
Roll into 12 balls, press onto the trays and top with chopped peanuts.
Bake for 11 minutes until puffed and golden at the edges, then cool on the tray.

notes: Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian and gluten-free.

title: Cassava Coconut Brownies
summary: Dense chocolatey gluten-free brownies made with cassava flour and coconut sugar-free sweetness from brown sugar.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 175°C and line a 20cm tin.
Melt the chocolate and butter together gently, then stir in the sugar and eggs one at a time until glossy.
Fold in the cassava flour, cocoa, coconut and salt until just combined.
Bake for 22 minutes until the top is set and a skewer comes out with a few moist crumbs.
Cool in the tin before cutting into squares.

notes: Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian and gluten-free.

title: Black Sesame Rice Flour Muffins
summary: Nutty muffins with ground black sesame and a soft crumb.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C and line 8 muffin cups.
Toast the sesame in a dry pan for 2 minutes until fragrant, then grind coarsely.
Whisk the eggs, sugar, milk, oil and vanilla, then fold in the rice flour, sesame and baking powder until just combined.
Divide between the cups and bake for 20 minutes until risen and a skewer comes out clean.
Cool on a wire rack before serving.

notes: Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian; gluten-free if you use gluten-free baking powder.

title: Sweet Potato Almond Brownies
summary: Fudgy squares with mashed sweet potato, almond meal and cocoa.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C and line a 20cm tin.
Whisk the mashed sweet potato, maple syrup, eggs and coconut oil until smooth.
Fold in the almond meal, cocoa and baking powder, then the chocolate.
Bake for 28 minutes until set and a skewer comes out with a few moist crumbs.
Cool completely before cutting into squares.

notes: Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian; gluten-free if you use gluten-free baking powder.

title: Thai Rice Flour Coconut Custard Cakes
summary: Little crisp-edged coconut rice cakes with a creamy centre, made in a hot pan or muffin tin.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C and brush a 12-hole mini muffin tin with coconut oil.
Whisk the rice flour, coconut milk, sugar and salt into a smooth batter, then stir in the corn and spring onion.
Heat the greased tin in the oven for 5 minutes until very hot.
Fill each hole with batter and bake for 15 minutes until set with golden edges.
Lift out gently and serve warm.

notes: Snack. Vegan and gluten-free.

title: Spring Onion Egg Pancake Rolls
summary: Thin savoury pancakes cooked with a layer of egg and spring onion, rolled and cut into pinwheels.

steps.text: Whisk the flour, water and salt into a smooth thin batter, and beat the eggs with the spring onion.
Heat a little oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat and pour in half the batter, swirling thin.
Cook for 1 minute until set, pour half the egg mixture over the top and cook for 2 minutes until the egg is fully set, then roll up.
Repeat with the rest, brush with sesame oil and cut into pinwheels.
Serve with the soy sauce for dipping.

notes: Food safety: cook the egg until fully set. Breakfast. Vegetarian.

title: Jianbing-Style Egg Crepe Wraps
summary: A thin crepe cooked with egg, sesame and spring onion, then wrapped around a crisp wonton cracker and sauce.

steps.text: Whisk the flours and water into a thin batter and rest briefly.
Fry the wonton wrappers in the oil over medium heat for 1 minute each side until golden and crisp, then drain.
Pour half the batter into a hot lightly oiled pan and swirl thin, crack an egg on top and spread it out. Sprinkle with sesame seed and spring onion.
Cook for 2 minutes until the egg is fully set, flip, then brush with hoisin and chilli oil.
Lay a crisp wrapper and coriander on one side, fold in the edges and roll into a wrap. Repeat for the second.

notes: Food safety: cook the egg until fully set. Breakfast. Vegetarian.

title: Savoury Soy Milk Tofu Scramble Bowls
summary: Soft tofu scrambled with turmeric, spring onion and chilli oil over warm rice.

steps.text: Fry the tofu in the oil over medium-high heat for 6 minutes until the edges turn golden.
Stir in the turmeric, soy sauce and soy milk and cook for 3 minutes until the liquid is absorbed.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and steaming hot.
Divide the rice between bowls, top with the scramble, spring onion and fried shallots, and drizzle with the sesame oil and chilli oil.

notes: Breakfast. Vegan.
Food safety: Keep any leftover garlic, herb or chilli oil in the fridge and use it within 4 days.

title: Tamagoyaki Rolled Omelette Breakfast Plates
summary: Sweet-savoury layered rolled omelette with rice, pickles and nori.

steps.text: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and sticky.
Beat the eggs with the mirin, soy sauce and sugar until just combined.
Brush a small non-stick pan with oil over medium-low heat and pour in a thin layer of egg. When just set but still glossy, roll it up to one side.
Brush the pan again, pour in more egg under the roll, cook until set and roll again. Repeat until the egg is used up.
Slice the omelette and serve with the rice, nori and pickles.

notes: Food safety: the omelette should be set all the way through with no runny egg. Breakfast. Vegetarian. Use fresh, uncracked eggs; for pregnant women, older people, young children and anyone with low immunity, cook the eggs until the yolks are firm.

title: Miso Grilled Salmon Breakfast Plates
summary: Miso-glazed salmon with steamed rice and a quick cucumber pickle.

steps.text: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and sticky.
Mix the miso, mirin and soy sauce and spread over the salmon.
Grill the salmon skin side up for 8 minutes until caramelised and the flesh is opaque and flakes easily.
Toss the cucumber with the vinegar, sugar and sesame seed for 5 minutes.
Serve the salmon on the rice with the pickle.

notes: Food safety: salmon is cooked when the flesh turns opaque and flakes with a fork. Breakfast. Dairy-free.

title: Onigiri Breakfast Pairs with Sesame Egg
summary: Palm-sized rice balls wrapped in nori and filled with a sesame egg mixture.

steps.text: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and sticky, then cool slightly.
Boil the eggs for 10 minutes until the yolks are fully set, cool, then mash with the mayonnaise, soy sauce and sesame seed.
Wet your hands, salt them and press a handful of rice around a spoonful of egg into a triangle.
Wrap each onigiri with a strip of nori and serve.

notes: Food safety: the eggs are boiled until fully set. Keep refrigerated if not eaten within an hour. Breakfast. Vegetarian.

title: Shaobing Sesame Flatbread Egg Sandwiches
summary: Flaky sesame flatbreads filled with a scrambled egg, spring onion and chilli sauce.

steps.text: Knead the flour, water and salt for 6 minutes until smooth, then rest. Divide into 4 balls and roll out thin.
Brush with 1 tbsp oil, roll up, coil and flatten into discs, then press one side into the sesame seed.
Pan-fry the discs in a dry pan over medium heat for 4 minutes each side until golden and puffed.
Scramble the eggs with the spring onion and soy sauce in the remaining oil for 3 minutes until fully set.
Split each flatbread, fill with the egg and a spoonful of chilli sauce, and serve hot.

notes: Food safety: cook the egg until fully set. Plus 30 minutes resting the dough. Breakfast. Vegetarian.

title: Nori Cheese Omelette Toast
summary: A savoury folded omelette with nori and melted cheese in toasted bread.

steps.text: Beat the eggs with the soy sauce and spring onion.
Melt the butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat, pour in the egg and scatter with the nori and cheese.
Cook for 3 minutes until the egg is fully set and the cheese has melted, then fold in four.
Toast the bread until golden and sandwich the omelette between the slices.

notes: Food safety: cook the omelette until fully set. Breakfast. Vegetarian.

title: Japanese Cotton Cheesecake
summary: A jiggly, light-as-air baked cheesecake with a whipped egg white meringue and a soft golden top.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 160°C and line a 18cm round tin with baking paper, then set it in a roasting dish.
Warm the cream cheese, milk and butter in a bowl over simmering water, stirring until smooth, then cool slightly and whisk in the yolks.
Sift in the flour and cornflour and whisk until smooth.
Beat the egg whites with the lemon juice until foamy, add the sugar in three batches and whisk until soft peaks form.
Fold the meringue into the cheese mixture in three batches, pour into the tin and add hot water to the roasting dish to come halfway up the tin.
Bake for 60 minutes until golden and gently set with a slight wobble, then cool in the oven with the door ajar.

notes: Food safety: bake until the centre is set. Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian. Wash fresh produce well, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat them within 3 days.

title: Lemon Butter Mochi Squares
summary: Chewy, buttery glutinous rice flour squares with lemon and coconut milk.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 175°C and grease a 20cm square tin.
Whisk the eggs, sugar, coconut milk, milk, butter, vanilla, zest and lemon juice until smooth.
Mix in the glutinous rice flour and baking powder until no lumps remain.
Pour into the tin and bake for 50 minutes until the top is deep golden and the centre is set.
Cool completely before cutting into squares.

notes: Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian; gluten-free if you use gluten-free baking powder.

title: Haupia Coconut Pudding Squares
summary: Silky set coconut squares from just coconut milk, sugar and cornflour, chilled and cut.

steps.text: Whisk the cornflour with the water until smooth.
Heat the coconut milk and sugar in a pot over medium heat until steaming, then whisk in the cornflour mixture.
Stir constantly for 5 minutes until the mixture is thick and glossy.
Pour into a lined 18cm tin, smooth the top and chill until set.
Cut into squares and sprinkle with toasted desiccated coconut.

notes: Plus 3 hours chilling. Snack. Dessert. Vegan; gluten-free if you use cornflour labelled gluten-free.

title: Hawaiian-Style Sweet Bread Rolls
summary: Soft, slightly sweet pineapple-scented rolls with a shiny honey-butter top.

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and salt, then add the pineapple juice, milk, half the butter and the egg and knead for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Cover and prove until doubled in size, then shape into 12 balls and arrange snugly in a tin.
Prove again for 30 minutes until puffy. Heat the oven to 180°C.
Bake for 22 minutes until golden, then brush with the remaining butter mixed with the honey.
Cool slightly and pull apart to serve.

notes: Plus 2 hours proving. Snack. Vegetarian.

title: Samoan-Style Coconut Buns
summary: Soft yeasted buns filled with sweet toasted coconut and brushed with a sugar glaze.

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, caster sugar and salt, then add the warm coconut milk and egg and knead for 8 minutes until smooth.
Cover and prove until doubled, then divide into 12 balls and flatten.
Mix the desiccated coconut, brown sugar and butter until combined, put a spoonful in each round and pinch closed.
Place seam down on a tray, prove for 20 minutes, then bake at 180°C for 22 minutes until deep golden.
Mix the icing sugar with a spoonful of water and brush over the warm buns.

notes: Plus 1 hour 30 minutes proving. Snack. Vegetarian.

title: Pineapple Coconut Upside-Down Cake
summary: A buttery caramelised pineapple topping over a coconut sponge, turned out while warm.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 175°C and line a 20cm round tin.
Melt the first butter with the brown sugar until bubbling, pour into the tin and arrange the pineapple on top.
Beat the softened butter and caster sugar for 3 minutes until pale, then beat in the eggs one at a time.
Fold in the flour, coconut milk and desiccated coconut, and spoon over the fruit.
Bake for 40 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean, rest for 5 minutes, then turn out.

notes: Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian.

title: Honey Ginger Yakgwa-Style Cookies
summary: Soft, flaky deep-fried cookies soaked in a warm ginger and honey syrup.

steps.text: Rub the flour with the sesame oil, then mix in the rice wine and enough water to make a firm dough.
Roll out 1cm thick, cut into small diamonds and prick with a fork.
Simmer the honey, 1/2 cup water, ginger and cinnamon for 5 minutes until syrupy, then keep warm.
Fry the cookies in the oil at 140°C for 8 minutes until golden, drain well, then soak in the syrup for 30 minutes.
Lift out, top with pine nuts and serve at room temperature.

notes: Plus 30 minutes soaking. Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian.

title: Sweet Potato Milk Bread Buns
summary: Fluffy milk buns swirled with a spiced sweet potato filling.

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar and salt, then add the warm milk, egg and butter and knead for 12 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Cover and prove until doubled, then divide into 12 pieces and roll each into an oval.
Mix the sweet potato, brown sugar and cinnamon until smooth, spread over each oval, roll up and tuck the ends under.
Place seam down in a tray, prove again for 30 minutes until puffy and bake at 180°C for 25 minutes until deep golden.
Cool on a rack before serving.

notes: Plus 2 hours proving. Snack. Vegetarian.

title: Steamed Honeycomb Sponge Cake
summary: A light, airy steamed cake with a springy honeycomb crumb and a gentle caramel flavour.

steps.text: Line a 18cm tin and set up a steamer over simmering water.
Whisk the eggs and sugar for 8 minutes until thick and pale.
Fold in the flour and baking powder, then the oil, milk and vanilla until just combined.
Pour into the tin, cover the tin loosely with foil and steam on medium heat for 30 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.
Cool for 10 minutes before slicing.

notes: Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian. Food safety: steam until fully set in the centre.

title: Hong Kong-Style Egg Waffle Bubbles
summary: Crisp-edged, chewy bubble waffles made from a sweet vanilla batter.

steps.text: Whisk the eggs, sugar, milk, oil and vanilla until smooth.
Mix in the flour, cornflour and baking powder, then rest.
Heat a waffle pan and pour in enough batter to fill the holes.
Cook for 3 minutes per waffle until deep golden and crisp, then cool briefly so it crisps further.
Serve warm, torn into pieces.

notes: Plus 10 minutes resting. Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian.

title: Soy Milk Pudding Cups with Orange Syrup
summary: Silky set soy milk pudding with a bright orange syrup.

steps.text: Whisk the cornflour with 1/2 cup of the soy milk until smooth.
Heat the remaining soy milk with the caster sugar until steaming, whisk in the cornflour mixture and stir for 4 minutes until thick, then add the vanilla.
Pour into 6 cups and chill until set.
Simmer the orange juice and white sugar for 5 minutes until syrupy, then cool.
Top the puddings with the syrup and orange segments.

notes: Plus 3 hours chilling. Snack. Dessert. Vegan; gluten-free if you use cornflour labelled gluten-free.

title: Thai Coconut Cream Pudding Cups with Lime
summary: Cool, creamy coconut pudding cups with a sharp lime syrup.

steps.text: Whisk the cornflour with 1/2 cup of the water until smooth.
Heat the coconut milk, remaining water and caster sugar until steaming, whisk in the cornflour mixture and stir for 4 minutes until thick.
Pour into 6 cups and chill until set.
Simmer the lime juice and white sugar for 4 minutes until syrupy, then cool.
Spoon the syrup over the puddings.

notes: Plus 3 hours chilling. Snack. Dessert. Vegan; gluten-free if you use cornflour labelled gluten-free.

title: Vietnamese Caramel Flan with Coconut
summary: Silky baked custard with a bittersweet caramel top, enriched with coconut milk.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 160°C. Cook the white sugar and water over medium heat for 6 minutes without stirring until deep amber, then pour into 6 ramekins.
Whisk the eggs, milk, coconut milk, caster sugar and vanilla until smooth, and strain.
Pour over the caramel and set the ramekins in a roasting dish. Add hot water to come halfway up the sides.
Bake for 35 minutes until set with a gentle wobble in the centre.
Chill, then run a knife around each flan and turn out.

notes: Food safety: bake until the custard is set. Plus 3 hours chilling. Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian.

title: Vietnamese Steamed Rice Honeycomb Cake
summary: A bouncy honeycomb-textured steamed cake made from rice flour and tapioca starch.

steps.text: Whisk the water, coconut milk and sugar, then stir in the yeast and rest until foamy.
Mix in the rice flour, tapioca starch and baking powder to a smooth runny batter and rest.
Pour into a lined 18cm tin and steam over simmering water for 30 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.
Cool completely before cutting into squares.

notes: Plus 45 minutes resting. Snack. Dessert. Vegan; gluten-free if you use gluten-free baking powder.

title: Indonesian Layered Spice Cake
summary: A rich buttery cake built from thin spiced layers grilled one at a time.

steps.text: Heat the grill on high until very hot and line a 20cm tin.
Beat the butter and sugar for 5 minutes until pale, then beat in the yolks and vanilla.
Fold in the flour, then divide the batter in two and mix the spices into one half.
Whisk the egg whites to soft peaks and fold half into each batter.
Spread 3 tbsp of plain batter in the tin and grill for 3 minutes until golden. Alternate with spiced layers, grilling each until golden, until all the batter is used.
Cool completely before slicing thinly.

notes: Food safety: each layer must be cooked through with no wet batter. Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian.

title: Palm Sugar Coconut Rice Balls
summary: Chewy glutinous rice balls hiding molten palm sugar, rolled in fresh coconut.

steps.text: Mix the flour, water and turmeric into a soft dough.
Roll into 18 small balls, press a piece of palm sugar into each and seal.
Boil in water for 4 minutes until they float, then boil for 1 minute more.
Toss the balls in the desiccated coconut mixed with the salt.
Serve warm, as the sugar centres are very hot.

notes: Snack. Dessert. Vegan and gluten-free.

title: Baked Tapioca Coconut Cake
summary: A dense, chewy baked coconut tapioca cake with a golden top.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C and grease a 20cm tin.
Whisk the coconut milk, sugar, eggs, vanilla and salt until smooth.
Stir in the tapioca starch and desiccated coconut until no lumps remain.
Pour into the tin and bake for 50 minutes until golden on top and set in the centre.
Cool completely before cutting.

notes: Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian and gluten-free.

title: Pineapple Jam Tarts
summary: Buttery shortcrust tarts filled with homemade spiced pineapple jam.

steps.text: Pulse the flour, butter and icing sugar until it looks like crumbs, add one egg and mix to a dough, then rest.
Simmer the pineapple, caster sugar, cinnamon and star anise for 30 minutes, stirring often, until thick and jammy.
Cool the jam and remove the spices. Heat the oven to 170°C.
Roll the dough, cut 20 rounds, fill each with a spoonful of jam, and decorate with dough strips.
Brush with the second egg beaten, then bake for 20 minutes until golden.

notes: Food safety: bake until the pastry is golden and set. Plus 30 minutes resting the dough. Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian. Wash fresh produce well, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat them within 3 days.

title: Ensaymada Cheese Brioche Rolls
summary: Soft, buttery spiral brioche rolls topped with butter, sugar and cheese.

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, 1/3 cup sugar and salt, then add the warm milk and eggs and knead for 12 minutes.
Work in the 120g butter a little at a time and knead for 8 minutes more until silky and elastic.
Cover and prove until doubled, then divide into 12, roll into ropes and coil into spirals in a tray.
Prove again for 40 minutes, then bake at 180°C for 22 minutes until golden.
Brush the warm rolls with the remaining butter and top with the remaining sugar and the grated cheddar.

notes: Plus 2 hours proving. Snack. Vegetarian.

title: Mamon Chiffon Cupcakes
summary: Tall, airy chiffon sponge cups with a buttery, sugar-dusted top.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 170°C and line a 12-hole muffin tin with tall paper cups.
Whisk the yolks with half the sugar, oil, milk and vanilla until smooth, then fold in the flour and baking powder.
Whisk the egg whites to soft peaks, add the remaining sugar and whisk until glossy and stiff.
Fold the meringue into the batter in three batches, fill the cups and bake for 22 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean.
Brush with butter and dust with a little extra sugar.

notes: Food safety: bake until fully set. Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian. Wash fresh produce well, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat them within 3 days.

title: Bibingka Baked Rice Cakes with Cheddar
summary: Fluffy rice-flour cakes baked with coconut milk and topped with melted butter and a cheese crust.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200°C and grease six small ramekins.
Whisk the coconut milk, sugar, eggs and butter until smooth.
Mix in the rice flour and baking powder, fill the ramekins and bake for 15 minutes.
Top with cheddar and coconut and bake for 10 minutes more until the tops are golden and bubbling.
Serve warm with extra melted butter.

notes: Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian; gluten-free if you use gluten-free baking powder.

title: Biko Sticky Rice Cake with Coconut Caramel
summary: Chewy glutinous rice cooked in coconut milk and topped with a thick coconut caramel.

steps.text: Rinse the rice, then simmer with the coconut milk, water, 3/4 cup brown sugar and salt for 25 minutes, stirring often, until thick and tender.
Press the rice into a lined 20cm tin.
Simmer the coconut cream and 1/4 cup sugar for 8 minutes until thick and caramel-coloured.
Spread the topping over the rice and cool before cutting.

notes: Snack. Dessert. Vegan and gluten-free.

title: Orange Semolina Cake with Cardamom Syrup
summary: A moist baked semolina cake soaked in a fragrant orange and cardamom syrup.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C and grease a 20cm tin.
Mix the semolina, flour, baking powder and caster sugar, then stir in the butter, yoghurt, eggs and orange zest until smooth.
Bake for 35 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean.
Simmer the white sugar, water, orange juice and cardamom for 6 minutes until syrupy.
Pour the warm syrup over the hot cake and cool before cutting.

notes: Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian.

title: Cardamom Rose Cupcakes
summary: Soft buttery cupcakes scented with cardamom and rose water, topped with a pink glaze.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C and line a 12-hole muffin tin.
Beat the butter and caster sugar for 4 minutes until pale, then beat in the eggs one at a time.
Fold in the flour, 1/3 cup milk, cardamom and half the rose water.
Fill the cases and bake for 20 minutes until risen and golden.
Mix the icing sugar with the remaining rose water and milk, spread on the cooled cupcakes and top with pistachio.

notes: Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian.

title: Saffron Shrikhand Yoghurt Cups
summary: Thick strained yoghurt sweetened and scented with saffron and cardamom, topped with pistachio.

steps.text: Warm the milk and steep the saffron in it for 10 minutes.
Whisk the yoghurt, sugar, saffron milk and cardamom until smooth and glossy.
Spoon into cups and chill.
Top with pistachio just before serving.

notes: Plus 2 hours chilling. Snack. Dessert. Vegetarian and gluten-free.

title: Mahamri Cardamom Coconut Doughnuts
summary: Pillowy triangle doughnuts spiced with cardamom and coconut milk, fried until golden.

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, cardamom and salt, then add the warm coconut milk and knead for 8 minutes until smooth.
Cover and prove until doubled, then divide into 4 balls and roll each out 5mm thick.
Cut each into 3 triangles.
Heat the oil in a deep pan to 175°C and fry the triangles for 2 minutes each side until puffed and golden.
Drain on paper and serve warm.

notes: Plus 1 hour proving. Snack. Vegan.

title: Ethiopian-Style Honey Spice Bread
summary: A soft, slightly sweet loaf with honey, cardamom and fennel.

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, salt, cardamom and fennel, then stir in the water, honey and oil and knead for 10 minutes until smooth.
Cover and prove until doubled, shape into a round loaf and score the top.
Prove for 30 minutes, brush with beaten egg and bake at 190°C for 35 minutes until deep golden and hollow-sounding.
Cool on a rack before slicing.

notes: Plus 2 hours proving. Snack. Vegetarian.

title: Koeksister Syrup Plaits
summary: Twisted doughnut plaits fried crisp and soaked in an ice-cold lemon-ginger syrup.

steps.text: Make the syrup first by simmering the sugar, water, lemon juice and ginger for 10 minutes until syrupy, then chill until ice cold.
Rub the butter into the flour and baking powder, then mix in the egg and milk to a soft dough and rest.
Roll out 1cm thick, cut into strips and plait three strips together.
Fry in the oil at 175°C for 3 minutes each side until deep golden.
Dip the hot plaits straight into the cold syrup for 1 minute, drain on a rack and serve.

notes: Plus 1 hour chilling the syrup and 30 minutes resting the dough. Snack. Vegetarian.

title: Soetkoekies Spiced Sweet Biscuits
summary: Crisp, golden biscuits flavoured with ginger, cinnamon and a splash of sherry.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 170°C and line two trays.
Beat the butter and sugar for 3 minutes until pale, then beat in the egg and sherry.
Mix in the flour, baking powder and spices to a firm dough.
Roll out 5mm thick, cut into rounds and place on the trays.
