summary: Tender chicken thigh and soft egg simmered in sweet dashi and served over steamed rice.

items.raw: 500g chicken thigh, cut into bite-size pieces

steps.text: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and sticky, then keep it warm.
Simmer the dashi, soy sauce, mirin and sugar in a wide pan, add the onion and chicken and cook for 8 minutes.
Pour the eggs over in a spiral, cover and cook for 1 minute until just set but still soft.
Spoon over bowls of rice and top with spring onions.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C in the thickest piece, and wash hands after handling raw chicken. Contains egg. Use fresh, uncracked eggs; for pregnant women, older people, young children and anyone with low immunity, cook the eggs until the yolks are firm.

title: Ayam Goreng Lengkuas Galangal Fried Chicken
summary: Galangal-and-turmeric simmered chicken, shallow-fried until crisp, served with rice, cucumber and a fiery tomato sambal.

steps.text: Simmer the chicken with the garlic, turmeric, coriander, lime leaves, salt and water, covered, for 20 minutes until cooked through.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender. Grill the chillies, tomatoes, shallots and shrimp paste until charred, then blend with lime juice and salt into a sambal.
Drain the chicken and pat dry. Shallow-fry in the hot oil for 3 minutes each side until deep golden and crisp.
Serve the chicken with the rice, cucumber and sambal on the side.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C in the thickest part near the bone, and take care with the hot oil. Contains shellfish.

title: Chapli Kebab Pashtun Spiced Beef Patties
summary: Pakistani flat patties of spiced beef, tomato and coriander shallow-fried until crisp, served in flatbread.

steps.text: Mix the mince, onion, tomato, chillies, coriander, ginger, garlic, spices, salt, egg and chickpea flour by hand until sticky.
Shape into 8 flat, wide patties about 1cm thick.
Heat the oil in a wide frying pan over medium heat and fry the patties for 5 minutes each side until deep brown and crisp, cooked all the way through.
Drain on paper towel and serve in flatbreads with yoghurt.

notes: Food safety: cook the beef patties until they reach 75°C throughout with no pink, and wash hands after handling raw mince. Contains egg and dairy.

title: Soboro Don Three-Colour Mince and Egg Rice Bowl
summary: Sweet soy-glazed chicken mince and fluffy scrambled egg over steamed rice with blanched greens.

steps.text: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and sticky, then keep it warm. Blanch the beans in boiling water for 3 minutes until bright green and just tender, then slice.
Simmer the chicken with 2 tbsp soy sauce, mirin, 2 teaspoons of the sugar and the ginger over medium heat for 8 minutes, stirring with chopsticks until the liquid is gone.
Beat the eggs with the remaining soy sauce and sugar and scramble in the neutral oil over low heat for 3 minutes until fine and fluffy.
Divide the rice between bowls and arrange the chicken, egg and beans in neat sections.
Drizzle with sesame oil and serve straight away.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken mince until it reaches 75°C with no pink, and the eggs until set. Contains egg.

title: Yakiniku Don Japanese Beef Rice Bowl
summary: Quick-seared beef strips glazed in sweet soy and garlic, served over rice with spring onion and a soft egg.

steps.text: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and sticky, then keep it warm. Stir the garlic, soy sauce, mirin, sugar and sesame oil together.
Heat the neutral oil in a frying pan over high heat and sear the beef in two batches for 1 1/2 minutes each until browned.
Return all the beef, pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until sticky and glossy.
Spoon over bowls of rice, top with a yolk and the spring onions and finish with sesame seeds.

notes: Food safety: cook the beef until no pink remains; the egg yolks are served soft, so skip them for young children, older adults or anyone pregnant. Contains egg; check the thickest part reaches 75°C.

title: Kimchi Bokkeumbap Pork Belly Fried Rice
summary: Sharp, spicy Korean fried rice with kimchi, pork belly and a fried egg on top.

steps.text: Fry the pork belly in a hot wok for 6 minutes until the fat renders and the edges are crisp.
Add the kimchi and cook for 3 minutes until the edges caramelise, then stir in the gochujang and kimchi juice.
Add the cold rice, break it up and toss for 4 minutes until hot and lightly crisp, then add the soy sauce and half the sesame oil.
Fry the eggs in the neutral oil for 2 minutes until the whites are set and crisp at the edge.
Serve the rice topped with an egg, spring onions, sesame seeds and the rest of the sesame oil.

notes: Food safety: cook the pork belly until it reaches 75°C and the eggs until the whites are set; use rice cooled and refrigerated within 1 hour and eaten within a day. Contains egg.

title: Dakbokkeumtang Braised Chicken and Potato
summary: Korean chilli chicken braised with potato and carrot until the sauce is thick, sweet and fiery.

steps.text: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, then keep it covered. Mix the gochugaru, gochujang, soy sauce, sugar, garlic, ginger and sesame oil into a paste.
Put the chicken, potato, carrot and onion in a wide pot, stir in the paste and water and bring to the boil until bubbling.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes, then uncover and cook for 15 minutes, stirring now and then, until the potato is tender and the sauce thick and glossy.
Scatter over spring onions and serve with the rice.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C near the bone, and wash hands after handling raw chicken.

title: Dubu Jorim Braised Tofu in Spicy Soy
summary: Pan-fried tofu simmered in a garlicky gochugaru-soy sauce, served with rice.

steps.text: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, then keep it covered. Pat the tofu dry with paper towel.
Fry the tofu in the oil over medium-high heat for 4 minutes each side until golden, then arrange in a flat pan.
Mix the soy sauce, gochugaru, sesame oil, sugar, garlic, spring onions and water and spoon over the tofu.
Simmer on low for 8 minutes, spooning the sauce over, until the liquid has reduced and the tofu is glossy.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve with the rice.

notes: Vegan. Dinner.

title: Mala Xiang Guo Dry Pot Chicken and Vegetables
summary: Sichuan dry pot of chicken, mushrooms, lotus-style potato and greens, wok-fried with numbing and chilli spices.

items.raw: 600g chicken thigh, boneless, cut into bite-size pieces

steps.text: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, then keep it covered. Fry the potato batons in 2 tbsp of the oil for 5 minutes until golden, then set aside.
In the same wok fry the dried chillies and peppercorns in the remaining oil for 30 seconds, then add the ginger, garlic and chilli bean paste for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and stir-fry for 6 minutes until cooked through, then add the mushrooms, broccoli, soy sauce, sugar and water.
Cook for 4 minutes until the broccoli is just tender, return the potato and toss for 1 minute.
Scatter with sesame seeds and serve with the rice.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C in the thickest piece, and wash hands after handling raw chicken.

title: Yu Xiang Rou Si Fish-Fragrant Shredded Pork
summary: Sichuan stir-fry of shredded pork, capsicum and wood ear mushroom in a sweet, sour and spicy sauce.

items.raw: 500g pork loin, cut into thin strips

steps.text: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, then keep it covered. Toss the pork with 1 tbsp soy sauce and the cornflour.
Mix the remaining soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and 2 tbsp water into a sauce.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat and stir-fry the pork for 2 minutes until it turns opaque. Add the chilli bean paste, garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Add the capsicums and wood ear and stir-fry for 3 minutes, then pour in the sauce and toss until glossy and the pork is cooked through.
Scatter over spring onions and serve with the rice.

notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C and no pink remains, and wash hands after handling raw pork.

title: Dongpo Pork Red-Braised Pork Belly
summary: Square-cut pork belly slow-braised in Shaoxing wine, soy and rock sugar until it melts at the touch of a spoon.

steps.text: Blanch the pork in boiling water for 5 minutes, drain and rinse to remove scum.
Line a heavy pot with the ginger and spring onions, sit the pork on top skin side down and add the wine, both soy sauces, sugar and water.
Bring to a simmer, cover and cook on the lowest heat for 2 hours, turning the pork once, until a skewer slides in with no resistance.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender. Blanch the bok choy for 2 minutes until just tender.
Boil the sauce uncovered for 5 minutes until sticky and glossy and serve over rice with the greens.

notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C throughout and is meltingly tender, and chill leftovers within 2 hours.

title: Beef Chow Fun Wok-Fried Rice Noodles
summary: Silky wide rice noodles seared in a hot wok with sliced beef, bean sprouts and spring onion in soy.

steps.text: Separate the noodles gently and toss the beef with 1 tbsp soy sauce and the wine. Mix the remaining soy sauces, oyster sauce and sugar.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over very high heat and sear the beef for 1 1/2 minutes until browned. Remove.
Add the rest of the oil and the garlic, then the noodles and sauce and toss for 3 minutes until the noodles take on colour and char slightly.
Return the beef with the sprouts and spring onions and toss for 1 minute until the sprouts just wilt.
Serve straight from the wok.

notes: Food safety: cook the beef until browned and no pink remains, and wash hands after handling raw beef; check the thickest part reaches 75°C. Cool any leftover noodles and cooked rice and refrigerate within 1 hour.

title: Salt and Pepper Tofu Crisp Wok-Tossed Cubes
summary: Crisp-edged tofu tossed with garlic, chilli and white pepper, served over rice with sauteed greens.

steps.text: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, then keep it covered. Pat the tofu very dry and toss gently in the cornflour.
Shallow-fry the tofu in the oil over medium-high heat for 8 minutes, turning, until crisp and golden. Drain on paper towel.
Pour off all but 1 tbsp oil, fry the garlic, chillies and spring onions for 1 minute, then add the salt, white pepper and Sichuan pepper.
Return the tofu and toss for 1 minute until coated.
Stir-fry the bok choy with the soy sauce for 2 minutes until just tender and serve alongside the tofu and rice.

notes: Vegan. Dinner.

title: Hakka Yong Tau Foo Stuffed Tofu with Prawn Filling
summary: Hakka tofu puffs and capsicum stuffed with a prawn and pork filling, pan-fried then braised in a light soy sauce.

items.raw: 300g raw prawns, peeled and finely chopped

steps.text: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, then keep it covered. Mix the prawns, pork, spring onions, cornflour, ginger, sesame oil and pepper into a sticky paste.
Cut a pocket into each tofu puff and press in a spoonful of filling, smoothing the top.
Pan-fry the stuffed puffs filling side down in the oil over medium heat for 4 minutes until golden.
Add the oyster sauce, soy sauce and stock, cover and simmer for 12 minutes until the filling is firm and cooked through.
Uncover and boil for 2 minutes until the sauce thickens, then serve over the rice.

notes: Food safety: cook the filling until the prawns are opaque, firm throughout and the pork reaches 75°C, and wash hands after handling raw pork and prawns. Contains shellfish.

title: Mee Siam Goreng Spicy Tamarind Vermicelli
summary: Stir-fried vermicelli in a sweet, sour and spicy tamarind sauce with prawns, tofu puffs, egg and chives.

items.raw: 1 bunch garlic chives, cut in 4cm lengths

steps.text: Soak the vermicelli in hot water for 5 minutes and drain. Mix the chilli paste, tamarind, sugar and fish sauce with 1/2 cup water.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat and fry the shallots and garlic for 1 minute, then add the prawns and cook for 2 minutes until pink and opaque.
Add the tofu puffs and sauce, then the vermicelli, and toss for 3 minutes until the noodles absorb the sauce.
Push aside, scramble in the eggs for 1 minute, then fold through the sprouts and chives.
Serve hot with lime wedges on the side for squeezing over the top.

notes: Food safety: cook the prawns until pink and opaque and the eggs until set, with the noodles steaming hot at 75°C. Contains egg and shellfish.

title: Pepes Ikan Banana Leaf Steamed Fish with Spices
summary: Fish fillets covered in a turmeric, lemongrass and chilli paste and steamed in parcels, served with rice.

steps.text: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender. Blend the shallots, garlic, chillies, turmeric, lemongrass, tamarind, fish sauce and oil to a coarse paste.
Coat the fish in the paste, then place each fillet on a sheet of baking paper with tomato and basil and fold into a sealed parcel.
Steam the parcels over simmering water for 15 minutes until the fish is opaque and flakes easily.
Open the parcels and serve with the rice.

notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and flaking, at least 63°C in the thickest part, and keep raw fish chilled until cooking.

title: Goong Pad Pong Karee Thai Curry Powder Prawns
summary: Prawns and egg stir-fried in a creamy yellow curry sauce with capsicum and celery, served with jasmine rice.

steps.text: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, then keep it covered. Mix the curry powder, coconut milk, stock, oyster sauce, fish sauce and sugar.
Heat the oil in a wok over high heat, fry the garlic and onion for 2 minutes, then add the prawns and cook for 2 minutes until pink and opaque.
Pour in the sauce, add the capsicum and celery and simmer for 3 minutes.
Drizzle in the eggs in a thin stream and stir gently for 2 minutes until just set and creamy.
Fold through the spring onions and serve with the rice.

notes: Food safety: cook the prawns until pink and opaque and the eggs until set, with the sauce steaming hot at 75°C. Contains egg and shellfish. Use fresh, uncracked eggs; for pregnant women, older people, young children and anyone with low immunity, cook the eggs until the yolks are firm.

title: Com Chien Duong Chau Yangzhou Fried Rice Vietnamese Style
summary: Colourful fried rice with prawns, Chinese sausage, egg, peas and carrot.

steps.text: Fry the sausage in 1 tbsp oil in a wok over medium-high heat for 3 minutes until crisp at the edges, then add the prawns and cook for 2 minutes until pink. Remove.
Add the remaining oil, garlic and carrot and cook for 2 minutes, then pour in the eggs and scramble for 1 minute until just set.
Add the cold rice and toss for 3 minutes until hot, breaking up any clumps.
Return the prawns and sausage with the peas, fish sauce, soy sauce and pepper and toss for 2 minutes until steaming hot.
Fold through the spring onions and serve.

notes: Food safety: cook the prawns until pink and opaque and the rice steaming hot at 75°C; use cooked rice cooled and refrigerated within 1 hour and eaten within a day. Contains egg and shellfish.

title: Kaldereta Filipino Spicy Beef Stew
summary: Beef braised in tomato sauce with liver spread, capsicum, potato and olives until rich and tender.

steps.text: Brown the beef in the oil in batches for 8 minutes total, then fry the onion and garlic for 3 minutes in the same pot.
Add the passata, tomato paste, stock, chillies and bay leaves, cover and simmer for 1 hour 20 minutes until the beef is tender.
Add the potato and carrot and cook for 20 minutes until soft, then stir in the capsicum, olives and pate and cook for 5 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and serve with the stew.

notes: Food safety: cook the beef until fork-tender and well above 75°C, and chill leftovers within 2 hours.

title: Chicken Afritada Tomato Braised Chicken
summary: Filipino chicken braised with potato, carrot and capsicum in a light tomato sauce.

steps.text: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, then keep it covered. Brown the chicken in the oil for 8 minutes, then remove.
Fry the onion and garlic in the same pot for 3 minutes, then add the passata, stock, fish sauce and bay leaf and return the chicken.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes, add the potato and carrot and cook for 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the capsicum and peas for 4 minutes and serve with the rice.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C near the bone, and wash hands after handling raw chicken.

title: Dum Aloo Kashmiri Style Potato Curry
summary: Baby potatoes fried until crisp and slow-cooked in a spiced yoghurt and fennel gravy.

steps.text: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender. Boil the potatoes for 10 minutes until nearly tender, drain, prick with a fork and fry in 2 tbsp oil for 8 minutes until golden.
Whisk the yoghurt with the fennel, ginger, cardamom, chilli, turmeric and salt.
Fry the onions and garlic in the remaining oil for 8 minutes until golden, then reduce the heat and stir in the yoghurt mix.
Add the potatoes and 1/2 cup water, cover and cook on low for 12 minutes until the gravy is thick and the potatoes tender.
Stir in the garam masala and serve with the rice.

notes: Vegetarian. Dinner. Contains dairy.

title: Methi Malai Paneer with Rice
summary: Soft paneer in a creamy fenugreek and cashew gravy, served with basmati rice.

steps.text: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender. Blend the cashews with 1/2 cup water to a smooth paste.
Fry the onions in the ghee for 6 minutes until pale gold, add the ginger, garlic, chillies and cumin for 2 minutes.
Stir in the cashew paste, milk and 1/2 cup water and simmer for 6 minutes until thick.
Add the paneer, fenugreek, cream and salt and cook gently for 5 minutes until the paneer is hot and the sauce coats the back of a spoon.
Sprinkle with garam masala and serve with the rice.

notes: Vegetarian. Dinner. Contains dairy and cashews.

title: Kabuli Pulao Afghan Lamb and Carrot Rice
summary: Afghan-style rice with tender lamb, caramelised carrot and raisins scented with cardamom and cumin.

steps.text: Brown the lamb with the onions in half the oil in a heavy pot for 10 minutes, add the cumin, cardamom, salt and 3 cups water, cover and simmer for 45 minutes until tender.
Fry the carrot with the sugar in the remaining oil for 6 minutes until caramelised and add the raisins for 1 minute.
Lift the lamb out, measure the stock to 3 cups and add the soaked rice, then lay the lamb on top. Cover and cook on low for 18 minutes until the rice is tender.
Fold through half the carrot and raisin mix, top with the rest and the almonds and serve.

notes: Food safety: cook the lamb until fork-tender and well above 75°C, and chill leftovers within 2 hours. Contains nuts.

title: Chicken Muamba Gabonese-Style Palm Butter Chicken
summary: Chicken braised in a rich palm butter and tomato sauce with okra, served with rice.

steps.text: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, then keep it covered. Brown the chicken in the palm oil for 8 minutes, then remove.
Fry the onions and garlic for 4 minutes in the same pot, add the tomatoes and chilli and cook for 6 minutes until pulpy.
Stir in the peanut butter and stock, return the chicken and simmer covered for 20 minutes until cooked through.
Add the okra and salt and cook for 8 minutes until tender and the sauce is thick, then serve over the rice.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C near the bone, and wash hands after handling raw chicken. Contains peanuts.

title: Wali wa Maharage Kenyan Beans in Coconut with Rice
summary: Red kidney beans simmered in coconut milk with tomato, onion and spices, served over fluffy rice.

steps.text: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, then keep it covered.
Fry the onion in the oil for 5 minutes until golden, add the garlic, curry powder and turmeric for 1 minute, then the tomatoes for 5 minutes until pulpy.
Stir in the beans, coconut milk, water and salt and simmer for 15 minutes until the sauce is thick and the beans are creamy.
Scatter with coriander and serve over the rice.

notes: Vegan. Dinner.

title: Thieboudienne Senegalese Fish and Tomato Rice
summary: Senegal's red rice cooked in a tomato and fish broth with white fish and vegetables.

steps.text: Mix half the garlic with the chilli, a pinch of salt and press this into the fish, then sear the fish in the oil for 2 minutes each side. Remove.
Fry the onions in the same pot for 5 minutes, add the tomato paste and tomatoes for 5 minutes, then the water and fish sauce and bring to the boil.
Add the carrots, eggplant and cabbage and simmer for 20 minutes until tender, then lift out the vegetables and keep warm.
Add the rice to the broth, cover and cook on low for 18 minutes until tender and the liquid is absorbed, then return the fish for the last 5 minutes until opaque.
Serve the rice with the fish and vegetables on top.

notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and flaking, at least 63°C in the thickest part, and chill leftovers within 2 hours.

title: Momo Nepali Steamed Chicken Dumplings with Tomato Dip
summary: Juicy steamed chicken dumplings with ginger and coriander, served with a tangy roasted tomato dip.

steps.text: Mix the chicken, onion, half the garlic, ginger, coriander, cumin, soy sauce and oil with 1/2 tsp salt until sticky.
Place a heaped teaspoon of filling in each wrapper, then pleat the edges closed.
Grill the tomatoes under a hot grill for 8 minutes until blackened, then blend with the remaining garlic, chilli powder and a pinch of salt.
Steam the momo in batches in an oiled steamer for 12 minutes until the wrappers turn translucent.
Serve hot with the tomato dip.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken filling until it reaches 75°C in the centre of a dumpling. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Veg Momo Nepali Cabbage and Paneer Dumplings
summary: Steamed dumplings filled with cabbage, carrot and crumbled paneer, with a chilli and sesame dip.

steps.text: Salt the cabbage with 1/2 tsp salt, rest for 10 minutes, then squeeze out the water.
Mix the cabbage with the carrot, paneer, ginger, garlic, soy sauce, vegetable oil and cumin.
Fill and pleat the wrappers, using a heaped teaspoon each.
Steam for 12 minutes until the wrappers are translucent.
Stir the sesame oil, chilli powder and a splash of soy sauce for the dip and serve alongside.

title: Manti Afghan Beef Dumplings with Garlic Yoghurt
summary: Baked and steamed beef and onion dumplings under garlic yoghurt, tomato sauce and dried mint.

steps.text: Mix the beef with one onion, the coriander and 1/2 tsp salt. Fill the wrappers and pinch each into a small parcel.
Bake the manti on an oiled tray at 200°C for 15 minutes until lightly golden.
Soften the other onion in the oil over medium heat for 6 minutes, add the turmeric and tomatoes and simmer for 12 minutes.
Drop the manti into the sauce with 1/2 cup water and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir the garlic into the yoghurt, spoon over the manti and scatter with mint.

notes: Food safety: cook the beef filling until it reaches 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Mantu Afghan Pumpkin Dumplings with Lentil Sauce
summary: Vegetarian dumplings stuffed with spiced pumpkin and onion, finished with yoghurt and a lentil tomato sauce.

steps.text: Cook the pumpkin and one onion in 1 tbsp oil for 12 minutes until soft, then stir in the coriander, sugar and a pinch of salt.
Fill and fold the wrappers with a heaped teaspoon each.
Simmer the lentils with the remaining onion, oil, turmeric, tomatoes and 2 cups water for 20 minutes until thick.
Steam the dumplings for 12 minutes until the wrappers turn translucent.
Stir the garlic into the yoghurt and serve over the dumplings with the lentil sauce.

title: Jiaozi Chive and Egg Dumplings with Black Vinegar Dip
summary: Boiled dumplings full of soft egg, garlic chives and glass noodles, served with a sharp black vinegar dip.

steps.text: Soak the noodles in hot water for 5 minutes, drain and chop finely.
Scramble the eggs in the oil over medium heat for 2 minutes until just set, then break up and cool.
Mix the egg with the chives, vermicelli, sesame oil, 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1/2 tsp salt.
Fill and seal the wrappers, using a heaped teaspoon each.
Boil in batches for 4 minutes until they float, then drain.
Mix the rest of the soy sauce, vinegar and ginger and serve for dipping.

notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until set and the filling until it reaches 75°C. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Shengjian Bao Shanghai Pan-Fried Pork Buns
summary: Fluffy buns with a crisp sesame base and a juicy pork and spring onion filling.

steps.text: Knead the flour, yeast, sugar and 3/4 cup warm water into a smooth dough, then rise for 1 hour until doubled.
Mix the pork with half the spring onions, soy sauce, ginger, sesame oil and 1/4 cup water until sticky.
Divide the dough into 12 balls, flatten, fill with a spoonful of pork and pleat to seal.
Heat the oil in a lidded non-stick pan, add the buns seam-side down and fry for 3 minutes until golden.
Add 1/3 cup water, cover and steam for 10 minutes, then uncover and cook until the water has gone.
Scatter with sesame seeds and remaining spring onion.

notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C in the centre of a bun. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Nikuman Japanese Steamed Pork Buns
summary: Soft white steamed buns around a gently sweet pork, cabbage and shiitake filling.

steps.text: Knead the flour, yeast, sugar and 3/4 cup warm water into a smooth dough, then rise for 1 hour until doubled.
Mix the pork, cabbage, shiitake, soy sauce, mirin, sesame oil and ginger until sticky.
Divide the dough into 8, roll into rounds, fill each and gather the edges to seal.
Steam on baking paper squares for 15 minutes until puffed and firm.
Serve warm with soy sauce or chilli sauce for dipping.

notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Kimchi Mandu Korean Pork Dumplings
summary: Pan-fried pork and kimchi dumplings with tofu for a tender filling and a soy dipping sauce.

steps.text: Mix the pork, kimchi, tofu, spring onions, garlic and sesame oil.
Fill and seal the wrappers with a heaped teaspoon each.
Fry in the oil for 2 minutes until the bases are golden, add 1/3 cup water, cover and steam for 6 minutes.
Mix the soy sauce and vinegar for dipping and serve with the mandu.

notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Banh Bao Vietnamese Steamed Pork and Egg Buns
summary: Pillowy steamed buns filled with seasoned pork, mushrooms and a quarter of boiled egg.

items.raw: 4 dried shiitake mushrooms, soaked and chopped

steps.text: Knead the flour, yeast, sugar and 3/4 cup warm water, then rise for 1 hour until doubled.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool, peel and cut into quarters, keeping 8 pieces.
Mix the pork, mushrooms, spring onions, fish sauce and pepper.
Divide the dough into 8 rounds, fill each with pork and a piece of egg, then seal.
Steam for 18 minutes until puffed and the pork is cooked through.

notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C and hard-boil the eggs. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Siopao Asado Filipino Steamed Pork Buns
summary: Fluffy steamed buns with a sticky sweet soy pork filling in the Filipino style.

steps.text: Knead the flour, yeast, sugar and 3/4 cup warm water, then rise for 1 hour until doubled.
Brown the onion and garlic in the oil for 4 minutes, add the pork, soy sauce, brown sugar and 1/2 cup water, and simmer for 30 minutes until tender.
Stir the cornflour with 2 tbsp water into the pork and simmer for 2 minutes until thick, then cool.
Divide the dough into 8, fill each round and seal.
Steam for 15 minutes until puffed.

notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Yakitori Chicken Thigh Skewers with Tare Glaze
summary: Chicken thigh pieces grilled on skewers and brushed with a glossy soy and mirin glaze, served with rice.

items.raw: 600g boneless chicken thighs, cut in chunks

steps.text: Simmer the soy sauce, mirin, sugar and ginger for 6 minutes until syrupy.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Thread the chicken and spring onion alternately onto soaked bamboo sticks.
Grill over medium-high heat for 10 minutes, turning and brushing with the glaze, until golden.
Serve over the rice with the remaining glaze.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C in the thickest piece. Boil any glaze used on raw chicken before serving. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Seekh Kebab Pakistani Spiced Lamb Skewers
summary: Minced lamb with ginger, garlic and spices moulded on skewers and grilled, with mint yoghurt and flatbread.

steps.text: Knead the lamb with the onion, ginger, garlic, spices, coriander and 1 tsp salt for 3 minutes until sticky.
Mould around 8 flat skewers into long sausages and chill while the grill heats.
Grill over medium-high heat for 10 minutes, turning, until browned.
Stir the mint into the yoghurt and serve with the kebabs and warm flatbreads.

notes: Food safety: cook the lamb until it reaches 75°C throughout. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Fish Moilee Kerala Mild Coconut Fish Curry
summary: A gentle turmeric and coconut milk curry with firm fish, ideal for children, served with rice.

items.raw: 600g white fish fillet, cut in chunks

steps.text: Soften the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil for 6 minutes without browning.
Stir in the turmeric, tomato, coconut milk and 1/2 tsp salt and simmer for 6 minutes.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Add the fish and poach for 6 minutes until opaque and flaking.
Serve with the rice while hot, and spoon the sauce over the top.

notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and it reaches 63°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Macher Jhol Bengali Light Fish Curry with Potatoes
summary: A thin, fragrant turmeric and cumin fish stew with potatoes and tomato, served with rice.

items.raw: 600g white fish fillet, cut in pieces

steps.text: Rub the fish with half the turmeric and 1/2 tsp salt.
Heat the oil, fry the potatoes for 6 minutes until golden at the edges, then add the ginger, cumin, chilli, tomato and remaining turmeric.
Add 2 cups water, cover and simmer for 12 minutes until the potato is tender.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Slide in the fish and simmer gently for 5 minutes until cooked through.
Serve over the rice while hot, spooning the sauce over the top.

notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and it reaches 63°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Sarisha Maach Mustard-Paste Fish with Rice
summary: Fish gently cooked in a ground mustard and mustard oil sauce, a Bengali favourite, served with rice.

items.raw: 600g white fish fillet, cut in pieces

steps.text: Soak the mustard seeds in warm water for 10 minutes if possible, then blend with the chillies and 1/2 cup water until smooth.
Rub the fish with turmeric and 1/2 tsp salt.
Heat the oil, add the mustard paste and 1/2 cup water and simmer for 5 minutes.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Add the fish, cover and cook gently for 8 minutes until cooked through.
Serve with the rice while hot, and spoon the sauce over the top.

notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and it reaches 63°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Amok Trey Cambodian Steamed Fish in Coconut Curry
summary: Fish in a lemongrass and coconut curry custard steamed in small bowls, served with rice.

steps.text: Whisk the coconut milk, eggs, curry paste, fish sauce and sugar until smooth.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Fold the fish through the custard and divide among four heatproof bowls lined with spinach.
Steam for 20 minutes until the custard is set and the fish is cooked.
Serve with the rice while hot, and spoon the sauce over the top.

notes: Food safety: cook the custard and fish until set and the fish reaches 63°C. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Lok Lak Cambodian Pepper Beef with Lime Dip
summary: Seared beef cubes in a soy and oyster glaze over lettuce and tomato with a lime and pepper dip.

steps.text: Mix the beef with oyster sauce, soy sauce, sugar and garlic.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Sear the beef in the oil in two batches over high heat for 3 minutes each until browned.
Mix the lime juice, pepper and a pinch of salt for the dip.
Serve the beef on lettuce and tomato with the rice and dip.

notes: Food safety: cook the beef pieces until they reach 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Laap Lao Minced Pork with Toasted Rice and Herbs
summary: Warm minced pork with lime, chilli, toasted rice and herbs, served with sticky rice.

steps.text: Soak the glutinous rice for 1 hour if time allows, then steam for 25 minutes.
Toast the jasmine rice in a dry pan until golden and grind coarsely.
Cook the pork in a splash of water for 8 minutes, breaking it up, until no pink remains.
Off the heat stir in the lime juice, fish sauce, toasted rice, chilli flakes, herbs and spring onions.
Serve with the sticky rice.

notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Mohinga Burmese Fish Curry with Rice Noodles
summary: A comforting Burmese catfish-style stew with lemongrass, turmeric and chickpea flour served over rice noodles.

items.raw: 500g white fish fillet, cut in chunks

steps.text: Soften the onion, garlic and lemongrass in the oil for 8 minutes, add the turmeric and 4 cups water, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Whisk the chickpea flour with 1/2 cup water and stir in with the fish sauce, then simmer for 8 minutes until slightly thick.
Add the fish and poach for 6 minutes.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, peel and halve.
Soak or boil the noodles until tender, divide among bowls, ladle over the stew, top with egg and lime.

notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and it reaches 63°C, and hard-boil the eggs. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Ginataang Hipon Filipino Prawns in Coconut Milk
summary: Prawns simmered in garlicky coconut milk with chilli, served with steamed rice.

steps.text: Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Simmer the onion, garlic, ginger, chilli and coconut milk for 8 minutes.
Add the prawns and fish sauce and cook for 4 minutes until pink and curled.
Serve over the rice while hot, spooning the sauce over the top.

notes: Food safety: cook the prawns until pink and firm, about 63°C inside. Contains shellfish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Lu Rou Fan Taiwanese Braised Pork Belly Rice
summary: Pork belly braised in soy, rice wine and fried shallots until sticky, spooned over rice with a boiled egg.

items.raw: 700g pork belly, cut in small pieces

steps.text: Brown the pork belly in a dry pot for 8 minutes until the fat renders.
Add the soy sauce, wine, sugar, shallots, star anise, ginger and 3 cups water, then simmer covered for 1 hour.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, peel, and add to the pot for the last 15 minutes.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Spoon the pork and sauce over the rice with an egg each.

notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C and tender, and hard-boil the eggs. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Singapore-Style Chilli Prawns with Fried Bread
summary: Prawns in a sweet-sour tomato and chilli sauce with ribbons of egg, mopped up with toasted bread.

steps.text: Fry the garlic and ginger in the oil for 1 minute, add the tomatoes, paste, chilli sauce and 1/2 cup water, and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the prawns and cook for 4 minutes until pink.
Beat the eggs and pour in slowly while stirring to form ribbons, cooking 1 minute.
Toast the bread until golden and serve for dipping.

notes: Food safety: cook the prawns until pink and firm, about 63°C inside, and the egg until set. Contains shellfish and egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Dal Makhani Punjabi Black Lentil and Kidney Bean Plate
summary: Slow-simmered creamy lentils and kidney beans with tomato and a little butter, served with rice.

steps.text: Soften the onion in the butter for 8 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger and garam masala for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, lentils, beans and 2 cups water and simmer 40 minutes, mashing some beans.
Stir in the cream and simmer for 5 minutes.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender, then serve the dal over it until the plates are full.

title: Shami Kebab Lahori Lamb and Lentil Patties
summary: Soft pan-fried patties of minced lamb and chana dal with warm spices, served with mint yoghurt and flatbread.

steps.text: Simmer the lamb, lentils, onion, garlic, cumin, garam masala, 1 tsp salt and 1 cup water for 20 minutes until the water has gone and the lentils are soft.
Cool slightly, mince in a food processor until paste-like, then mix in the egg.
Shape into 12 patties and chill for 10 minutes so they hold together.
Fry in the oil for 3 minutes each side until browned and crisp.
Stir the mint into the yoghurt and serve with the patties and warm flatbreads.

notes: Food safety: cook the lamb until it reaches 75°C throughout, and the egg until set. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Malai Boti Lahori Creamy Chicken Skewers
summary: Mild chicken marinated in cream, yoghurt and white pepper then grilled, with rice and a squeeze of lemon.

items.raw: 700g boneless chicken breast, cut in chunks

steps.text: Mix the chicken with the cream, yoghurt, ginger, garlic, pepper, garam masala and 1 tsp salt, and thread onto skewers.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Grill over medium-high heat for 12 minutes, turning, until golden at the edges and cooked through.
Serve with the rice and lemon wedges for squeezing over.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C in the thickest piece. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Lahori Fried Fish with Chickpea Flour Crust
summary: Firm white fish in a spiced chickpea flour coating, fried until crisp, with lemon and mint yoghurt.

items.raw: 700g white fish fillet, cut in strips

steps.text: Toss the fish with the lemon juice and 1/2 tsp salt.
Mix the chickpea flour, cornflour and spices with 1/3 cup water into a thick batter and coat the fish.
Shallow-fry the fish in batches for 3 minutes each side until golden and crisp.
Drain on paper and stir the mint into the yoghurt to serve alongside.

notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and it reaches 63°C at the centre. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Chopan Kebab Afghan Lamb Chops with Flatbread
summary: Simple salt, pepper and onion lamb cutlets grilled until crusty, served with flatbread and grilled tomato.

steps.text: Rub the cutlets with the onion, garlic, coriander, pepper, oil and 1 tsp salt.
Grill the tomatoes cut-side down for 6 minutes until blistered.
Grill the cutlets over high heat for 4 minutes each side until browned and cooked to your liking.
Rest the lamb for 3 minutes and serve with the tomatoes and warmed flatbreads.

notes: Food safety: cook the lamb until it reaches 63°C at the thickest point, with 3 minutes rest. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Bolani Afghan Potato and Chive Stuffed Flatbread
summary: Thin fried flatbreads filled with mashed potato, chives and cumin, served with yoghurt and a tomato salsa.

steps.text: Mix the flour, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tbsp oil and 3/4 cup warm water into a soft dough, then rest 20 minutes.
Boil the potatoes for 12 minutes until soft, drain and mash with the chives, cumin, chilli and a pinch of salt.
Divide the dough into 4, roll thin, spread half of each round with filling, fold over and seal.
Fry in the remaining oil for 3 minutes each side until golden and crisp.
Serve with the yoghurt and diced tomato.

title: Sekuwa Nepali Charcoal-Style Grilled Pork
summary: Smoky pork pieces rubbed with ginger, garlic, timur-style pepper and mustard oil, grilled and served with rice.

steps.text: Rub the pork with the oil, ginger, garlic, spices and 1 tsp salt.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Grill or roast the pork at 220°C for 20 minutes, turning, until browned and tender.
Squeeze over the lemon and serve with the rice.

notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C in the thickest piece. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Dal Bhat Nepali Lentil Plate with Spinach and Potato Tarkari
summary: Lentil soup poured over rice, with a mild spiced potato and spinach side, and a squeeze of lime.

steps.text: Simmer the lentils with the turmeric and 3 cups water for 20 minutes until soft, then season with salt.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Fry the onion, garlic and cumin in the oil for 5 minutes, add the potatoes and 1/2 cup water and cook for 12 minutes until tender.
Stir in the spinach for 2 minutes until wilted.
Serve the rice with the dal and tarkari, with lime wedges.

title: Thukpa Nepali Chicken Noodle Curry
summary: A warming bowl of chicken, noodles and vegetables in a mild ginger and tomato broth.

steps.text: Fry the onion, ginger and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the cumin and tomatoes for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken and 5 cups water and simmer for 12 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Add the carrots and cabbage and simmer for 5 minutes until tender.
Boil the noodles separately for 4 minutes, drain and divide among bowls.
Ladle over the broth and finish with the soy sauce.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Mappas Kerala Chicken in Gentle Coconut Gravy
summary: A mild coconut milk chicken stew with potatoes, peppercorns and cardamom, served with rice.

items.raw: 700g boneless chicken thighs, cut in chunks

steps.text: Soften the onion, ginger and garlic in the oil for 6 minutes.
Add the chicken, potatoes, pepper, cardamom and 1 tsp salt and cook for 4 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk and 1/2 cup water and simmer for 20 minutes until the chicken and potato are tender.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, and serve the stew over it.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Kerala Vegetable Stew with Appam-Style Pancakes
summary: Vegetables in a mild coconut milk stew served with soft rice-flour pancakes.

steps.text: Whisk the rice flour, yeast, sugar, a pinch of salt and 1 1/4 cups warm water into a batter, then rest for 1 hour.
Soften the onion and ginger in the oil for 5 minutes, add the potatoes, carrots, pepper and 1 cup water, and cook 12 minutes until tender.
Add the beans and coconut milk and simmer for 6 minutes until the beans are tender.
Pour small ladles of batter into a hot non-stick pan, swirl and cook covered for 2 minutes until set and lacy at the edges.
Serve the pancakes with the stew.

title: Bhapa Maach Bengali Steamed Mustard Fish Parcels
summary: Fish pieces steamed with mustard paste and green chilli in foil parcels, served with rice.

items.raw: 600g white fish fillet, cut in pieces

steps.text: Blend the mustard seeds, chillies, coconut and 1/3 cup water into a coarse paste, then stir in the turmeric, oil and 1 tsp salt.
Coat the fish and wrap in foil or banana leaf parcels.
Steam for 15 minutes until the fish is opaque and flakes easily.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, and serve with the parcels.

notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and it reaches 63°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Kosha Mangsho Bengali Slow-Cooked Lamb Curry
summary: Lamb slowly browned with onions and spices until the sauce clings, served with rice.

steps.text: Brown the onions in the oil for 15 minutes until deep golden.
Add the ginger, garlic, spices and yoghurt and cook for 5 minutes until the oil separates.
Add the lamb and cook 10 minutes, then add 1 cup water and the potatoes, cover and simmer for 1 hour until tender.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, then serve with the curry.

notes: Food safety: cook the lamb until it reaches 75°C and is tender. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Hyderabadi Chicken Dum Biryani
summary: Spiced chicken and fragrant rice layered and steamed together under a tight lid.

items.raw: 700g boneless chicken thighs, cut in chunks

steps.text: Brown the onions in the oil for 15 minutes until deep golden, then set half aside.
Add the ginger, garlic, spices, yoghurt, chicken and 1 tsp salt to the remaining onions and cook 12 minutes.
Boil the rice in salted water for 5 minutes until just par-cooked, then drain.
Layer the rice over the chicken with the mint and reserved onions, cover tightly and cook on low heat for 25 minutes until the rice is tender.
Fluff gently with a fork and serve straight from the pot.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Lucknowi Chicken Korma Mild Almond Curry
summary: A creamy, mild chicken curry with yoghurt and ground almonds, good for children, served with rice.

items.raw: 700g boneless chicken thighs, cut in chunks

steps.text: Soften the onions in the butter for 10 minutes without browning, then add the ginger, garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and brown lightly for 5 minutes.
Stir in the yoghurt, almonds and 1 cup water and simmer for 20 minutes until the chicken is tender.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, and serve with the curry.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Kadhi Pakora Punjabi Yoghurt Curry with Chickpea Fritters
summary: A tangy turmeric yoghurt curry holding soft onion fritters, served with rice.

steps.text: Whisk the yoghurt, 1/4 cup chickpea flour, turmeric and 3 cups water until smooth, then simmer for 25 minutes, stirring, until thickened.
Mix the remaining chickpea flour with the onion, half the cumin, 1/2 tsp salt and 3 tbsp water into a thick batter.
Fry spoonfuls in 2 tbsp oil for 3 minutes each side until golden, then add to the kadhi.
Heat the last tbsp oil, sizzle the mustard seeds, cumin and chilli for 30 seconds and pour over.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, and serve with the kadhi.

title: Gujarati Vegetarian Thali with Dal, Potato Curry and Rotis
summary: A balanced plate of sweet-sour dal, spiced potato and cauliflower and soft rotis.

steps.text: Simmer the lentils with the turmeric and 3 cups water for 20 minutes until soft, then stir in the sugar, lemon juice and salt.
Knead the flour with 1/2 cup water and 1 tbsp oil, rest 10 minutes, then roll into 8 thin rounds.
Sizzle the mustard seeds and cumin in the remaining oil, add the potatoes, cauliflower and 1/2 cup water, and cook covered 15 minutes until tender.
Cook the rotis in a dry pan for 1 minute each side until blistered.
Serve everything on a plate.

title: Pav Bhaji Mumbai Spiced Vegetable Mash with Buttered Rolls
summary: A buttery spiced tomato and vegetable mash scooped up with toasted rolls.

steps.text: Boil the potatoes and cauliflower for 12 minutes until soft, then drain.
Fry the onion and capsicum in 2 tbsp butter for 6 minutes, add the tomatoes and spices and cook 8 minutes until pulpy.
Add the boiled vegetables and peas, mash roughly while cooking 8 minutes until thick.
Toast the split rolls in the remaining butter until golden.
Serve the bhaji with the rolls and lemon wedges.

title: Galle-Style Ambul Thiyal Peppery Sour Fish
summary: Dry-style fish curry cooked with black pepper and tamarind, served with rice.

items.raw: 600g white fish fillet, cut in chunks

steps.text: Mix the tamarind, pepper, turmeric, garlic, ginger, 1 tsp salt and 1/2 cup water.
Add the fish and simmer gently for 20 minutes until the liquid has reduced and clings.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Stir in the oil and serve with the rice.

notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and it reaches 63°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Tehari Dhaka Beef and Potato Rice
summary: Aromatic rice cooked with tender beef, potato and mustard oil, Dhaka style.

steps.text: Brown the onions in the oil for 12 minutes, then add the ginger, garlic and spices for 2 minutes.
Add the beef and 1 tsp salt and cook 8 minutes, then add 2 cups water, cover and simmer for 40 minutes until tender.
Add the potatoes, rice and 2 more cups water and simmer covered 15 minutes until the rice is tender.
Rest covered for 5 minutes before fluffing.

notes: Food safety: cook the beef until it reaches 75°C and is tender. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Murgir Jhol Bangladeshi Home-Style Chicken Curry
summary: A light, thin-gravy chicken and potato curry for everyday rice.

steps.text: Brown the onions in the oil for 10 minutes, then add the ginger, garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook 6 minutes, then add the potatoes, 2 cups water and 1 tsp salt.
Cover and simmer for 25 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the potato tender.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, and serve with the curry.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C near the bone. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Tandoori Prawns with Mint Chutney Yoghurt
summary: Prawns in a spiced yoghurt coating grilled until charred at the edges.

steps.text: Mix the prawns with half the yoghurt, ginger, garlic, spices, oil, lemon juice and 1/2 tsp salt.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Grill the prawns on skewers for 5 minutes, turning, until pink and lightly charred.
Stir the mint into the remaining yoghurt and serve with the prawns and rice.

notes: Food safety: cook the prawns until pink and firm, about 63°C inside. Contains shellfish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Kashmiri Rogan Josh Lamb Curry
summary: Lamb slowly cooked in a ginger, fennel and chilli yoghurt gravy with a deep red colour.

steps.text: Brown the lamb in the oil for 8 minutes in batches, then remove.
Soften the onions in the same pot for 8 minutes, add the ginger, garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Return the lamb with the yoghurt and 1 cup water, cover, and simmer for 1 hour until tender.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, and serve with the curry.

notes: Food safety: cook the lamb until it reaches 75°C and is tender. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Mangalorean Chicken Ghee Roast
summary: Chicken in a dry-roasted red chilli and spice paste cooked in ghee until sticky.

items.raw: 800g boneless chicken thighs, cut in chunks

steps.text: Soak the chillies in hot water 10 minutes, then blend with the spices, tamarind and garlic into a paste.
Rub the chicken with the paste and 1 tsp salt.
Cook the chicken in the ghee over medium heat for 25 minutes, stirring, until dark and the oil clings.
Stir in the sugar and cook for 2 minutes.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, and serve.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Menchi Katsu Japanese Crumbed Beef and Pork Patties
summary: Juicy crumbed mince patties fried until crisp, served with rice, shredded cabbage and tonkatsu-style sauce.

steps.text: Mix the beef, pork, onion, egg, breadcrumbs, soy sauce and 1/2 tsp salt, then shape into 8 oval patties.
Cook the rice until tender and sticky.
Dust the patties in flour, dip in a thin paste of 1/2 cup flour and 1/2 cup water, then coat in panko.
Shallow-fry in the oil for 4 minutes each side until golden and cooked through.
Mix the tomato sauce and Worcestershire sauce for the dipping sauce and serve with the cabbage and rice.

notes: Food safety: cook the mince patties until they reach 75°C in the centre. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Tatsuta-Age Japanese Soy Ginger Fried Chicken
summary: Chicken thigh marinated in soy, ginger and sake, coated in potato starch and fried until crisp, with rice.

items.raw: 700g boneless chicken thighs, cut in chunks

steps.text: Toss the chicken with the soy sauce, sake, ginger and garlic.
Cook the rice until tender and sticky.
Coat the chicken in cornflour and shallow-fry in batches for 6 minutes, turning, until deep golden and cooked through.
Serve with the rice and lemon wedges.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C in the thickest piece. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Chashu Pork Rice Bowls with Soft Egg
summary: Pork belly rolled-style braised in soy, mirin and ginger, sliced over rice with a soft-boiled egg.

steps.text: Brown the pork belly in a dry pot for 8 minutes on all sides.
Add the soy sauce, mirin, sugar, ginger and 1 cup water, cover, and simmer for 1 hour 15 minutes until tender, turning twice.
Boil the eggs for 6 minutes, cool in cold water, peel and marinate in a little braising liquid.
Cook the rice until tender and sticky.
Slice the pork, serve over the rice with an egg each, spoon over the liquid and scatter the spring onion.

notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C and is tender; boil the eggs for at least 6 minutes. Contains egg. Not suitable for anyone avoiding runny yolks. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour. Use fresh, uncracked eggs; for pregnant women, older people, young children and anyone with low immunity, cook the eggs until the yolks are firm.

title: Tempura Prawn and Vegetable Plate with Rice
summary: Light, crisp prawns and vegetables in ice-cold batter, served with rice and a soy dipping sauce.

steps.text: Cook the rice until tender and sticky.
Mix the soy sauce, mirin and 2 tbsp water for dipping.
Stir the flour, cornflour and iced water together lightly, leaving lumps.
Heat the oil to 180°C, dip the prawns and vegetables and fry in batches for 3 minutes until pale golden and crisp.
Drain on paper and serve straight away with the rice and dipping sauce.

notes: Food safety: cook the prawns until pink and firm, about 63°C inside. Contains shellfish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Samgyeopsal Korean Grilled Pork Belly Lettuce Wraps
summary: Crisp-edged pork belly slices wrapped in lettuce with rice, garlic and a sesame ssamjang-style dip.

steps.text: Mix the miso, gochujang, sesame oil, spring onion and sesame seeds for the dip.
Cook the rice until tender and sticky.
Grill or pan-fry the pork belly for 4 minutes each side until golden and cooked through.
Fry the garlic in the pork fat for 2 minutes until golden.
Wrap pork, rice, garlic and dip in lettuce leaves and eat in one bite.

notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Dakgangjeong Korean Sticky Crispy Chicken Bites
summary: Crisp fried chicken pieces tossed in a sweet, garlicky soy and gochujang glaze, served with rice.

items.raw: 700g boneless chicken thighs, cut in chunks

steps.text: Coat the chicken in cornflour and a pinch of salt.
Cook the rice until tender and sticky.
Shallow-fry in batches for 7 minutes until deep golden and cooked through.
Simmer the soy sauce, honey, gochujang and garlic for 4 minutes until syrupy, then toss the chicken through.
Scatter with sesame seeds and serve over the rice.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C in the thickest piece. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Gua Bao Taiwanese Braised Pork Belly Buns with Peanut
summary: Folded steamed buns with soy-braised pork belly, pickled cucumber, coriander and crushed peanuts.

steps.text: Simmer the pork belly in the soy sauce, sugar, star anise, ginger and 2 cups water, covered, for 1 hour 15 minutes until tender.
Toss the cucumber with the vinegar and a pinch of sugar and salt.
Slice the pork thickly and reduce the braising liquid for 5 minutes until glossy.
Steam the buns for 5 minutes until soft and hot.
Fill each bun with pork, cucumber, coriander and peanuts, and spoon over a little liquid.

notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C and is tender. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Taiwanese Popcorn Chicken Rice Plate with Basil
summary: Crunchy five-spice chicken bites fried with basil, served over rice with pickled cucumber.

items.raw: 700g boneless chicken thighs, cut in small chunks

steps.text: Toss the chicken with the soy sauce, five spice, pepper and garlic.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Coat the chicken in the starch, shake off the excess and fry in batches for 5 minutes until crisp and cooked through.
Fry the basil in the hot oil for 15 seconds until crisp.
Toss the cucumber with the vinegar and serve with the chicken, basil and rice.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C in the thickest piece. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Lo Mai Gai Cantonese Sticky Rice with Chicken and Mushroom
summary: Glutinous rice steamed with chicken, shiitake, oyster sauce and a hint of sesame, in foil parcels.

items.raw: 6 dried shiitake mushrooms, soaked and sliced

steps.text: Soak the rice in water for 2 hours if possible, then drain.
Marinate the chicken with the oyster sauce, soy sauce, ginger and sesame oil.
Mix the chicken, mushrooms and rice, season with salt, and divide among 4 foil parcels.
Steam for 40 minutes until the rice is tender and the chicken is cooked through.
Open the parcels and scatter with spring onion.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Da Pan Ji Xinjiang Big Plate Chicken with Hand-Pulled-Style Noodles
summary: Chicken and potato braised in a star anise and chilli sauce, poured over wide noodles.

steps.text: Brown the chicken in the oil for 8 minutes, then add the onion, garlic, ginger, star anise and chilli flakes.
Add the soy sauce, potatoes and 2 cups water and simmer covered for 25 minutes until the potato is tender.
Add the capsicum for 5 minutes.
Boil the noodles for 5 minutes until tender, drain and top with the chicken.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C near the bone. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Gong Bao Ji Ding Sichuan Kung Pao Chicken with Peanuts
summary: Quick-fried chicken with dried chilli, Sichuan pepper and roasted peanuts in a sweet-sour glaze, with rice.

steps.text: Toss the chicken with 1 tbsp soy sauce and the cornflour.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Mix the remaining soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and 2 tbsp water for the sauce.
Stir-fry the chillies and Sichuan pepper in the oil for 30 seconds, add the chicken and fry for 6 minutes until cooked through.
Add the garlic, spring onions, peanuts and sauce, and toss for 2 minutes until glossy. Serve over rice.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C. Contains peanuts. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Hakka Salt-Baked Style Chicken with Ginger Spring Onion Oil
summary: Roasted whole chicken pieces rubbed with salt and five spice, served with rice and ginger oil.

steps.text: Rub the chicken with the five spice and 2 tsp salt, and roast at 200°C for 45 minutes until the skin is golden and crisp.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Heat the oil until shimmering and pour over the ginger, spring onion and soy sauce for the oil.
Rest the chicken 5 minutes, then serve with the oil and rice.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C near the bone. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Pla Rad Prik Thai Crispy Fish with Sweet Chilli Sauce
summary: Crisp-fried fish fillets topped with a sweet, sour and garlicky chilli sauce, served with rice.

steps.text: Dust the fish in cornflour and a pinch of salt.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Fry the fish for 4 minutes each side until golden and crisp, then drain.
Fry the garlic and chillies in a little oil for 1 minute, add the sweet chilli sauce, fish sauce, vinegar, sugar and 1/4 cup water and simmer for 3 minutes until syrupy.
Pour over the fish and serve with the rice.

notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and it reaches 63°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Tod Mun Pla Thai Fish Cakes with Cucumber Dip
summary: Springy fish cakes with red curry paste and green beans, fried until golden, served with rice and a sweet cucumber dip.

steps.text: Blend the fish with the curry paste, egg and fish sauce into a sticky paste, then fold through the beans.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Stir the cucumber, vinegar, sugar and a pinch of salt for the dip.
Shape into 12 patties and fry for 3 minutes each side until golden and cooked through.
Serve the fish cakes with rice and dip.

notes: Food safety: cook the fish cakes until they reach 63°C in the centre and the egg is set. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Hor Mok Thai Steamed Fish Curry Custard
summary: A soft, mousse-like steamed fish and coconut curry custard served with jasmine rice.

steps.text: Blend the fish with the curry paste, eggs, half the coconut milk and fish sauce until smooth.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Divide the spinach among four heatproof bowls, then pour in the fish mixture.
Steam for 20 minutes until just set, then spoon over the remaining warm coconut milk.
Serve with the rice while hot, spooning the sauce over the top.

notes: Food safety: cook the custard until set and the fish reaches 63°C. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Sai Ua Northern Thai Herb Pork Sausage Patties
summary: Spiced pork patties with lemongrass, galangal-style ginger and curry paste, grilled and served with sticky rice.

steps.text: Mix the pork, curry paste, lemongrass, ginger, lime leaves and fish sauce until sticky.
Steam the rice until tender, about 25 minutes.
Shape into 8 patties and fry in the oil for 5 minutes each side until browned and cooked through.
Serve with the sticky rice.

notes: Food safety: cook the pork patties until they reach 75°C in the centre. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Bun Thit Nuong Vietnamese Grilled Pork with Vermicelli
summary: Lemongrass pork slices over rice noodles with herbs, cucumber and nuoc cham dressing.

steps.text: Marinate the pork with the lemongrass, garlic, 1 tbsp fish sauce and 2 teaspoons sugar.
Soak or boil the noodles until tender, rinse and drain.
Grill the pork over high heat for 4 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Stir the lime juice, remaining fish sauce, sugar and 2 tbsp water for the dressing.
Serve the pork over noodles with the vegetables, herbs and dressing.

notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Cha Gio Vietnamese Pork and Prawn Spring Rolls
summary: Crisp rolls of pork, prawn, mushroom and glass noodle fried until golden, served with lettuce and herbs.

items.raw: 4 dried shiitake mushrooms, soaked and chopped

steps.text: Soak the noodles until soft and chop.
Mix the pork, prawns, noodles, mushrooms, carrot, fish sauce and pepper.
Roll a tablespoon of filling in each wrapper, folding in the sides and sealing with water.
Fry in the oil in batches for 6 minutes, turning, until deep golden and cooked through.
Wrap in lettuce with mint to eat.

notes: Food safety: cook the rolls until the filling reaches 75°C and the prawns are opaque and pink (63°C). Contains shellfish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Rawon East Javanese Black Beef Stew with Rice
summary: Beef slow-cooked in a dark, earthy spice paste with lemongrass and lime leaves, served with rice.

steps.text: Blend the onion, garlic, ginger and spices with 1/2 cup water into a paste and fry in the oil for 6 minutes.
Add the beef, lemongrass, lime leaves and 3 cups water and simmer covered for 1 hour 15 minutes until tender.
Stir in the tamarind and 1 tsp salt and simmer for 5 minutes.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, and serve with the stew.

notes: Food safety: cook the beef until it reaches 75°C and is tender. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Sambal Goreng Udang Indonesian Prawns in Chilli Tomato Sauce
summary: Prawns in a spicy chilli and tomato sauce with coconut milk, served with rice.

steps.text: Fry the onion, garlic and chilli in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the tomatoes and tamarind and cook for 5 minutes until pulpy.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Pour in the coconut milk and 1/2 tsp salt, add the prawns and simmer for 4 minutes until pink and firm.
Serve over the rice while hot, spooning the sauce over the top.

notes: Food safety: cook the prawns until pink and firm, about 63°C inside. Contains shellfish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Murtabak Malaysian Stuffed Pan-Fried Flatbread with Spiced Lamb
summary: Thin flatbread folded around spiced lamb, onion and egg, fried until crisp.

steps.text: Fry the lamb, one onion, curry powder and ginger in 1 tbsp oil for 10 minutes until the lamb is cooked through and dry.
Beat the eggs, stir in the lamb, second onion and 1/2 tsp salt.
Place a quarter of the mixture in the centre of each flatbread and fold in the sides to make a square parcel.
Fry in the remaining oil for 4 minutes each side until golden and the egg is set.
Cut in squares and serve with sliced cucumber.

notes: Food safety: cook the lamb until it reaches 75°C and the egg until fully set. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Roti John Malaysian Egg and Minced Beef Sandwich
summary: Bread fried with a savoury beef and egg topping, a Malaysian street favourite, served with chilli sauce.

steps.text: Fry the beef and onion in the oil for 8 minutes until cooked through and browned.
Whisk the eggs with the beef mixture and a pinch of salt.
Cook the roll halves cut-side down in a pan, pouring a quarter of the egg mixture on each, for 4 minutes until the egg is set and the bread crisp.
Drizzle with the chilli and tomato sauces and serve in squares.

notes: Food safety: cook the beef until it reaches 75°C and the egg until set. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Sambal Stingray-Style Grilled Fish in Banana Leaf
summary: White fish fillets topped with a fiery sambal and grilled in foil parcels, served with rice.

steps.text: Blend the chillies, shallots, garlic, shrimp paste, tamarind, sugar and oil into a sambal.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Spread the sambal over the fish, wrap in foil and grill or bake at 200°C for 15 minutes until the fish flakes.
Serve with the rice and lime wedges.

notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and it reaches 63°C. Contains shellfish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Menudo Filipino Pork and Vegetable Tomato Stew
summary: Pork cubes simmered with potatoes, carrots and capsicum in a tomato sauce, served with rice.

steps.text: Fry the onion and garlic in the oil for 4 minutes, then add the pork and brown for 6 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, soy sauce and 1 cup water and simmer covered for 20 minutes.
Add the potatoes and carrots and simmer for 15 minutes until the pork and vegetables are tender, adding the capsicum for the last 5.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, and serve with the stew.

notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C and is tender. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Embutido Filipino Baked Pork Meatloaf with Sweet Pickle
summary: A baked pork loaf with carrot, raisins and a boiled egg centre, sliced and served with rice.

steps.text: Boil 2 eggs for 9 minutes, cool and peel.
Mix the pork, carrot, raisins, breadcrumbs, remaining egg, soy sauce, pepper and 1/2 tsp salt.
Press half the mixture into a lined loaf tin, lay in the boiled eggs, then cover with the rest.
Bake at 180°C for 50 minutes until firm and browned, brushing with tomato sauce for the last 10.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, rest the loaf 10 minutes, slice and serve.

notes: Food safety: cook the pork loaf until it reaches 75°C in the centre, and hard-boil the eggs. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Pochero Filipino Chicken and Banana Tomato Stew
summary: A mild tomato stew with chicken, chickpeas, potatoes and green beans served over rice.

steps.text: Fry the onion and garlic in the oil for 4 minutes, then brown the chicken for 6 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, fish sauce, potatoes, chickpeas and 1 cup water and simmer covered for 25 minutes until the potato is tender.
Add the beans for 5 minutes until just tender.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, and serve with the stew.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C near the bone. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Paksiw na Isda Filipino Vinegar-Poached Fish with Ginger
summary: White fish gently simmered with vinegar, ginger, garlic and green chilli, served with rice.

items.raw: 700g white fish fillet, cut in pieces

steps.text: Layer the onion, ginger, garlic and chillies in a wide pan.
Add the fish, vinegar, 1/2 cup water, pepper and 1/2 tsp salt and bring to a boil without stirring until bubbling.
Simmer covered for 12 minutes until the fish is opaque and flakes.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, and serve with the fish and pan juices.

notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and it reaches 63°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Escabeche Filipino Sweet and Sour Fried Fish with Vegetables
summary: Crisp fried fish topped with a sweet-sour sauce of capsicum, carrot and ginger, served with rice.

items.raw: 1 tbsp fresh ginger, cut in thin sticks

steps.text: Dust the fish in flour and salt, then fry 4 minutes each side until golden and cooked through.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Simmer the vinegar, sugar, ginger, carrot and 1/2 cup water for 4 minutes, then add the capsicum and cornflour mixed with 2 tbsp water, and stir until glossy.
Pour over the fish and serve with the rice.

notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and it reaches 63°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Mechado Filipino Braised Beef in Tomato and Soy
summary: Beef braised until fall-apart with potatoes, carrots and a tangy tomato-soy sauce, served with rice.

steps.text: Brown the beef in the oil in batches for 10 minutes, then fry the onion and garlic for 4 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, soy sauce, lemon juice, bay leaf and 2 cups water and simmer covered for 1 hour 15 minutes until the beef is tender.
Add the potatoes and carrots and cook for 20 minutes until soft.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, and serve with the beef.

notes: Food safety: cook the beef until it reaches 75°C and is tender. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Waakye Ghanaian Rice and Beans with Egg and Tomato Stew
summary: Rice and black-eyed beans cooked together, served with boiled eggs and a spicy tomato stew.

steps.text: Simmer the rice and peas together with 2 cups water and 1/2 tsp salt covered for 18 minutes until tender.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool and peel.
Fry the onion and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes, add the tomatoes and chilli and cook for 15 minutes until thick.
Serve the rice and beans with the stew and halved eggs.

notes: Food safety: hard-boil the eggs until the yolk is firm. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Poulet DG Cameroonian Chicken with Plantain and Vegetables
summary: Pan-fried chicken in a tomato and herb sauce with fried plantain, carrots and green beans.

steps.text: Brown the chicken in 2 tbsp oil for 10 minutes, then remove.
Fry the onion, garlic and ginger in the same pan for 5 minutes, add the tomatoes and thyme and cook 8 minutes.
Return the chicken with 1 cup water and the carrots and simmer covered for 20 minutes until cooked through, adding the beans for 5.
Fry the plantain in the remaining oil for 3 minutes each side until golden, and serve on the side.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C near the bone. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Domoda Gambian Peanut Butter Stew with Sweet Potato and Rice
summary: A smooth peanut and tomato stew with chicken and sweet potato, served with rice.

steps.text: Fry the onion and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes, add the chicken and brown 5 minutes.
Stir the peanut butter and tomato paste into 3 cups water and add with the sweet potato and 1/2 tsp salt.
Simmer for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce thick.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, and serve with the stew.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C. Contains peanuts. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Durban Chicken Curry with Potatoes and Roti
summary: A fragrant Durban-style chicken curry with potato, served with flatbread.

steps.text: Fry the onions in the oil for 8 minutes, add the garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and chicken and cook 8 minutes, then add the potatoes and 1 cup water.
Simmer covered 25 minutes until the chicken is cooked and the potato tender.
Warm the flatbreads and serve with the curry.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C near the bone. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Pap en Wors South African Maize Porridge with Sausage and Tomato Relish
summary: Grilled sausages with soft polenta-style pap and a quick tomato and onion gravy.

steps.text: Bring 4 cups water and 1/2 tsp salt to a boil and whisk in the polenta, then cook on low for 20 minutes until thick, stirring often.
Fry the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, add the tomatoes, paste and sugar and simmer for 10 minutes until saucy.
Grill or pan-fry the sausages for 12 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through.
Serve the sausages on the pap with the relish.

notes: Food safety: cook the sausages until they reach 75°C in the centre. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Mishkaki Swahili Marinated Beef Skewers with Coconut Rice
summary: Tender beef skewers marinated with garlic, lemon and paprika, grilled and served with coconut rice.

steps.text: Mix the beef with the garlic, ginger, lemon juice, spices, oil and 1 tsp salt.
Cook the rice with the coconut milk and 1 cup water until tender and fluffy.
Thread the beef onto skewers and grill for 10 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through.
Serve with the coconut rice.

notes: Food safety: cook the beef until it reaches 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Firfir Ethiopian Shredded Injera in Spiced Beef Sauce
summary: Torn flatbread soaked in a spicy beef and tomato sauce, a hearty Ethiopian breakfast-or-dinner plate.

steps.text: Cook the onions dry for 8 minutes, add the oil, garlic, ginger and spices and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the beef, tomatoes and 1 cup water and simmer covered for 30 minutes until the beef is tender.
Fold the torn flatbread through for 2 minutes until it absorbs the sauce.

notes: Food safety: cook the beef until it reaches 75°C and is tender. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Beef Sambusa Somali Spiced Pastry Pockets with Lime Yoghurt
summary: Crisp baked pastry triangles filled with spiced beef, onion and coriander.

steps.text: Fry the onion, garlic and beef in 1 tbsp oil for 10 minutes until cooked through, then add the spices, salt and coriander and cool.
Fold the wrappers around a spoonful of filling into triangles, sealing with water.
Brush with the remaining oil and bake at 200°C for 15 minutes until crisp and golden.
Stir lime juice into the yoghurt and serve alongside.

notes: Food safety: cook the beef filling until it reaches 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Kenyan Grilled Tilapia-Style Fish with Tomato Salsa and Ugali
summary: Whole-style white fish grilled with chilli and lemon, served with a tomato and onion salsa and maize porridge.

steps.text: Rub the fish with the lemon juice, garlic, chilli, oil and 1/2 tsp salt.
Bring 3 cups water to a boil, whisk in the polenta and stir over low heat for 15 minutes until thick and stiff.
Grill the fish for 4 minutes each side until opaque and flaking.
Mix the tomatoes, onion and a pinch of salt for the salsa and serve all together.

notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and it reaches 63°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Ethiopian Fasting Plate with Gomen Greens and Spiced Lentils
summary: A vegan Ethiopian plate of collard-style greens and spiced red lentils with flatbread.

steps.text: Cook one onion dry for 6 minutes, add 1 tbsp oil, garlic, paprika and turmeric for 1 minute.
Add the lentils and 3 cups water and simmer 20 minutes until soft and thick.
Soften the other onion and ginger in the remaining oil for 5 minutes, add the silverbeet and 1/2 cup water and cook for 12 minutes until tender.
Serve both with the flatbreads.

title: Laulau Hawaiian Pork and Silverbeet Parcels with Rice
summary: Pork wrapped in silverbeet leaves and steamed slowly until silky, served with rice.

steps.text: Mix the pork with the soy sauce, salt and ginger.
Wrap a portion of pork in 2 silverbeet leaves, then in foil, making 4 parcels.
Steam for 1 hour 45 minutes until the pork is tender and the leaves soft.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, and serve with the opened parcels.

notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C and is tender. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Hawaiian Kalbi Short Ribs with Pineapple Rice
summary: Thin sliced beef short ribs in a sweet soy, garlic and pineapple marinade, grilled until caramelised.

steps.text: Mix the soy sauce, sugar, juice, garlic and sesame oil, and coat the ribs.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, then fold through the pineapple.
Grill the ribs over high heat for 3 minutes each side until charred and cooked through.
Serve the ribs with the rice.

notes: Food safety: cook the beef until it reaches 75°C. Boil any marinade used on raw meat before serving. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Puaka Tunu Tongan Roast Pork with Coconut Sweet Potato
summary: Slow-roasted pork shoulder with garlic and salt, served with sweet potato simmered in coconut milk.

steps.text: Rub the pork with the garlic and 2 tsp salt and roast at 160°C for 1 hour 30 minutes until tender, then rest for 10 minutes.
Simmer the sweet potato, onion, coconut milk and 1/2 cup water for 25 minutes until the sweet potato is soft.
Slice the pork and serve with the sweet potato.

notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C and is tender. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Manapua Hawaiian Steamed Char Siu Pork Buns
summary: Soft steamed buns stuffed with sticky sweet roast pork, a Hawaiian plate-lunch classic.

steps.text: Knead the flour, yeast, sugar and 3/4 cup warm water, then rise for 1 hour until doubled.
Brown the pork in the oil for 6 minutes, add the hoisin, soy sauce, honey and 1/3 cup water and simmer 25 minutes until tender.
Stir the cornflour with 1 tbsp water in and simmer until thick, then cool.
Divide the dough into 8, fill and seal.
Steam for 15 minutes until puffed and firm.

notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

title: Sukiyaki Kansai-Style Beef Hot Pot
summary: A tabletop pot of thinly sliced beef, tofu and vegetables simmered in a sweet soy broth, finished with noodles.

steps.text: Stir the soy sauce, mirin, sugar and water together to make the broth.
Heat the oil in a wide pot, sear half the beef for 1 minute, then pour in half the broth.
Add the tofu, leek, mushrooms and cabbage in sections and simmer for 8 minutes until tender.
Add the remaining beef for the last 2 minutes so it stays soft, and top up with water if the broth reduces too far.
