Toss with lime juice, fish sauce, rice powder and chilli.
Fold through the shallots and herbs.
Spoon into the lettuce leaves.

notes: Food safety: cook mince until it reaches 75°C and no pink remains.
High-protein and dairy-free.

title: Quinoa and Roasted Pumpkin Salad
summary: Fluffy quinoa with roasted pumpkin, chickpeas, rocket and a lemon tahini dressing, vegan and high in protein.

steps.text: Roast the pumpkin and chickpeas with the oil at 200C for 25 minutes until golden.
Cook the quinoa for 15 minutes until the grains uncurl.
Whisk the tahini, lemon juice, garlic and water until smooth.
Toss everything until coated.
Serve warm or cold, as a side or a main.

notes: Dairy-free and vegan.
Keeps 3 days.

title: Prawn and Avocado Salad
summary: Chilled prawns with avocado, cucumber and a lime and chilli dressing.

steps.text: Whisk the lime juice, oil and chilli.
Slice the avocado and cucumber.
Arrange the lettuce on a platter.
Layer with the avocado, cucumber and prawns.
Spoon over the dressing until coated.

notes: Food safety: use fully cooked prawns kept cold, with flesh opaque and pink.
Eat within a day.

title: Garlic Butter Mushrooms on Toast
summary: Golden mushrooms in garlic butter and thyme piled on crisp sourdough.

steps.text: Heat half the butter in a pan until foaming.
Add the mushrooms and cook for 6 minutes until deeply golden.
Add the garlic, thyme and remaining butter for 1 minute until fragrant.
Toast the bread until crisp.
Pile the mushrooms on top.

notes: Vegetarian.
Don't crowd the pan.

title: Shakshuka with Chickpeas
summary: Eggs poached in spiced tomato and capsicum sauce with chickpeas.

steps.text: Soften the onion and capsicum in the oil for 8 minutes until soft.
Add garlic and spices for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer for 10 minutes until thick.
Make wells and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook for 6 minutes until the whites are set.
Top with chopped parsley and serve straight from the pan.

notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set.
Serve with bread.

title: Green Smoothie Bowl with Seeds
summary: A thick spinach, avocado and pineapple smoothie topped with seeds.

steps.text: Blend the spinach, avocado, pineapple and coconut milk until thick and smooth.
Pour into a bowl and smooth the surface flat.
Top with the seeds and coconut.

notes: Vegan.
Use frozen pineapple for thickness.

title: Potato Rosti with Poached Egg
summary: A crisp grated potato cake topped with a soft poached egg and chives.

steps.text: Grate the potato and onion and squeeze out the water.
Season and shape into two cakes.
Fry in the butter for 8 minutes per side until deep golden.
Poach the eggs in simmering water with the vinegar for 3 minutes.
Top the rosti with the eggs.

notes: Food safety: poached eggs have a runny yolk, so cook until firm for vulnerable people.
Squeeze potato well for crispness.

title: Overnight Chia-Style Sesame Muesli
summary: Soaked oats with sesame, apple and coconut milk, vegan and dairy-free.

steps.text: Mix the oats, coconut milk, water, apple, cinnamon and syrup.
Cover and refrigerate overnight until the oats are soft.
Stir in sesame seeds and serve cold.

notes: Vegan.
Add fruit before serving.

title: Tzatziki Dip
summary: Thick yoghurt with grated cucumber, garlic, dill and lemon.

steps.text: Grate the cucumber and squeeze out the water until dry.
Mix with the yoghurt, garlic, dill and lemon juice until combined.
Chill for 30 minutes and drizzle with oil.

notes: Vegetarian.
Squeeze the cucumber well.

title: Tahini Lemon Sauce
summary: A creamy lemon tahini sauce with garlic for falafel and roasted vegetables.

steps.text: Whisk the tahini, lemon juice and garlic.
Add the water slowly until the sauce turns pale and smooth.
Season to taste with salt and more lemon until bright.

notes: Vegan and dairy-free.
It seizes before it loosens, so keep whisking.

title: Pesto Genovese Dairy-Free
summary: A fresh basil and pine nut pesto without cheese, using nutritional yeast.

steps.text: Toast the pine nuts until golden.
Blend with the basil, garlic and yeast until a coarse paste forms.
Stream in the oil and lemon juice.
Season with salt and serve straight away at room temperature.

notes: Vegan and dairy-free.
Cover with oil to stop browning.

title: Sambal Goreng Tofu and Long Beans
summary: Crisp fried tofu and green beans tossed in a sticky sweet chilli and tamarind sambal, a vegan Malaysian side or main.

steps.text: Fry the tofu in the oil for 6 minutes until golden and crisp, then lift out.
Fry the shallots and garlic in the same oil for 3 minutes until soft.
Add the chilli paste and cook for 4 minutes until the oil rises to the surface.
Stir in the tamarind, sugar and a splash of water and simmer until sticky.
Add the beans and tofu and toss for 4 minutes until the beans are just tender.

notes: Vegan and dairy-free.
Serve with steamed rice.

title: Hokkien Mee Prawn Noodle Soup
summary: A deep prawn-head broth with pork, egg noodles, bean sprouts and fried shallots, rich and sweet with a chilli kick.

steps.text: Peel the prawns, keeping the heads and shells, and set the meat aside.
Fry the shells and heads in the oil for 5 minutes until bright orange.
Add the garlic, chilli paste, ribs and water and simmer for 45 minutes until the ribs are tender and the broth is red-gold.
Strain and season with soy sauce and white pepper.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, cool, peel and halve.
Poach the prawns in the broth for 3 minutes until pink and opaque.
Blanch the noodles, sprouts and greens, then top with prawns, ribs, eggs and shallots and ladle over the broth.

notes: Food safety: cook the prawns until pink and opaque, cook the pork until tender and at least 75°C, and boil the eggs until set.
The broth freezes well.

title: Lemang-Style Coconut Sticky Rice Breakfast
summary: Glutinous rice steamed in coconut milk until sticky and fragrant, served with serundeng and fried egg.

steps.text: Soak the rice for 2 hours and drain.
Steam the rice over boiling water for 20 minutes until half cooked.
Stir in the coconut milk, water and salt and steam 20 minutes until tender and sticky.
Toast the coconut, peanuts and sugar in a dry pan for 5 minutes until golden.
Fry the eggs in the oil until the whites are fully set.
Serve the rice with serundeng and egg.

notes: Food safety: fry the eggs until the whites and yolks are firm.
Vegetarian.

title: Ikan Bakar Style Grilled Fish with Sambal
summary: Whole-style fish fillets brushed with a turmeric and chilli marinade and grilled until smoky, with a lime sambal.

steps.text: Mix the chilli paste, turmeric, crushed garlic, tamarind and oil into a marinade.
Rub it over the fish and rest for 20 minutes.
Grill the fish for 4 minutes per side until opaque and flaking.
Dice the tomato, chilli and shallot and toss with lime juice for the sambal.
Serve the fish with the sambal.

notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and it flakes easily with a fork.
Prep time excludes marinating.

title: Warm Lamb and Bulgur Salad
summary: Spiced lamb strips over nutty bulgur with pomegranate, mint and a lemon tahini drizzle.

steps.text: Soak the bulgur in boiling water for 15 minutes until tender, then drain.
Rub the lamb with cumin, paprika and oil.
Sear the lamb for 4 minutes per side until browned.
Rest the lamb for 5 minutes, then slice.
Whisk tahini, lemon juice and water until pourable.
Toss bulgur with cucumber, rocket and mint, then top with lamb and drizzle.

notes: Food safety: cook lamb to at least 63°C, with the rest time counting, or until no raw meat remains inside if cut.
Dairy-free.

title: Chermoula Roasted Carrot Salad
summary: Sweet roasted carrots in a herb chermoula with chickpeas and almonds.

steps.text: Roast the carrots with half the oil at 200C for 30 minutes until caramelised.
Blend the herbs, garlic, spices, lemon juice and remaining oil into chermoula.
Toast the almonds until golden and chop.
Toss the warm carrots and chickpeas with the chermoula until coated.
Scatter with the chopped almonds and serve at room temperature.

notes: Vegan and gluten-free.
Good served cold.

title: Warm Potato Salad with Bacon and Mustard
summary: Waxy potatoes with crisp bacon, red onion and a warm mustard vinaigrette.

steps.text: Boil the potatoes for 18 minutes until tender, then drain and slice.
Fry the bacon until crisp.
Add the onion and cook for 3 minutes until soft.
Stir in the vinegar, mustard and oil.
Toss with the warm potatoes and parsley.

notes: Food safety: cook the bacon until crisp and fully cooked.
Dress while warm.

title: Spiced Pumpkin Seed Granola Clusters
summary: Crunchy oat clusters with pumpkin seeds, coconut and cinnamon baked until golden.

steps.text: Whisk the syrup, oil, cinnamon and salt.
Mix with the oats, seeds and coconut.
Fold through the lightly whisked egg white.
Press into a lined tray and pack down firmly with the back of a spoon.
Bake at 150C for 30 minutes until golden.
Cool completely before breaking into clusters.

notes: Store airtight for 2 weeks.
Food safety: bake until golden and fully dry. Wash fresh produce well, refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat them within 3 days.

title: Tortilla Española
summary: A thick Spanish omelette of slow-cooked potato and onion, set and golden.

steps.text: Cook the potato and onion in the oil over low heat for 20 minutes until completely soft.
Drain the oil and mix the vegetables into the beaten eggs.
Rest the mixture for 5 minutes until the egg soaks into the potato.
Cook the mixture in a pan for 5 minutes until the base is set and golden.
Flip using a plate and cook for 4 minutes until firm.

notes: Food safety: cook until the egg is fully set in the centre.
Eat warm or cold.

title: Egg and Chorizo Breakfast Burritos
summary: Warm tortillas filled with scrambled egg, chorizo, beans and salsa.

steps.text: Fry the chorizo in the oil for 4 minutes until crisp and the fat runs.
Warm the beans in a pot until hot.
Pour in the whisked eggs and scramble until just set.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan until soft.
Fill with egg, beans, tomato, salsa and avocado and fold.

notes: Food safety: cook the egg until firm and chorizo until hot throughout.
Wrap in foil to take away.

title: Congee with Century Egg and Pork
summary: Silky rice porridge with minced pork, century egg and ginger, a classic Chinese breakfast.

steps.text: Simmer the rice in the water for 50 minutes, stirring now and then, until the grains burst and the congee turns creamy.
Mix the pork with soy sauce and ginger.
Add the pork and cook for 8 minutes until it reaches 75°C.
Chop the century eggs into small pieces and set aside.
Ladle into bowls and top with egg, spring onion, sesame oil and pepper.

notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C with no pink.
Century eggs are cured, not cooked, so avoid in pregnancy.

title: Savoury Oats with Soft Egg and Spinach
summary: Creamy porridge oats cooked in stock with spinach, topped with a jammy egg and sesame.

steps.text: Simmer the oats in the stock for 5 minutes until thick and creamy.
Stir in the spinach until wilted.
Boil the egg for 7 minutes until jammy.
Spoon the oats into a bowl and top with the halved egg.
Drizzle with soy sauce and sesame oil and scatter with sesame seeds.

notes: Food safety: a jammy egg is not recommended for pregnant women, older adults or small children, so boil for 10 minutes until firm.
Dairy-free.

title: Apple Cinnamon Dutch Porridge Pots
summary: Creamy porridge baked with apple, cinnamon and a touch of maple, served warm.

steps.text: Simmer the oats and milk for 5 minutes until thick.
Fold in the apples, cinnamon, syrup and salt.
Spoon into ramekins and bake at 180C for 10 minutes until golden on top.

notes: Vegetarian.
Add nuts for crunch.

title: Sri Lankan Egg Hopper Pancakes
summary: Bowl-shaped fermented rice pancakes with a lacy edge and a soft egg in the centre.

steps.text: Mix the flour, coconut milk, water, sugar, yeast and salt until smooth.
Rest in a warm place for 2 hours until bubbly.
Heat a small wok with a little oil until hot.
Pour in a ladle of batter and swirl to coat the sides.
Crack an egg in the centre and cover.
Cook for 3 minutes until the edges are crisp and the egg is set.

notes: Food safety: cook until the egg white is fully set.
Serve with sambol.

title: Moroccan Spiced Lentil Harira Soup
summary: A tomato and chickpea soup with lentils, cinnamon and fresh herbs, traditionally eaten to break the Ramadan fast.

steps.text: Soften the onion and celery in the oil for 6 minutes until translucent.
Add the spices for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes, lentils and stock and simmer for 25 minutes until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the chickpeas and vermicelli and cook for 5 minutes until soft.
Finish with coriander and lemon juice.

notes: Vegan.
Add a pinch of saffron for tradition.

title: Kale and Quinoa Caesar-Style Bowl
summary: Massaged kale and quinoa with chicken, a creamy tahini dressing and seeds.

steps.text: Cook the quinoa for 15 minutes until tender and fluffy.
Season the chicken and pan-fry for 6 minutes per side until it reaches 75°C.
Massage the kale with the oil and lemon juice until softened.
Whisk the tahini, garlic and water into a dressing.
Slice the chicken and arrange over the quinoa and kale.
Drizzle with dressing and seeds.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C and the juices run clear.
High-protein and dairy-free.

title: Warm Tofu and Peanut Noodle Salad
summary: Rice vermicelli with crisp tofu, herbs, cucumber and a peanut dressing.

steps.text: Fry the tofu in the oil for 8 minutes until golden on all sides.
Soak the noodles in boiling water for 5 minutes until tender, then rinse.
Whisk the peanut butter, lime juice, soy sauce, sugar and water until pourable.
Toss the noodles with the vegetables and herbs.
Top with tofu and spoon over the dressing.

notes: Vegan and dairy-free.
Check the noodles are rice for gluten-free.

title: Caponata Siciliana
summary: Sweet and sour Sicilian eggplant, celery, olives and capers in a rich tomato sauce.

steps.text: Fry the eggplant in the oil for 10 minutes until golden, then set aside.
Soften the celery and onion in the same pan for 8 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, olives, capers, vinegar and sugar and simmer for 15 minutes until thick.
Fold in the eggplant and cook for 5 minutes.
Serve at room temperature with basil.

notes: Vegan.
Better after a day.

title: Honey Garlic Roasted Carrots with Thyme
summary: Glazed carrots roasted until caramelised and sweet.

steps.text: Halve the carrots lengthways and toss with oil, garlic, thyme and salt.
Roast at 200C for 25 minutes until tender.
Drizzle with honey and roast for 10 minutes until sticky and caramelised.

notes: Vegetarian.
Use maple syrup for vegan.

title: Colcannon with Cabbage and Spring Onion
summary: Buttery Irish mash with cabbage and spring onions.

steps.text: Boil the potatoes for 20 minutes until tender, then drain and mash.
Soften the cabbage in half the butter for 6 minutes until tender.
Warm the milk with the spring onions for 3 minutes.
Beat everything into the mash until smooth and creamy.
Top with the remaining butter.

notes: Vegetarian.
Serve with sausages.

title: Spiced Cauliflower Rice Pilaf
summary: Fluffy grated cauliflower with cumin, raisins, almonds and herbs.

steps.text: Grate the cauliflower coarsely.
Toast the almonds until golden.
Fry the cauliflower and spices in the oil for 6 minutes until tender and fragrant.
Stir in the raisins and lemon juice.
Top with almonds and parsley.

notes: Vegan and gluten-free.
Don't over-stir.

title: Sweet Potato Wedges with Chipotle Mayo
summary: Crisp spiced sweet potato wedges with a smoky chipotle mayo.

steps.text: Cut the sweet potato into wedges and toss with oil and spices.
Roast at 220C for 35 minutes until crisp and browned.
Mix the mayonnaise, chipotle and lime.
Serve the wedges with the dip.

notes: Contains egg.
Vegetarian.

title: Cheesy Polenta with Roasted Mushrooms
summary: Creamy polenta with vegetarian hard cheese and garlicky roasted mushrooms.

steps.text: Roast the mushrooms with oil, garlic and thyme at 200C for 25 minutes until golden.
Whisk the polenta into the simmering water.
Cook for 20 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy.
Stir in the butter and cheese.
Spoon the mushrooms over the polenta.

notes: Vegetarian when made with vegetarian hard cheese.
Add milk to loosen if it sets.

title: Fermented Chilli Hot Sauce
summary: A tangy, funky hot sauce from chillies fermented in brine for a week.

steps.text: Dissolve the salt in the water.
Pack the chopped chillies and garlic into a jar and cover with the brine.
Weigh down and ferment at room temperature for 7 days until bubbly and sour.
Drain, reserving the brine.
Blend with the vinegar, sugar and enough brine until smooth.

notes: Discard if it smells off or grows fuzzy mould.
Keeps 6 months in the fridge.

title: Chilli Crisp Oil
summary: A crunchy chilli oil with garlic, shallots and sesame, for noodles and dumplings.

steps.text: Slice the garlic and shallots thinly.
Heat the oil with the star anise to 120C.
Fry the garlic and shallots in the oil for 6 minutes until golden and crisp.
Pour the hot oil over the chilli flakes and sesame in a heatproof bowl.
Stir in the soy sauce and sugar once cooled.

notes: Vegan.
Keep it in the fridge for 1 month.

title: Garlic Toum Whipped Sauce
summary: A fluffy Lebanese garlic emulsion of garlic, oil and lemon, no egg.

steps.text: Blend the garlic and salt to a paste.
Add oil a few drops at a time while blending.
Alternate with lemon juice and ice water until thick and white.
Rest in the fridge for 1 hour.

notes: Vegan.
Add the oil slowly or it splits.

title: Teriyaki Glaze
summary: A glossy homemade teriyaki sauce of soy, mirin and sugar.

steps.text: Simmer the soy sauce, mirin, sugar, ginger and garlic for 5 minutes.
Whisk the cornflour with water and stir in until glossy and thick.
Strain the glaze and cool it until it thickens further.

notes: Vegan.
Keeps 2 weeks.

title: Nyonya Chicken Kapitan Curry Bowls
summary: A fragrant Penang-style chicken curry with lemongrass, turmeric and coconut, served over rice.

steps.text: Blend the shallots, garlic, ginger, lemongrass, turmeric and chilli paste into a smooth paste.
Fry the paste in the oil for 8 minutes until the oil separates and it smells toasty.
Add the chicken and brown it for 5 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk, tamarind and 200ml water and simmer for 30 minutes until the chicken reaches 75°C and the sauce thickens.
Cook the rice until fluffy and serve with the curry.

notes: Food safety: cook bone-in chicken until it reaches 75°C at the thickest part and the juices run clear.
Dairy-free.

title: Penang Assam Laksa Fish Noodle Soup
summary: A sour, spicy tamarind fish soup with thick rice noodles, pineapple, cucumber and mint.

steps.text: Poach the fish in the water for 8 minutes until opaque and flaking, then lift out and flake the flesh.
Blend the soaked chillies, shallots, lemongrass, ginger and shrimp paste smooth.
Simmer the paste in the fish broth with the tamarind for 25 minutes until the soup tastes tangy and rich.
Cook the noodles until tender.
Divide the noodles into bowls and top with flaked fish, cucumber, pineapple, mint and sliced chilli.
Ladle over the hot soup until the noodles are just covered.

notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and flaking.
Dairy-free.

title: Roti Jala Lacy Net Pancakes
summary: Delicate lacy crepes drizzled in a net pattern, served with chicken curry or sweet kaya.

steps.text: Whisk the flour, egg, coconut milk, water, turmeric and salt until a thin batter forms.
Rest the batter for 20 minutes.
Heat a lightly oiled pan until hot.
Drizzle the batter in a lacy net pattern using a squeezy bottle.
Cook for 1 minute until the lace is set, then fold into quarters.

notes: Food safety: cook until the batter is fully set.
Serve with curry.

title: Gado Gado Style Peanut Vegetable Plate
summary: Blanched vegetables, potato, tofu and egg with a rich peanut sauce.

steps.text: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes until tender, then slice.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes until firm, cool and halve.
Blanch the beans, cabbage and sprouts for 2 minutes each until just tender.
Fry the tofu until golden.
Blend the peanut butter, soy, sugar, lime, chilli, garlic and hot water until smooth.
Arrange the vegetables, tofu and eggs on a platter and pour over the sauce.

notes: Food safety: boil the eggs until firm.
Vegetarian.

title: Pisang Goreng Style Plantain Fritters
summary: Crisp golden plantain fritters in a light rice flour batter.

steps.text: Whisk the flours, baking powder, sugar and water until smooth.
Slice the plantains lengthways into thick pieces.
Heat the oil in a deep pan to 180C until a drop of batter sizzles.
Dip the plantain in the batter and fry for 3 minutes until crisp and golden.
Drain on paper and serve hot.

notes: Keep the oil at 180C for a crisp batter.
Vegan.

title: Dhal Tadka Red Lentil Breakfast Soup
summary: Silky red lentils finished with a sizzling garlic and cumin tadka.

steps.text: Simmer the lentils with turmeric and water for 20 minutes until they collapse.
Stir in the chopped tomato for 5 minutes until soft.
Heat the ghee in a small pan and fry the cumin, garlic and chilli for 1 minute until golden.
Pour the tadka over the dhal and finish with lemon juice.

notes: Vegetarian.
Use oil instead of ghee for vegan.

title: Pao de Queijo Cheese Bread Bites
summary: Chewy gluten-free Brazilian cheese breads with a crisp crust.

steps.text: Heat the milk, oil and salt until simmering.
Pour over the tapioca starch and stir until a sticky dough forms.
Cool for 5 minutes, then mix in the egg and cheese.
Roll the dough into walnut-sized balls with wet hands.
Bake at 200C for 22 minutes until puffed and golden.

notes: Food safety: bake until the centres are cooked through.
Vegetarian when made with vegetarian hard cheese, and gluten-free.

title: Hungarian Lecso Pepper Stew
summary: A stewed summer capsicum and tomato dish with onion and paprika, finished with eggs.

steps.text: Soften the onion in the oil for 6 minutes until golden.
Add the paprika, capsicum and tomato.
Simmer for 15 minutes until the peppers are soft and the sauce is thick.
Make wells and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook for 4 minutes until the whites are set.

notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are firm.
Vegetarian and gluten-free.

title: Tarator Cold Bulgarian Yoghurt Soup
summary: Cold yoghurt soup with cucumber, dill, garlic and walnuts for hot days.

steps.text: Dice the cucumbers finely.
Whisk the yoghurt with the water until smooth.
Stir in the cucumber, garlic and dill.
Chill for 1 hour until very cold, then top with walnuts and oil.

notes: Vegetarian.
Serve in chilled bowls.

title: Avgolemono Greek Egg and Lemon Soup
summary: Silky chicken and rice soup thickened with egg and lemon.

steps.text: Simmer the stock and rice for 12 minutes until the rice is tender.
Poach the chicken in the stock for 10 minutes until it reaches 75°C, then shred.
Whisk the eggs with the lemon juice until frothy.
Ladle hot stock into the eggs slowly, whisking, then stir back into the pot.
Heat gently without boiling until slightly thickened, then add the chicken and dill.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C and heat the soup until it coats a spoon with no raw egg.
Do not boil after adding the egg.

title: Caldo Verde Portuguese Kale and Potato Soup
summary: A rustic soup of potato, thin shredded kale and smoky chorizo.

steps.text: Soften the onion and garlic in half the oil for 5 minutes until translucent.
Add the potatoes and stock and simmer for 20 minutes until completely tender.
Mash the potatoes into the soup until creamy.
Fry the chorizo until crisp.
Add the kale to the soup for 5 minutes until tender, then serve with chorizo.

notes: Food safety: cook the chorizo until hot and browned throughout.
Dairy-free.

title: Sopa de Lima Yucatan Chicken Lime Soup
summary: A bright lime and chicken soup with crisp tortilla strips and avocado.

steps.text: Simmer the chicken, onion, garlic and stock for 20 minutes until the chicken reaches 75°C.
Shred the chicken and return to the strained broth.
Cut the tortillas into strips and fry in the oil until crisp.
Add the tomatoes and lime juice to the soup and heat for 5 minutes.
Serve topped with avocado, tortilla strips and coriander.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C.
Dairy-free.

title: Egyptian Koshari Lentil Rice Bowl
summary: Layers of rice, lentils, pasta and chickpeas with spiced tomato sauce and crispy onions.

steps.text: Simmer the lentils for 20 minutes until tender and cook the rice until fluffy.
Boil the macaroni until tender.
Slice and fry the onions in the oil for 15 minutes until deep brown and crisp.
Simmer the tomatoes, garlic, cumin and vinegar for 15 minutes until thick.
Layer the grains, pasta, lentils and chickpeas in bowls and top with sauce and onions.

notes: Vegan.
Keeps well for lunches.

title: Injera Style Teff Pancake Breakfast with Lentils
summary: Sour fermented teff pancakes topped with a spiced red lentil stew.

steps.text: Whisk the teff flour and water and leave it for 2 days at room temperature until sour and bubbly.
Simmer the onion, garlic and paprika in the oil for 6 minutes until fragrant.
Add the lentils and water and simmer for 25 minutes until thick and soft.
Pour a thin layer of batter into a hot pan and cook for 3 minutes until set and covered in holes.
Serve the lentils on the injera.

notes: Vegan and gluten-free.
Fermenting time is waiting time.

title: Hummus from Dried Chickpeas
summary: Ultra-smooth hummus from chickpeas cooked until falling apart, with tahini and lemon.

steps.text: Soak the chickpeas overnight in water with the bicarbonate of soda.
Drain and simmer in fresh water for 60 minutes until very soft and falling apart.
Blend the warm chickpeas with the tahini, lemon, garlic, cumin and salt.
Add the iced water until pale and silky.
Drizzle with the olive oil and serve at room temperature.

notes: Vegan.
Peel the chickpeas for the smoothest result.

title: Baba Ganoush Smoky Eggplant Dip
summary: Charred eggplant blended with tahini, lemon and garlic.

steps.text: Char the whole eggplants over a flame or at 230C for 40 minutes until collapsed and blackened.
Scoop out the flesh and drain for 10 minutes.
Mash with the tahini, lemon, garlic and salt until creamy.
Drizzle with oil and parsley.

notes: Vegan.
Charring gives the smoky flavour.

title: Bibimbap Vegetable Rice Bowl
summary: Rice topped with seasoned vegetables, fried egg and gochujang.

steps.text: Cook the rice until fluffy.
Blanch the spinach and sprouts for 1 minute each, then season with soy sauce and garlic.
Stir-fry the carrot and zucchini in oil for 3 minutes until just tender.
Fry the eggs until the whites are set.
Arrange everything over the rice and add gochujang.

notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are firm.
Vegetarian.

title: Vietnamese Egg Coffee Style Breakfast Toast
summary: Banh mi style toast with fried egg, pickled carrot and chilli mayo.

steps.text: Pickle the carrot in the vinegar and sugar for 10 minutes.
Fry the eggs until the whites are fully set.
Toast the bread until golden.
Mix the mayonnaise and chilli sauce until smooth, then spread on the toast.
Top with egg, carrot and coriander.

notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are firm.
Vegetarian.

title: Mojo Verde Canarian Green Sauce
summary: A garlic and coriander green sauce for potatoes and fish.

steps.text: Blend the coriander, garlic, chilli and cumin to a rough paste.
Add the vinegar and oil and blend until emulsified.
Season and rest for 20 minutes.

notes: Vegan.
Serve with boiled potatoes.

title: Salsa Roja Roasted Tomato Salsa
summary: Smoky roasted tomato and chilli salsa.

steps.text: Roast the tomatoes, onion, garlic and chillies at 220C for 20 minutes until charred.
Cool them for 5 minutes until safe to handle.
Blend roughly with the lime, coriander and salt until chunky.

notes: Vegan.
Keeps 5 days.

title: Sweet Chilli Dipping Sauce
summary: A sticky sweet chilli sauce with garlic and rice vinegar.

steps.text: Blend the chillies and garlic.
Simmer with the vinegar, sugar and water for 8 minutes.
Whisk the cornflour with water and stir in until clear and thick.

notes: Vegan.
Thickens as it cools.

title: Black Garlic Soy Dipping Sauce
summary: A sweet and savoury black garlic and soy dipping sauce for dumplings.

steps.text: Mash the black garlic to a smooth paste.
Whisk in the soy sauce, vinegar, oil and sugar until smooth.
Rest for 10 minutes so the flavours meld.

notes: Vegan.
Keeps a week.

title: Apam Balik Peanut Pancake Folds
summary: Thick-and-crisp Malaysian folded pancakes with a soft, bubbly centre, filled with crushed peanuts and sugar.

steps.text: Whisk the flour, baking powder, bicarbonate of soda, sugar, egg and water into a smooth, pourable batter.
Heat a non-stick frying pan with a little oil over medium heat until a drop of batter sizzles.
Pour in a thick round of batter and cook for 3 minutes, until bubbles pop across the surface and the base is deep golden.
Smear the top with butter and scatter over the peanuts and brown sugar, until the surface is evenly coated.
Fold the pancake in half and cook for 1 minute until the edges are crisp and the sugar has begun to melt.
Slide out, cut into wedges and serve warm while the edges are still crisp.

notes: Food safety: cook the egg batter until the centre is fully set and no longer wet.
Contains peanuts.
For a dairy-free version use vegetable oil in place of the butter.

title: Mee Rebus Sweet Potato Gravy Noodles
summary: Yellow noodles under a thick, sweet-savoury sweet potato gravy with egg, lime and crisp shallots.

steps.text: Boil the sweet potato in the water for 15 minutes until completely soft, then blend it smooth with a little of the cooking water.
Blend the shallots, garlic, dried shrimp and chilli paste into a rough paste.
Fry the paste in the oil for 6 minutes, until the oil separates and the smell turns toasty.
Pour in the sweet potato purée, soy sauce and sugar and simmer for 10 minutes until the gravy coats the back of a spoon.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes until the yolks are set, then peel and halve.
Blanch the noodles and bean sprouts until just tender, then drain well.
Pile the noodles into bowls, ladle over the gravy and top with egg, fried shallots, sliced chilli and a lime wedge.

notes: Contains dried shrimp, so not vegetarian.
The gravy thickens as it cools, so loosen with hot water when reheating.
Food safety: boil the eggs until the yolks are fully set. Reheat leftovers until steaming hot right through.

title: Bubur Lambuk Spiced Beef Rice Porridge
summary: The fragrant Ramadan-style Malay porridge of rice, coconut milk and warm spices with tender beef, simmered until silky.

steps.text: Fry the sliced shallots, garlic, ginger and whole spices in the ghee for 4 minutes until golden and fragrant.
Add the mince and cook for 6 minutes, breaking it up until no pink remains.
Stir in the rice, water and salt and bring to a boil until bubbling.
Simmer gently for 40 minutes, stirring often, until the rice has collapsed into a thick, creamy porridge.
Pour in the coconut milk and cook for 5 minutes until hot and glossy.
Remove the whole spices, then ladle into bowls and top with coriander and fried shallots.

notes: Food safety: cook the beef mince until no pink remains and it reaches 75°C.
Dairy-free if you use oil instead of ghee.
Add more water if the porridge sets too thick.

title: Chee Cheong Fun with Sweet Sauce and Sesame
summary: Silky steamed rice-flour rolls in a sweet hoisin-style sauce with chilli and toasted sesame.

steps.text: Whisk the rice flour, tapioca starch, wheat starch, water and oil into a thin batter, then rest it briefly and stir again.
Set a wide steamer over boiling water and grease a shallow tray well.
Pour a thin layer of batter into the tray, cover and steam for 3 minutes until the sheet is translucent and set.
Lift out the tray, cool for 1 minute until you can handle it, then roll the sheet up with an oiled scraper.
Repeat with the remaining batter, greasing the tray each time, until all the rolls are made.
Whisk the hoisin, soy, sesame oil, peanut butter and chilli sauce with 2 tablespoons hot water until smooth.
Cut the rolls into pieces, drizzle with the sauce and finish with sesame and fried shallots.

notes: Contains peanuts, sesame and soy.
Dairy-free and vegan.
The rolls are best eaten the day they are steamed.

title: Bak Chor Mee Minced Pork Noodles
summary: Springy noodles tossed in black vinegar and chilli with minced pork, mushrooms and crisp shallots.

steps.text: Soak the mushrooms in hot water for 20 minutes until soft, then slice them.
Fry the garlic in the oil for 1 minute, add the pork and mushrooms and stir-fry for 6 minutes until the pork is cooked through with no pink.
Season the pork with 1 tablespoon soy sauce and the sugar, then keep it warm.
Whisk the vinegar, remaining soy, sesame oil and chilli sauce in a large bowl.
Heat the stock until simmering and cook the noodles for 3 minutes until just tender with a slight bite.
Lift the noodles into the sauce bowl, toss well, then top with the pork, spring onion and fried shallots.
Serve with a small bowl of the hot stock on the side.

notes: Food safety: cook pork mince until no pink remains and it reaches 75°C.
Dairy-free.

title: Lontong Sayur Rice Cake Vegetable Curry
summary: Compressed rice cakes in a mild coconut vegetable curry with tofu and egg, a Malay and Singaporean morning staple.

steps.text: Cook the rice in 600ml water for 18 minutes until very soft and sticky, then press into a tray and cool until firm.
Blend the shallots, garlic, lemongrass, turmeric and chilli paste smooth.
Fry the paste in the oil for 6 minutes until the oil separates and it smells toasty.
Add the stock, coconut milk, carrot and beans and simmer for 10 minutes until the carrot is tender.
Add the cabbage and tofu and simmer for 5 minutes until the cabbage is soft.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes until the yolks are set, then peel and halve.
Cut the rice cake into cubes, ladle over the curry and top with egg and fried shallots.

notes: Food safety: boil the eggs until the yolks are fully set.
Contains soy.
Dairy-free; leave out the eggs for a vegan version.

title: Mee Siam Spicy Tamarind Vermicelli
summary: Thin rice vermicelli in a hot, sweet and sour tamarind gravy with tofu, egg and chives.

steps.text: Soak the dried chillies in hot water for 15 minutes until soft, then blend with the shallots, garlic and soybean paste into a paste.
Fry the paste in the oil for 7 minutes until darkened and the oil separates.
Add the water, tamarind and sugar and simmer for 12 minutes until the gravy tastes sour, sweet and spicy.
Soak the vermicelli in hot water until tender, then drain.
Pan-fry the tofu cubes for 5 minutes until golden on all sides.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes until the yolks are set, then peel and halve.
Pile the vermicelli in bowls, ladle over the gravy and top with tofu, egg, bean sprouts, chives and lime.

notes: Food safety: boil the eggs until the yolks are fully set.
Contains soy.
Dairy-free.

title: Singapore Egg Prata with Fish Curry Gravy
summary: Flaky pan-fried flatbread folded around a spiced egg and onion filling, served with a thin turmeric fish curry gravy.

steps.text: Knead the flour, 1 egg, water, 1 tablespoon ghee and salt into a soft dough and rest it in oiled balls.
Fry the onion in the oil for 5 minutes until soft, add the curry powder and turmeric and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the coconut milk, 200ml water and tomato and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the fish and simmer for 6 minutes until opaque and flaking, then keep warm.
Stretch a dough ball paper-thin on an oiled bench, crack an egg on top and fold the edges into a square.
Fry in ghee for 3 minutes per side, until the egg is set and the dough is crisp and golden.
Crumple lightly to open the layers and serve with the fish gravy.

notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and flaking and the egg until fully set.
Dairy-free if you use oil instead of ghee.
Rest the dough for at least an hour to make it stretch easily.

title: Nasi Dagang Terengganu Coconut Rice with Tuna Curry
summary: East-coast Malay coconut rice with glutinous rice and fenugreek, served with a thick tuna and tamarind curry.

steps.text: Soak the rice and glutinous rice together for 30 minutes, then drain.
Steam the rice with the fenugreek, coconut milk, water and salt for 30 minutes until the grains are tender and sticky.
Blend the shallots, garlic, ginger, chilli paste and lemongrass smooth.
Fry the paste in the oil for 6 minutes until the oil separates.
Add the coconut cream and tamarind and simmer for 8 minutes until thick and glossy.
Fold in the tuna and heat for 3 minutes until piping hot.
Serve the rice with the curry and sliced cucumber.

notes: Food safety: heat canned fish until piping hot, above 75°C.
Dairy-free.

title: Singapore Ginger Chicken Rice Porridge
summary: Silky rice porridge in rich poaching broth with shredded ginger chicken, spring onion and sesame oil.

steps.text: Simmer the chicken with half the ginger and the spring onion whites in the water for 18 minutes, until it reaches 75°C and the juices run clear.
Lift out the chicken, cool slightly, then shred it.
Add the rice and salt to the broth and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring often, until thick and creamy.
Season with the white pepper and soy sauce.
Julienne the remaining ginger.
Ladle the porridge into bowls and top with chicken, ginger, spring onion greens, sesame oil, fried shallots and chilli.

notes: Food safety: cook chicken until it reaches 75°C at the thickest part and the juices run clear.
Dairy-free.

title: Besan Egg-White Muffin Frittatas
summary: Dairy-free high-protein mini frittatas bound with egg whites and chickpea flour, packed with spinach and capsicum.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C and oil a 12-hole muffin tin well.
Wilt the spinach in the oil for 2 minutes until just collapsed, then squeeze out the excess water and chop.
Whisk the egg whites, eggs, chickpea flour, paprika and salt until smooth with no lumps.
Fold in the spinach, diced capsicum, spring onion and parsley.
Divide among the holes and bake for 18 minutes until puffed, set in the centre and golden.
Cool in the tin for 3 minutes, then ease out with a knife.

notes: Food safety: bake until the egg is fully set with no liquid in the centre, about 75°C.
Dairy-free and gluten-free.
They keep for 3 days in the fridge and reheat well.

title: Turkey and Sweet Potato Breakfast Hash
summary: A one-pan, dairy-free, high-protein hash with turkey mince, sweet potato, kale and fried eggs.

steps.text: Dice the sweet potato small and fry in the oil for 10 minutes, turning, until golden and tender.
Add the onion and capsicum and cook for 4 minutes until soft.
Push to one side, add the turkey and spices and cook for 6 minutes, breaking up, until no pink remains.
Stir in the kale and cook for 2 minutes until wilted.
Make four wells and crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 4 minutes until the whites are set.
Scatter with parsley and serve from the pan.

notes: Food safety: cook turkey mince until no pink remains and it reaches 75°C, and eggs until the whites are set.
Dairy-free and gluten-free.
Cook the yolks through for anyone vulnerable.

title: Oat and Egg Protein Pancakes
summary: Dairy-free, flour-free pancakes blended from oats, eggs and soy milk, higher in protein than usual.

steps.text: Blend the oats, eggs, soy milk, baking powder, vanilla, maple syrup and salt until smooth, then rest the batter.
Heat a non-stick pan with a little oil over medium heat until hot.
Pour in small rounds and cook for 2 minutes until bubbles appear on the surface.
Flip and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Stack and top with warmed peanut butter and thinly sliced apple.

notes: Food safety: cook the pancakes until the centre is fully set, not wet.
Dairy-free.
Use certified gluten-free oats for a gluten-free version.

title: Black Bean Breakfast Bowl with Lime Avocado
summary: A dairy-free, high-protein bowl of spiced black beans, rice and crisp tortilla with a lime avocado.

steps.text: Fry the garlic in the oil for 1 minute until fragrant, then add the beans, cumin, paprika and 3 tablespoons water.
Simmer for 6 minutes, mashing a few beans, until thick and saucy.
Toast the tortillas until crisp and break into shards.
Fry the eggs for 3 minutes until the whites are set.
Mash the avocado with the juice of one lime and a pinch of salt.
Spoon the rice and beans into bowls and top with the avocado, tomato, egg, tortilla shards and coriander.

notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set and the yolks to your preference, fully for anyone vulnerable.
Dairy-free and gluten-free.

title: Salade Lyonnaise with Poached Egg and Bacon
summary: Bitter frisee, hot bacon, garlic croutons and a poached egg in a warm mustard vinaigrette.

steps.text: Rub the bread with 1 garlic clove, cube it and toast in the oil for 6 minutes until golden and crisp.
Fry the bacon in its own fat for 7 minutes until crisp and the fat has rendered.
Add the minced shallot and remaining garlic to the pan and cook for 1 minute until soft.
Stir in the red wine vinegar and mustard, scraping the pan, until the dressing is warm and glossy.
Poach the eggs in barely simmering water with the vinegar for 3 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks runny.
Toss the endive, croutons and warm dressing together.
Top each plate with a poached egg and parsley.

notes: Food safety: this keeps a runny yolk, so use very fresh eggs and avoid it for anyone vulnerable. Cook the bacon until crisp.
Dairy-free.

title: Salade Nicoise with Seared Tuna
summary: Composed Provencal salad of seared tuna, soft eggs, new potatoes, green beans, olives and anchovy mustard dressing.

steps.text: Simmer the potatoes for 15 minutes until a knife slides in easily, then halve while warm.
Boil the eggs for 7 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks soft, then cool and peel.
Blanch the beans for 3 minutes until just tender and bright green, then refresh in cold water.
Mash the anchovies and garlic into the mustard and vinegar, then whisk in the oil.
Sear the tuna in a hot oiled pan for 90 seconds per side until the outside is golden but the centre is still pink.
Toss the potatoes and beans with half the dressing.
Arrange on a platter with the tomatoes, olives, capers, halved eggs and sliced tuna and drizzle with the rest of the dressing.

notes: Food safety: seared tuna stays rare in the middle, so use very fresh fish and cook through for anyone pregnant or vulnerable. Cook the eggs until the whites are fully set, and cook the tuna through to 63°C until opaque and flaking for anyone vulnerable.
Dairy-free and gluten-free.

title: Caesar Salad with Anchovy Garlic Dressing and Sourdough Crumb
summary: A cheese-free take on Caesar: crisp cos, a coddled-style egg yolk dressing with anchovy, and garlic sourdough crumb.

items.raw: 3 tbsp olive oil for the crumb

steps.text: Blitz the bread to coarse crumbs and fry in 3 tablespoons oil with 1 garlic clove for 6 minutes until deep golden and crunchy.
Mash the anchovies and remaining garlic to a paste.
Whisk the anchovy paste with the yolk, lemon juice, mustard and Worcestershire sauce until smooth.
Drizzle in the oil slowly, whisking constantly, until thick and creamy like mayonnaise.
Season with the pepper and add a splash of water if too thick.
Tear the cos into large leaves, toss with the dressing and top with the crumb.

notes: Food safety: the dressing uses a raw egg yolk, so use very fresh eggs and avoid it for anyone pregnant, elderly or vulnerable.
Dairy-free.

title: Warm Puy Lentil Salad with Roasted Beetroot and Mustard Dressing
summary: A hearty French-style salad of warm green lentils, roasted beetroot, walnuts and rocket in a grain-mustard dressing.

steps.text: Roast the whole beetroot wrapped in foil at 200°C for 45 minutes until a knife slides in easily, then peel and cut into wedges.
Simmer the lentils with the bay leaf and garlic for 22 minutes until tender with a slight bite.
Whisk the mustard, vinegar, oil and honey into a dressing.
Drain the lentils and toss with the dressing and thinly sliced onion while still warm.
Toast the walnuts for 4 minutes until fragrant.
Fold in the beetroot, rocket, walnuts and parsley just before serving.

notes: Vegan if you swap the honey for maple syrup.
Dairy-free and gluten-free.
Warm lentils absorb the dressing best.

title: Seua Rong Hai Grilled Sirloin Salad
summary: Grilled sirloin sliced thin in a hot, sour lime and chilli dressing with herbs and toasted rice.

steps.text: Season the beef with the soy and cook on a very hot grill for 3 minutes per side for medium-rare, until browned outside and 55°C at the centre.
Rest for 8 minutes, then slice thinly across the grain.
Stir the fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, rice powder and chilli flakes until the sugar dissolves.
Toss the beef with the sauce, sliced shallots and herbs.
Serve on lettuce leaves with sliced cucumber.

notes: Food safety: whole cuts of beef are safe seared on the outside, but cook to at least 63°C if serving anyone pregnant or vulnerable.
Dairy-free and gluten-free if you use tamari.

title: Yam Woon Sen Glass Noodle Salad
summary: Slippery mung bean noodles with prawns, pork mince, peanuts and a fierce lime, chilli and fish sauce dressing.

steps.text: Soak the noodles in hot water for 6 minutes until tender and clear, then drain and cut.
Poach the pork mince in simmering water for 3 minutes until no pink remains, then lift out.
Poach the prawns for 2 minutes until pink and curled, then drain.
Crush the garlic and chillies, then stir with the fish sauce, lime juice and sugar until the sugar dissolves.
Toss the noodles, pork and prawns with the dressing, shallots, celery, tomato and spring onion.
Top with peanuts and coriander.

notes: Food safety: cook prawns until pink and opaque and pork mince until no pink remains and it reaches 75°C.
Dairy-free.
Contains peanuts and shellfish.

title: Kenyan Pilipili ya Nyanya Tomato Chilli Relish
summary: A fiery East African chilli and tomato relish with garlic and lemon, for grilled meat and chips.

steps.text: Heat the oil and fry the garlic for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chopped tomato and chillies and cook for 6 minutes until the tomato has collapsed.
Cool slightly, then blend with the lemon juice, salt, sugar and water until smooth.
Return to the pan and simmer for 3 minutes until thickened.
Cool and store in a clean jar.

notes: Hot: wear gloves when handling the chillies.
Vegan, dairy-free and gluten-free.
Keeps for 2 weeks in the fridge.

title: Ethiopian Awaze Berbere-Style Chilli Paste
summary: A thick red chilli and spice paste for dipping injera, brushing on meat or stirring into stews.

steps.text: Toast the paprika, chilli flakes, cumin, ginger, cardamom and cloves in a dry pan for 2 minutes until fragrant and a shade darker.
Heat the oil and fry the crushed garlic for 1 minute.
Stir in the toasted spices and salt, then add the wine.
Simmer for 6 minutes, stirring, until thick like a paste and the raw wine smell has gone.
Cool and store in a jar topped with a thin layer of oil.

notes: Vegan, dairy-free and gluten-free.
Keeps for 3 weeks in the fridge under oil.
Use stock instead of the wine if you prefer to avoid alcohol.

title: Niter Kibbeh Ethiopian Spiced Clarified Butter
summary: Gently infused clarified butter with ginger, garlic, cardamom and fenugreek, the base of countless Ethiopian stews.

steps.text: Melt the butter over low heat and skim off any foam as it rises.
Add the onion, garlic, ginger and all the spices.
Simmer very gently for 35 minutes until the milk solids sink and turn golden, the liquid is clear and the kitchen smells rich.
Remove from the heat and let it stand for 10 minutes.
Strain through muslin into a clean jar, discarding the solids.
Cool completely, then cover and store in the fridge for up to two months.

notes: Vegetarian, gluten-free.
Keeps for 2 months in the fridge.
Use 1 teaspoon to finish lentils, eggs or greens.

title: Kenyan Coconut Tomato Fish Sauce
summary: A coastal sauce of tomato, coconut cream, turmeric and tamarind, spooned over grilled fish or rice.

steps.text: Fry the onion in the oil for 6 minutes until soft and golden.
Add the garlic, ginger, chilli and spices and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in the chopped tomato and cook for 8 minutes until broken down into a thick sauce.
Add the tamarind, coconut cream and salt and simmer gently for 5 minutes until glossy.
Finish with the chopped coriander and taste for salt, lemon and heat.

notes: Vegan, dairy-free and gluten-free.
Serve over grilled white fish or with chapati.

title: Hawaiian Macadamia and Coriander Pesto
summary: A cheese-free island pesto of macadamias, coriander, ginger and lime for fish, noodles and grilled vegetables.

steps.text: Toast the macadamias in a dry pan for 4 minutes, until lightly golden and fragrant, then cool.
Blitz the nuts, garlic and ginger to a coarse crumb.
Add the coriander, basil, lime juice, salt and chilli and pulse until finely chopped.
Stream in the oil with the motor running until the pesto is thick and spoonable.
Taste and adjust the lime and salt, then store under a thin layer of oil.

notes: Contains tree nuts.
Vegan, dairy-free and gluten-free.
Keeps for 5 days in the fridge.

title: Tahitian Coconut Lime Sauce for Raw Fish
summary: The creamy citrus coconut dressing used for poisson cru, good on raw fish, steamed vegetables and boiled taro.

steps.text: Squeeze the limes and whisk the juice with the coconut cream and salt until smooth.
Grate the cucumber and carrot finely and squeeze out the liquid.
Fold the vegetables, onion and spring onion into the sauce.
Season with the chilli flakes.
Chill for 15 minutes and serve cold.

notes: Serve over very fresh sashimi-grade fish only. Fish served raw is not suitable for anyone pregnant or vulnerable.
Vegan, dairy-free and gluten-free.

title: Hawaiian Huli Huli Pineapple Glaze
summary: A sticky ginger, soy and pineapple glaze for grilled chicken, tofu or vegetables.

steps.text: Simmer the pineapple juice, soy, sugar, garlic and ginger for 12 minutes until reduced by a third.
Stir in the tomato sauce and vinegar and simmer for 3 minutes until syrupy and coating the back of a spoon.
Remove from the heat and add the sesame oil.
Brush onto food during the last few minutes of grilling.

notes: Vegan, dairy-free.
Keeps for 2 weeks in the fridge.
Do not reuse any glaze that has touched raw meat; boil it first.

title: Fijian Lolo Coconut Cream Sauce
summary: A silky, lightly spiced coconut sauce spooned over steamed cassava, taro or fish.

steps.text: Soften the onion in the oil for 5 minutes until translucent.
Add the garlic, ginger, chilli and turmeric and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the coconut cream and salt.
Simmer gently for 6 minutes, stirring, until slightly thickened.
Finish with the lime juice.

notes: Vegan, dairy-free and gluten-free.
Do not boil hard or the cream may split.

title: Samoan Oka Coconut Lime Marinade
summary: The bright dressing for Samoan oka: coconut cream, lime and onion, spooned over cured fish or cucumber salad.

steps.text: Dice the onion, tomato and cucumber finely.
Mix the lime juice, coconut cream and salt until smooth.
Fold in the vegetables and chilli.
Chill for 20 minutes and serve cold.

notes: Vegan, dairy-free and gluten-free.
Use fresh limes only for the best flavour.

title: Soy Milk with You Tiao Crullers Singapore Style
summary: Warm sweetened soy milk with crisp, airy fried dough sticks, a hawker-centre breakfast pairing.

steps.text: Mix the flour, baking powder, bicarbonate of soda and salt, then stir in the warm water and oil to a soft dough.
Knead for 5 minutes until smooth, cover and rest the dough while the oil heats.
Roll the dough into a rectangle 1cm thick and cut into strips 2cm wide, pressing two strips together.
Heat the frying oil to 180C and stretch each pair to about 20cm before lowering it in.
Fry for 2 to 3 minutes, turning, until puffed and deep golden.
Warm the soy milk with the sugar over low heat for 5 minutes until steaming, and serve with the crullers.

notes: Hot oil: use a deep pan, keep a lid nearby and never leave it unattended.
The dough should rest 20 minutes before rolling, which is not counted in prep time.

title: Chwee Kueh with Chye Poh Topping
summary: Steamed rice-flour cups topped with sweet-salty preserved radish, a Singapore breakfast favourite.

steps.text: Whisk the rice flour, starch, salt and 300ml of the water until smooth.
Bring the other 300ml water to the boil, whisk it into the batter and stir over low heat for 3 minutes, until it thickens like custard.
Stir in 1 tbsp oil and pour into oiled small cups.
Steam over high heat for 15 minutes, until the cakes are set and translucent.
Fry the garlic and chye poh in 2 tbsp oil for 5 minutes, until fragrant and crisp at the edges, then add sugar and soy sauce.
Unmould the cakes, top with the radish and serve with chilli sauce.

notes: Preserved radish is salty, so no extra salt is needed at the table.
Contains no egg or dairy.

title: Mee Soto Singapore Chicken Noodle Soup
summary: Turmeric chicken broth with noodles, bean sprouts and boiled egg, served with a spoon of sambal.

steps.text: Blend the shallots, garlic, ginger and turmeric to a paste and fry in the oil for 5 minutes until fragrant.
Add the bruised lemongrass, chicken, water and salt and simmer for 25 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through and tender.
Lift out the chicken, shred it and keep the broth hot.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes until firm, then peel and halve.
Blanch the noodles and bean sprouts for 1 minute, until the noodles are just tender.
Divide into bowls, add chicken, ladle over broth and top with egg, spring onion, sambal and lime.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until there is no pink and it reaches 75°C, and chill leftovers within 2 hours.
Cook the eggs until the yolks are set.

title: Singapore Style Lor Mai Gai Sticky Rice Parcels
summary: Glutinous rice steamed with chicken, mushroom and Chinese sausage in lotus leaf-style wrapping, a dim-sum breakfast.

steps.text: Soak the dried mushrooms in hot water for 20 minutes, then slice, keeping 3 tbsp of the soaking water.
Slice the chicken and sausage and toss the chicken with 1 tbsp oyster sauce, soy and cornflour.
Stir-fry the sausage, mushroom and chicken in the oil for 6 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through, then add the remaining oyster sauce and soaking water.
Steam the soaked, drained rice for 20 minutes until tender, then fold in the sesame oil.
Spoon rice and filling onto sheets of baking paper (not listed, cut to size) and fold into tight parcels.
Steam the parcels for 20 minutes until piping hot throughout and the rice is sticky and glossy.
Serve scattered with spring onion.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C and keep parcels steaming hot until served.
Soak the rice for 4 hours before cooking, which is not counted in prep time.
Contains pork sausage, which must reach 75°C too.

title: Nasi Lemak Singapore Chicken Wing Plate
summary: Coconut rice with crisp spiced chicken wings, fried anchovies, cucumber and peanuts.

steps.text: Rinse the rice and cook it with the coconut milk, water and a pinch of salt for 18 minutes, until tender, then rest it covered.
Rub the wings with turmeric, coriander and salt.
Bake the wings at 220C for 30 minutes, turning once, until deep golden and cooked through.
Fry the anchovies and peanuts in the oil for 3 minutes until crisp and golden.
Slice the cucumber and plate the rice with the wings, anchovies, peanuts, cucumber and sambal.

notes: Food safety: wings must reach 75°C and have no pink near the bone.
Contains peanuts and fish.
Coconut milk is calorie-dense, so this is a rich plate.

title: Roti Prata with Dhal Singapore Breakfast
summary: Flaky, stretched flatbread torn into a mild lentil dhal.

steps.text: Knead the flour, salt, sugar, water and 2 tbsp ghee for 8 minutes until the dough is soft and elastic, then divide into 8 balls and coat with ghee.
Simmer the lentils with the water and turmeric for 20 minutes, until completely soft.
Fry the onion, garlic and curry powder in the oil for 6 minutes, until golden, then add the tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes until jammy.
Stir into the lentils and simmer for 5 minutes until thick, seasoning with salt.
Stretch each ball very thin, fold into a square and fry in a hot pan for 3 minutes each side, until golden and flaky.
Clap the pratas to loosen the layers and serve with the dhal.

notes: Rest the dough balls in ghee for at least 2 hours, which is not counted in prep time.
Ghee is dairy, so it is not dairy-free; use oil if needed.

title: Egg White Spinach Omelette Muffins High Protein
summary: Baked egg cups with spinach, feta and sun-dried tomato, easy to batch and reheat.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180C and oil a 12-hole muffin tin.
Wilt the spinach in a pan for 2 minutes until soft, then squeeze out moisture and chop.
Whisk the eggs and whites with pepper and fold in the spinach, feta, tomato and spring onion.
Pour into the holes and bake for 20 minutes, until puffed, set in the centre and lightly golden.
Cool for 3 minutes before lifting out.

notes: Food safety: bake until the centres are fully set; reheat leftovers until steaming hot and eat within 3 days.
Feta is salty, so no salt is added.

title: Tofu Scramble Breakfast Burrito Dairy Free
summary: Turmeric tofu scramble with black beans, avocado and salsa wrapped in warm tortillas.

steps.text: Crumble the tofu and fry in the oil with turmeric, cumin and salt for 6 minutes, until dry and golden.
Add the diced capsicum and cook for 4 minutes until tender.
Warm the beans in a small pan for 3 minutes until hot.
Stir the nutritional yeast through the tofu.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds each side.
Fill with tofu, beans, avocado and salsa, fold in the sides and roll tight.

notes: Tofu and beans give about 27 g protein per burrito.
Check tortillas if you need them dairy-free; most are.

title: Greek Yoghurt Protein Pancakes with Berries
summary: Fluffy oat pancakes made with Greek yoghurt and eggs for a high-protein start.

steps.text: Blend the oats to a fine flour, then add the yoghurt, eggs, baking powder, vanilla and honey and blend smooth.
Rest the batter for 5 minutes while a non-stick pan heats over medium heat.
Cook 1/4 cup scoops for 2 minutes until bubbles form, then flip and cook 1 to 2 minutes until golden and set through.
Stack the pancakes and top with berries and maple syrup.

notes: Food safety: cook the pancakes until the centre is no longer wet.
About 17 g protein per serve.

title: Smoked Salmon Egg Muffin Stack
summary: Toasted muffins with scrambled eggs, smoked salmon and chives.

steps.text: Split and toast the muffins until golden.
Whisk the eggs with milk and pepper.
Melt the butter in a pan over low heat and stir the eggs gently for 3 minutes, until softly set and creamy.
Pile the eggs on the muffins and top with salmon, chives and a squeeze of lemon.

notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until set; smoked salmon is not recommended for pregnant people unless cooked.
Contains fish, egg, dairy and gluten.

title: Menemen Turkish Tomato and Egg
summary: Soft eggs folded through a sweet pepper and tomato base, scooped up with bread.

steps.text: Fry the sliced capsicum in the oil for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the grated tomato and salt and cook for 6 minutes, until thick and jammy.
Crack in the eggs and stir gently for 3 minutes until just set but still soft.
Sprinkle with chilli and serve with toasted sourdough.

notes: Add sucuk for a meat version.
Food safety: cook until the eggs are fully set. Use fresh, uncracked eggs; for pregnant women, older people, young children and anyone with low immunity, cook the eggs until the yolks are firm.

title: Peruvian Aguadito de Pollo Chicken and Coriander Soup
summary: Bright green coriander soup with chicken, rice, peas and potato.

steps.text: Blend the coriander with a little stock until a smooth green paste.
Fry the onion, garlic and aji paste in the oil for 6 minutes until soft and fragrant.
Add the chicken and stock and simmer for 15 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through, then shred it.
Add the rice, diced potato and carrot and simmer for 15 minutes until tender.
Return the chicken, add the peas and coriander paste, and cook for 3 minutes until bright green.

notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C and have no pink.
Aji amarillo paste can be replaced with mild yellow chilli.

title: Oaxacan Caldo de Piedra Style Fish Soup
summary: Chilli and tomato fish broth with white fish, prawns and lime, in the spirit of a coastal Oaxacan caldo.

steps.text: Toast the chillies in a dry pan for 1 minute until fragrant, then soak in hot water for 10 minutes.
Blend the chillies with tomato, half the onion and the garlic until smooth.
Fry the sauce in the oil for 8 minutes until darker and thick.
Add the stock, oregano and salt and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the fish and prawns and simmer for 5 minutes until the fish flakes and the prawns are pink.
Serve with lime, remaining onion and coriander.

notes: Food safety: cook fish and prawns until opaque and prawns are pink; eat within a day.
Contains fish and shellfish.

title: Sichuan Hot and Sour Soup Suan La Tang
summary: Silky tangy soup with tofu, mushroom, bamboo and egg ribbons, warming with white pepper.

items.raw: 2 tbsp cornflour mixed with 4 tbsp water

steps.text: Simmer the stock and sliced mushrooms for 8 minutes until tender.
Add the soy, vinegar and tofu strips and simmer for 3 minutes.
Stir in the cornflour slurry and cook for 2 minutes until the soup turns glossy and thickens.
Pour in the beaten eggs in a thin stream, stirring slowly, until ribbons form and set.
Finish with white pepper, sesame oil and spring onion.

notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until fully set.
Contains soy and egg.

title: Georgian Kharcho Beef and Walnut Soup
summary: Rich beef soup thickened with ground walnuts and rice, warmed with coriander and chilli.

steps.text: Simmer the beef cubes in the water for 1 hour, skimming, until tender.
Fry the onion in the oil for 8 minutes until golden, then stir in the tomato paste and spices for 1 minute.
Grind the walnuts with the garlic into a coarse paste.
Add the onion mix, rice and walnut paste to the soup and simmer for 20 minutes until the rice is soft.
Stir in the chopped coriander and salt.

notes: Food safety: cook the beef until tender and at least 75°C inside.
Contains tree nuts.

title: Lebanese Lentil and Silverbeet Soup Adas bi Hamod
summary: Lemony green lentil soup with silverbeet and coriander.

steps.text: Simmer the lentils in the water for 25 minutes until just tender.
Fry the onions in 2 tbsp oil for 10 minutes until deep golden.
Fry the garlic and coriander in the last tbsp oil for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the silverbeet and onion to the lentils and cook for 5 minutes until the leaves wilt.
Stir the flour into the lemon juice, add it with the garlic mix, and simmer for 5 minutes until thickened.

notes: Vegan.
Contains gluten from the flour.

title: Andalusian Ajo Blanco Chilled Almond Soup
summary: Cold white soup of almonds, garlic and sherry vinegar, served with grapes.

steps.text: Soak the bread in a little water for 5 minutes, then squeeze it dry.
Blend the almonds, bread and garlic with the water until very smooth.
Blend in the oil in a thin stream until the soup is creamy and pale.
Season with vinegar and salt and chill for 1 hour until very cold.
Serve in chilled bowls with diced apple scattered over until just covered.

notes: Contains tree nuts and gluten.
Olive oil makes this rich, so a small bowl goes a long way.

title: Andalusian Gazpacho with Cucumber Salsa
summary: Classic cold tomato soup with olive oil and a crisp cucumber topping.

steps.text: Soak the bread in water for 5 minutes and squeeze it dry.
Blend the tomatoes, half the cucumber, the capsicum, garlic and bread until smooth.
Add the oil slowly while blending until the soup looks creamy.
Season with vinegar and salt and chill for 1 hour until cold.
Dice the remaining cucumber and scatter over the bowls.

notes: Vegan.
Chill well; flavours deepen overnight.

title: Thai Larb Gai Chicken Salad
summary: Minced chicken salad with lime, fish sauce, toasted rice powder, mint and chilli.

steps.text: Cook the mince in the water over medium heat for 8 minutes, breaking it up, until no pink remains.
Cool for 2 minutes, then toss with lime, fish sauce and chilli.
Stir in the rice powder, sliced shallot, spring onion and herbs.
Spoon into lettuce leaves to serve.

notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C with no pink.
Contains fish sauce, so not vegetarian.

title: Beetroot, Rocket and Walnut Salad with Honey Balsamic
summary: Earthy beetroot with peppery rocket, tangy goat cheese and crunchy walnuts.

steps.text: Roast the beetroot, wrapped in foil with oil, at 200C for 45 minutes until tender.
Cool, peel and cut into wedges.
Toast the walnuts in a dry pan for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Whisk balsamic, honey and salt.
Toss the beetroot and rocket with dressing, and top with crumbled cheese and walnuts.

notes: Contains tree nuts and dairy.
Wear gloves when peeling beetroot.

title: Roast Autumn Pumpkin and Sage Side
summary: Caramelised wedges tossed with crisp sage and pepitas.

steps.text: Toss the pumpkin with 2 tbsp oil, maple syrup and salt and roast at 220C for 30 minutes, until deep golden and tender.
Fry the sage in the remaining oil for 1 minute until crisp.
Toast the pepitas in a dry pan for 2 minutes until they pop.
Scatter the sage and pepitas over the pumpkin.

notes: Vegan.

title: Spring Peas with Mint and Lemon Butter
summary: Sweet peas and broad beans in lemony butter.

steps.text: Simmer the peas and green beans in salted water for 4 minutes, until just tender.
Drain well and return to the pan.
Stir in the butter and lemon zest until glossy.
Fold through the torn mint until evenly distributed.

notes: Dairy-free version: use olive oil.

title: Summer Zucchini Ribbons with Basil and Parmesan
summary: Raw and quickly seared zucchini with basil and shaved vegetarian hard cheese.

steps.text: Shave the zucchini into ribbons.
Sear half in the oil with garlic for 2 minutes, until just softening.
Toss with raw ribbons, lemon, salt and torn basil.
Shave the cheese over the top.

notes: Uses vegetarian hard cheese.

title: Rotkohl German Sweet-Sour Red Cabbage
summary: Sweet-sour cabbage braised with apple, vinegar and cloves.

steps.text: Fry the onion in the oil for 6 minutes until soft.
Add the shredded cabbage, apple, vinegar, sugar, cloves, salt and water.
Cover and cook on low for 40 minutes, stirring now and then, until the cabbage is tender and glossy.
Taste and adjust the vinegar before serving.

notes: Vegan.

title: Egyptian Style Mashed Bean Breakfast with Tomato
summary: Mashed fava beans with olive oil, lemon, cumin and chopped tomato, scooped up with flatbread.

steps.text: Warm the beans with their liquid and garlic for 10 minutes until hot.
Mash roughly with cumin, lemon juice and salt.
Spoon into bowls, drizzle with oil and top with tomato and parsley.
Serve with warmed flatbread.

notes: Vegan.
Contains gluten.

title: Tahini and Toum Lebanese Garlic Sauce Trio
summary: Sesame yoghurt, tahini lemon and garlic sauces for grilled meat or falafel.

steps.text: Whisk tahini, juice of 1 lemon, water and salt until pale and thick.
Mash the garlic with salt, then stir into the yoghurt with the remaining lemon juice.
Fold in the parsley until evenly mixed through.
Chill in a covered jar until needed, until cold and thickened.

notes: Contains sesame and dairy.
Keeps 4 days in the fridge.

title: Georgian Satsivi Walnut Sauce
summary: Silky walnut sauce with garlic, coriander and spice, served with chicken or vegetables.

steps.text: Fry the onion in oil for 6 minutes until golden.
Grind the walnuts with the garlic to a paste.
Mix in the onion, spices and vinegar.
Stir in hot water gradually and cook gently for 3 minutes until thick.
Season with salt and serve warm or at room temperature.

notes: Contains tree nuts.
Vegan.

title: Poha Flattened Rice with Peanuts and Lime
summary: Light, turmeric-yellow flattened rice with peanuts, curry leaves and lime.

steps.text: Rinse the flattened rice in a sieve until just softened and set aside to drain.
Fry the mustard seeds, peanuts in the oil for 2 minutes, until the seeds pop and the peanuts brown.
Add the diced onion, chillies and diced potato and cook for 8 minutes until the potato is tender.
Stir in turmeric, salt and the rice and cook for 3 minutes until hot through.
Finish with lime juice and coriander.

notes: Vegan.
Contains peanuts.

title: Aloo Paratha Potato Stuffed Flatbread
summary: Whole wheat flatbreads stuffed with spiced mashed potato, griddled until blistered.

steps.text: Knead the flour, salt and water for 5 minutes into a soft dough.
Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes until soft, then mash with cumin, garam masala, chilli and coriander.
Roll each dough ball, fill with potato, pinch closed and roll out thin again.
Cook on a hot dry pan for 2 minutes a side, then brush with ghee and cook until golden and blistered.
Serve hot, straight from the pan, with yoghurt alongside.

notes: Contains gluten and dairy.
Use oil in place of ghee for dairy-free.

title: Arepas with Black Beans and Avocado
summary: Crisp-outside, soft-inside cornmeal cakes split and stuffed with beans and avocado.

steps.text: Mix the cornmeal, salt and water into a soft dough and rest for 5 minutes.
Shape into 8 thick discs.
Cook in the oil in a pan for 5 minutes a side, until a crisp golden crust forms.
Bake at 180C for 10 minutes until the arepas sound hollow when tapped.
Warm the beans for 5 minutes until hot and mash the avocado with lime.
Split the arepas and fill with beans, avocado and feta.

notes: Dairy-free: leave out the feta.
Gluten-free as long as the cornmeal is.

title: Okonomiyaki Cabbage Pancake
summary: Savoury Osaka-style cabbage pancake with sweet sauce, mayonnaise and bonito flakes.

steps.text: Mix the flour, dashi, eggs, cabbage and spring onion into a thick batter.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan and spoon in the batter, topping with the bacon.
Cook for 6 minutes until golden underneath, flip and cook 5 minutes until the bacon is cooked and the middle is firm.
Brush with sauce, drizzle with mayonnaise and scatter with bonito.

notes: Food safety: cook the pancake until the centre is fully set and the bacon is crisp.
Contains pork, egg, fish and gluten.

title: Full Australian Breakfast Plate
summary: Eggs, bacon, grilled tomato, smashed avocado, mushrooms and toast.

steps.text: Grill the bacon for 6 minutes until crisp and cooked through.
Fry the halved tomatoes and mushrooms in the oil for 8 minutes until browned and soft.
Fry the eggs in the butter for 3 minutes until the whites are set.
Mash the avocado with lemon and pepper.
Toast the bread until golden and plate everything together.

notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are firm and yolks thickened.
Bacon must be cooked through.

title: Spiced Lamb and Hummus Breakfast Bowl
summary: Spiced minced lamb over hummus with tomato, cucumber and parsley.

steps.text: Fry the lamb in the oil for 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned and no pink remains.
Stir in the spices for 1 minute until fragrant.
Spread the hummus into bowls.
Top with lamb, diced tomato, cucumber and parsley, and squeeze over lemon.

notes: Food safety: minced lamb must reach 75°C inside, with no pink.
Contains sesame from hummus.

title: Cottage Cheese and Smoked Salmon Rye Toast
summary: Rye toast with cottage cheese, smoked trout, cucumber and dill, high in protein.

steps.text: Toast the rye until crisp at the edges.
Spread with cottage cheese.
Top with sliced cucumber and flaked salmon.
Finish with dill, lemon juice and pepper until each slice is generously covered.

notes: Smoked fish is not recommended for pregnant people unless heated to 75°C.
Contains fish, dairy and gluten.

title: Tortilla Espanola Breakfast Wedges
summary: Thick potato and onion omelette, cut into wedges, good hot or cold.

steps.text: Slice the potatoes thinly and fry gently in the oil with the onion for 15 minutes until completely tender.
Beat the eggs with salt and fold in the drained potato mix.
Cook in a 24cm pan over medium-low heat for 6 minutes until the base sets.
Flip with a plate and cook 5 minutes until the middle is set and no longer wet.
Rest for 5 minutes before cutting.

notes: Food safety: cook until the egg is fully set in the centre; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.
Most of the oil is drained away.

title: Lebanese Manakish Zaatar Flatbread
summary: Soft flatbread topped with thyme, sesame and olive oil, a Lebanese bakery breakfast.

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, salt, water and 1 tbsp oil and knead for 8 minutes until smooth.
Rest the dough covered until doubled, then divide into 4 balls and roll to 20cm rounds.
Stir the zaatar with the remaining oil and spread over the dough.
Bake at 240C for 10 minutes, until the edges are golden and the base is crisp.
Serve with cucumber and tomato.

notes: Vegan.
Contains gluten and sesame.

title: Miso Soup with Tofu and Wakame
summary: Quick Japanese morning soup of dashi, miso, silken tofu and seaweed.

steps.text: Soak the wakame in cold water for 5 minutes until soft, then drain.
Heat the dashi to a gentle simmer for 3 minutes until steaming, without boiling.
Dissolve the miso in a ladleful of the hot dashi and stir back in.
Add the tofu and wakame and heat for 2 minutes until hot through.
Ladle into bowls and serve with sliced spring onion on top.

notes: Contains soy and fish if the dashi is made with bonito.

title: Khao Tom Thai Rice Soup with Pork
summary: Gentle ginger rice soup with pork meatballs, a comforting Thai breakfast.

steps.text: Simmer the stock with sliced ginger for 5 minutes until fragrant.
Mix the pork with garlic, fish sauce and pepper and roll into small balls.
Drop the balls into the stock and simmer for 10 minutes until cooked through.
Add the rice and cook for 5 minutes until soft.
Serve topped with spring onion, fried garlic and coriander.

notes: Food safety: pork balls must reach 75°C with no pink centre.
Contains fish sauce.

title: Minestrone Genovese with Pesto
summary: Chunky vegetable and bean soup finished with a spoon of basil pesto.

steps.text: Cook the onion, carrot and celery in the oil for 8 minutes until soft.
Add the potato, tomatoes, stock and salt and simmer for 15 minutes until the potato is almost tender.
Add the zucchini, beans and pasta and simmer for 10 minutes until the pasta is tender.
Serve with the pesto stirred through.

notes: Pesto contains cheese and nuts; use vegetarian-hard-cheese pesto for vegetarian.

title: Fattoush Pomegranate and Sumac Salad
summary: Crunchy salad with toasted pita, sumac dressing and pomegranate.

steps.text: Brush the pita with oil and bake at 200C for 5 minutes until crisp and golden.
Whisk lemon juice, sumac and 3 tbsp oil.
Chop the vegetables and toss with mint and dressing.
Break the pita over the top.

notes: Vegan.

title: Spiced Chickpea Caesar Salad with Vegan Dressing
summary: Crisp cos with roasted chickpeas, garlic croutons and a creamy cashew dressing.

steps.text: Toss the chickpeas with oil and paprika and roast at 200C for 20 minutes, until crisp.
Cube the bread, toss with oil and bake alongside for 8 minutes until golden.
Blend the cashews, lemon, garlic, mustard, water and salt until silky.
Toss the lettuce with the dressing and top with chickpeas and croutons.

notes: Vegan.
Contains tree nuts and gluten.

title: Thai Green Papaya Style Cucumber Som Tam
summary: Crunchy cucumber and carrot crushed with lime, chilli and peanuts.

steps.text: Crush the garlic and chilli in a mortar to a rough paste.
Add the lime juice, fish sauce and sugar and stir until the sugar dissolves.
Add the sliced vegetables and bruise gently until they release their juices.
Top with crushed peanuts.

notes: Contains fish sauce and peanuts.

title: Roasted Cauliflower Salad with Currants and Lemon
summary: Roasted cauliflower with currants, almonds and parsley under a tangy dressing.

steps.text: Toss florets with 2 tbsp oil, cumin and salt and roast at 220C for 25 minutes, until browned at the edges.
Toast the almonds for 3 minutes until golden.
Whisk the lemon, honey and remaining oil.
Toss everything together while the cauliflower is warm.

notes: Contains tree nuts.
Use maple syrup for vegan.

title: Colcannon Irish Mashed Potato and Cabbage
summary: Creamy mash folded with buttery kale and spring onions.

steps.text: Boil the potatoes for 20 minutes until tender, then drain and mash.
Simmer the shredded cabbage in water for 5 minutes until tender, then drain.
Warm the milk with the spring onion for 3 minutes.
Fold the milk, butter and cabbage into the mash until smooth and creamy.

notes: Contains dairy.
Dairy-free: use olive oil and oat milk.

title: Honey Roast Carrots with Cumin and Yoghurt
summary: Sweet roasted carrots with cumin and tangy yoghurt.

steps.text: Toss the carrots with oil, honey, cumin and salt and roast at 200C for 30 minutes, until caramelised and tender.
Mix the yoghurt with lemon zest.
Spoon the yoghurt onto a plate, top with carrots and dill.

notes: Contains dairy.
Dairy-free: use coconut yoghurt.

title: Elote Mexican Street Corn Off the Cob
summary: Charred corn tossed with mayonnaise, lime, chilli and crumbled cheese.

steps.text: Char the corn in the oil for 10 minutes, turning, until blackened in spots.
Cut the kernels from the cobs with a sharp knife.
Mix with mayonnaise, lime juice and chilli.
Top with cheese and coriander.

notes: Contains egg and dairy.

title: Romesco Roasted Red Capsicum and Almond Sauce
summary: Smoky capsicum, almond and sherry vinegar sauce for grilled vegetables and fish.

steps.text: Roast the capsicums at 220C for 20 minutes, until blackened, then cool in a bag and peel.
Toast the almonds for 3 minutes until golden.
Blend with the garlic, vinegar, paprika, salt and capsicum, then drizzle in the oil until smooth.

notes: Contains tree nuts.
Vegan.

title: Zuppa Toscana Sausage Kale and Potato Soup
summary: Spicy Italian sausage soup with potato, kale and a splash of cream.

steps.text: Brown the sausage meat in the oil for 8 minutes, breaking it up, until cooked through, then lift out.
Cook the onion and garlic in the fat for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the sliced potato, stock and chilli and simmer for 15 minutes until the potato is tender.
Return the sausage, add kale and cream and simmer for 5 minutes until the kale wilts.

notes: Food safety: sausage must reach 75°C with no pink.
Contains dairy and pork.

title: Colombian Ajiaco Chicken and Potato Soup
summary: Three-potato Bogota soup with corn and chicken, served with capers and cream.

steps.text: Simmer the chicken, onion and spring onions in the water for 20 minutes until the chicken reaches 75°C, then shred it.
Add the diced potatoes, corn and herb and simmer for 30 minutes, until the potatoes break down and thicken the soup.
